questions.spokenPrompt: Do we have clearance to send the first batch to the paint shop this afternoon?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 第一批零件獲准在今天下午送去噴漆區了嗎？

options.text: The paint booth is free after lunch.
options.zh: 噴漆室午餐後就空了。
options.whyZh: 噴漆室有空不代表第一批零件已獲准送去噴漆。

options.text: Only if the inspector signs off before two.
options.zh: 只有檢驗員在兩點前簽核才可以。
options.whyZh: 說明下午送漆的核准條件：檢驗員要在兩點前簽核。

options.text: The last job came back from the paint shop this morning.
options.zh: 上一筆工單的零件今天早上已從噴漆區送回來了。
options.whyZh: 上一筆工單的進度，不能說明這一批是否獲准送漆。

questions.explanationZh: 說明下午送漆的核准條件：檢驗員要在兩點前簽核。

vocabulary.note: 指允許第一批零件送去噴漆的正式許可。
表示檢驗員完成確認並給予核准。

questions.evidence: Do we have clearance to send the first batch to the paint shop this afternoon? / Only if the inspector signs off before two.

questions.spokenPrompt: Do you have any cash for the farmers market?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 你有現金可以在農夫市集用嗎？

options.text: The bank closes at noon on Saturdays.
options.zh: 銀行星期六中午關門。
options.whyZh: 銀行的營業時間沒有說明手邊是否有現金，也沒有表示要去提款。

options.text: I already have enough bags for the produce.
options.zh: 我已經準備好足夠的袋子裝蔬果了。
options.whyZh: 購物袋夠不夠不是對方問的付款問題。

options.text: No, but there's an ATM on the way.
options.zh: 沒有，不過路上有提款機。
options.whyZh: 先回答沒有現金，再補充可以去哪裡提款。

questions.explanationZh: 先回答沒有現金，再補充可以去哪裡提款。

vocabulary.note: 販售農產品的市集；這裡是詢問到那裡付款用的現金。
指前往市集途中可以先提款。

questions.evidence: Do you have any cash for the farmers market? / No, but there's an ATM on the way.

questions.spokenPrompt: Should this label printer stay on the packing table?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 這台標籤印表機要留在包裝桌上嗎？

options.text: No, it belongs on the shelf under the table.
options.zh: 不用。它應該放在桌子下方的架子上。
options.whyZh: 「No」否定把標籤印表機留在包裝桌上；「on the shelf under the table」指定改放桌子下方的架子上。

options.text: There's a fresh roll of labels in the drawer.
options.zh: 抽屜裡有一卷新的標籤紙。
options.whyZh: 耗材的位置不能決定印表機要放在哪裡。

options.text: That table was delivered on Friday.
options.zh: 那張桌子是星期五送到的。
options.whyZh: 桌子的到貨時間與印表機要不要留在桌上無關。

questions.explanationZh: 「No」否定把標籤印表機留在包裝桌上；「on the shelf under the table」指定改放桌子下方的架子上。

vocabulary.note: 用來列印包裝標籤的設備。
標籤印表機該移到桌下的架子。

questions.evidence: Should this label printer stay on the packing table? / No, it belongs on the shelf under the table.

questions.spokenPrompt: I thought Priya couldn't eat the cake we ordered.
questions.spokenPromptZh: 我以為 Priya 不能吃我們訂的蛋糕。

options.text: She ordered a cake for her birthday last year.
options.zh: 她去年生日有訂蛋糕。
options.whyZh: 以前訂過蛋糕，不代表她能吃這次訂的這一款。

options.text: We changed the order after she told us about her allergy.
options.zh: 她告訴我們她會過敏後，我們就改了訂單。
options.whyZh: 指出原先的顧慮已納入訂單調整，正面回應說話者的疑問。

options.text: I'm picking it up at four on my way home.
options.zh: 我回家路上四點會去取蛋糕。
options.whyZh: 取貨安排沒有回應她能不能吃蛋糕的顧慮。

questions.explanationZh: 指出原先的顧慮已納入訂單調整，正面回應說話者的疑問。

vocabulary.note: 是修改蛋糕訂單時必須考量的原因。
不是另外下單，而是修改先前的蛋糕訂單。

questions.evidence: I thought Priya couldn't eat the cake we ordered. / We changed the order after she told us about her allergy.

questions.spokenPrompt: What if the sample case won't fit in the taxi trunk?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 萬一裝樣品的箱子放不進計程車後車廂，怎麼辦？

options.text: It's the case with the blue tag.
options.zh: 是貼著藍色標籤的那一箱。
options.whyZh: 辨認箱子並沒有解決空間不夠的問題。

options.text: The driver can wait by the loading door.
options.zh: 司機可以在裝卸區入口等。
options.whyZh: 改變等候位置不會讓後車廂容納得下箱子。

options.text: Then we'll request a larger vehicle.
options.zh: 那我們就改叫一輛大一點的車。
options.whyZh: 直接說明箱子放不下時可改叫更大的車。

questions.explanationZh: 直接說明箱子放不下時可改叫更大的車。

vocabulary.note: 裝樣品的箱子，不是指某個案例。
題幹擔心樣品箱放不進去。

questions.evidence: What if the sample case won't fit in the taxi trunk? / Then we'll request a larger vehicle.

questions.spokenPrompt: I can bring your grocery order up after dinner.
questions.spokenPromptZh: 我晚餐後可以把你訂的雜貨拿上樓。

options.text: I bought groceries at that store last week.
options.zh: 我上週有去那家店買雜貨。
options.whyZh: 上週的購物經驗與這一單何時拿上樓無關。

options.text: Dinner usually takes about half an hour.
options.zh: 晚餐通常會吃半個小時左右。
options.whyZh: 沒有回應這個幫忙提議，也沒有表示物品可以等多久。

options.text: Could you bring the frozen items up now?
options.zh: 冷凍食品可以現在就先幫我拿上來嗎？
options.whyZh: 接受對方幫忙的方向，但針對不能久放的品項提出更早的時間。

questions.explanationZh: 接受對方幫忙的方向，但針對不能久放的品項提出更早的時間。

vocabulary.note: 這些食品需要優先拿上樓。
是原先提議送上整筆雜貨訂單的時間。

questions.evidence: I can bring your grocery order up after dinner. / Could you bring the frozen items up now?

questions.spokenPrompt: Why are we leaving the old prices on the shelves for now?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 為什麼目前還保留貨架上的舊標價？

options.text: The registers won't switch to the new prices until closing.
options.zh: 收銀系統要等到打烊才會切換成新價格。
options.whyZh: 暗示現在更換會讓貨架標價與收銀金額不一致，解釋為何要等。

options.text: The new price labels are in the office.
options.zh: 新的標價牌在辦公室。
options.whyZh: 知道新標價牌在哪裡，仍無法解釋為什麼暫時不更換。

options.text: We keep last year's price lists in a separate folder.
options.zh: 我們把去年的價格表放在另一個資料夾。
options.whyZh: 舊資料的歸檔方式不是目前保留貨架舊價格的原因。

questions.explanationZh: 暗示現在更換會讓貨架標價與收銀金額不一致，解釋為何要等。

vocabulary.note: 在這裡指店內結帳所用的設備或系統。
新價格要等到打烊才在收銀系統生效。

questions.evidence: Why are we leaving the old prices on the shelves for now? / The registers won't switch to the new prices until closing.

questions.spokenPrompt: Will I have to pay a late fee if I return this book on Thursday?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 如果我星期四還這本書，要付逾期費嗎？

options.text: The return slot is next to the side door.
options.zh: 還書口在側門旁邊。
options.whyZh: 回答了去哪裡還書，卻沒說明會不會逾期。

options.text: No, the book isn't due until Friday.
options.zh: 不會，這本書到星期五才到期。
options.whyZh: 還書期限是星期五，星期四還書不會逾期，因此不必付逾期費。

options.text: You can check out up to six books at a time.
options.zh: 你一次最多可以借六本書。
options.whyZh: 借閱上限和這本書星期四歸還是否逾期無關。

questions.explanationZh: 還書期限是星期五，星期四還書不會逾期，因此不必付逾期費。

vocabulary.note: 超過借閱期限才可能收取的費用。
此片語在 isn't due until Friday 中表示星期四還來得及。

questions.evidence: Will I have to pay a late fee if I return this book on Thursday? / No, the book isn't due until Friday.

options.text: The tour starts upstairs at eleven.
options.zh: 參觀十一點從樓上開始。
options.whyZh: 集合時間和起點沒有回答訪客是否需要護目鏡。

questions.spokenPrompt: We can sit inside now or wait for a table outside. Think Grandpa can hear us over the music out there?
questions.spokenPromptZh: 現在可以坐室內，也可以等戶外的桌位。外頭有音樂，你覺得爺爺聽得見我們說話嗎？

options.text: The host said we could have the table by the kitchen now.
options.zh: 接待人員說廚房旁那桌現在就能坐。
options.whyZh: 重複了室內有空位，但沒有比較兩處的噪音，也沒有回答戶外是否方便交談。

options.text: The band has the night off, but they're playing a recording at the same volume.
options.zh: 樂團今晚休息，但店家播錄音，音量一樣大。
options.whyZh: 音源改了，音量並未降低；這沒有提供爺爺能否聽清楚談話的依據。

options.text: He could follow us fine out there last week, and it's quieter tonight.
options.zh: 上星期我們坐外面時，他聽得清楚；今晚外頭更安靜。
options.whyZh: 用同一地點的經驗回答：上週能聽清楚，今晚更安靜，因此戶外座位應可行。

questions.explanationZh: 用同一地點的經驗回答：上週能聽清楚，今晚更安靜，因此戶外座位應可行。

vocabulary.note: hear us over the music 是問音樂是否會蓋過說話聲。
這裡指跟得上談話內容，不是跟著走。

questions.evidence: We can sit inside now or wait for a table outside. Think Grandpa can hear us over the music out there? / He could follow us fine out there last week, and it's quieter tonight.

vocabulary.note: 活動中用來陳列物品的架子。

questions.evidence: Where should we leave the empty display stands? / In the marked area behind the curtain.

questions.prompt: What does Purchasing need before the change is tried on another line?
questions.promptZh: 在另一條線試行前，採購部需要什麼？

options.text: A measurement of the fresh water saved
options.zh: 實際節省多少新水的量測資料
options.whyZh: 男子要裝水表，以提供第二條線試行前所需的節水資料。

options.text: An estimate of the cost of a larger tank
options.zh: 較大的回收槽要花多少錢的估算
options.whyZh: 回收槽目前只須排空，沒有要求購買或估價。

options.text: A schedule for the afternoon run
options.zh: 下午的生產時程
options.whyZh: 下午開工時間是排空回收槽的期限，不是第二條線試行前的資料。

options.text: A sample of the coating used on the second line
options.zh: 第二條線使用的塗料樣品
options.whyZh: 採購部要的是用水量的節省數據，不是塗料樣品。

questions.explanationZh: 男子要裝水表，以提供第二條線試行前所需的節水資料。
questions.evidence: Purchasing will want to see how much fresh water we save before we try this on the second line.

vocabulary.term: put a meter on the line
vocabulary.note: meter 是計量器；量測用水量不是預估成本。

questions.prompt: What does the man say his mother needs?
questions.promptZh: 男子說他媽媽需要什麼？

options.text: A ticket for a lower price
options.zh: 較便宜的票
options.whyZh: 他沒有詢問票價或折扣。

options.text: A seat beside the entrance
options.zh: 入口旁的座位
options.whyZh: 他關心的是能不能看清字幕，不是出入口距離。

options.text: Captions for the movie
options.zh: 電影字幕
options.whyZh: 男子開頭直接說媽媽需要字幕。

options.text: A quieter showing
options.zh: 比較安靜的場次
options.whyZh: 早場與晚場之別在字幕呈現方式，沒有談到音量偏好。

questions.explanationZh: 男子開頭直接說媽媽需要字幕。
questions.evidence: My mother needs captions.

vocabulary.note: 此處指把放映內容以文字呈現，讓有聽覺需求的人也能理解。

questions.prompt: Why is the late show unsuitable for the man's mother?
questions.promptZh: 晚場為什麼不適合男子的媽媽？

options.text: The devices needed to see the captions are unavailable.
options.zh: 用來看字幕的裝置都借不到了。
options.whyZh: 晚場字幕只能透過借用裝置觀看，但所有裝置都被預約了。

options.text: Captions for it will not be ready until next week.
options.zh: 晚場用的字幕要到下週才會完成。
options.whyZh: 晚場已有字幕，只能用專用裝置看；下週指重映的場次。

options.text: The seats in the middle section have sold out.
options.zh: 中間區的座位已售完。
options.whyZh: 對話說賣完的是早場的前排；沒說晚場中間區售完。

options.text: Its captions appear too high on the main screen.
options.zh: 字幕出現在大銀幕太高的位置。
options.whyZh: 大銀幕上有字幕的是早場，晚場不在大銀幕顯示字幕。

questions.explanationZh: 晚場字幕只能透過借用裝置觀看，但所有裝置都被預約了。
questions.evidence: The late show offers captions only on a device you borrow. Those devices are all reserved.

vocabulary.note: 設施本身有提供，不代表現場還有可借的設備。

questions.prompt: What is the man's best choice if he wants to go on Friday and make sure his mother can read the captions?
questions.promptZh: 如果男子希望星期五看電影，又要讓媽媽看得清字幕，他最適合選哪種安排？

options.text: The early show in the front row
options.zh: 早場前排
options.whyZh: 早場有大銀幕字幕，但前排座位已售完。

options.text: The early show in the closer side seats
options.zh: 早場較靠近銀幕的側邊座位
options.whyZh: 較近不代表更容易看字幕；喇叭支架會遮住銀幕底部。

options.text: The late show with a seat in the middle
options.zh: 晚場中間區
options.whyZh: 中間區的視野不能彌補晚場字幕不在大銀幕、裝置又借不到的問題。

options.text: The early show in the middle section
options.zh: 早場中間區
options.whyZh: 早場大銀幕有字幕；中間區確定看得清楚，且前排已售罄、側邊視線會受阻。

questions.explanationZh: 早場大銀幕有字幕；中間區確定看得清楚，且前排已售罄、側邊視線會受阻。
questions.evidence: Friday's early show has captions on the main screen. | The seats at the front are sold out | Try the middle section. We checked the captions from there yesterday. The side seats are closer, but the speaker stands block the bottom of the screen. | The late show offers captions only on a device you borrow. Those devices are all reserved.

vocabulary.term: block the bottom of the screen
vocabulary.note: block 是遮住視線；座位較近不一定看得更清楚。

questions.prompt: What has the design team already moved to the new service?
questions.promptZh: 設計組已經把什麼移到新服務？

options.text: Its billing records
options.zh: 帳務紀錄
options.whyZh: 對話談到續約費用，但沒有說帳務資料已移轉。

options.text: Its files
options.zh: 檔案
options.whyZh: 女子開頭說設計組上週已經移轉檔案。

options.text: Its clients' comments
options.zh: 客戶的留言
options.whyZh: 男子說匯出留言還沒完成。

options.text: Its user accounts
options.zh: 使用者帳戶
options.whyZh: 有提到一個舊服務帳戶，但未提到搬移使用者帳戶。

questions.explanationZh: 女子開頭說設計組上週已經移轉檔案。
questions.evidence: The design team moved its files to the new storage service last week. | The new service has the files, but it doesn't have the comments our clients added.

vocabulary.zh: 把檔案移轉到另一項服務
vocabulary.note: 移轉檔案不等於移轉客戶留言；兩者要分開確認。

questions.prompt: Which action lets the team avoid a new charge without losing the chance to export the comments?
questions.promptZh: 要避免再被扣款，又保留匯出留言的機會，團隊應該採取什麼做法？

options.text: Close the old account on Friday before noon.
options.zh: 星期五中午前關閉舊帳戶。
options.whyZh: 關閉帳戶不是關閉自動續約；提前關閉帳戶可能在匯出或確認完成前失去必要的存取權限。

options.text: Wait until the export is done on Monday to cancel renewal.
options.zh: 等星期一匯出完成再取消續約。
options.whyZh: 星期一才處理會錯過星期五中午的期限。

options.text: Turn off automatic renewal by Friday at noon.
options.zh: 最晚星期五中午關閉自動續約。
options.whyZh: 能避免扣款，又能利用保留到星期一當天的唯讀存取匯出留言。

options.text: Leave automatic renewal on and make the old account read-only.
options.zh: 維持自動續約，再把舊帳戶設成唯讀。
options.whyZh: 唯讀不會關掉自動續約；維持續約仍有扣款問題。

questions.explanationZh: 能避免扣款，又能利用保留到星期一當天的唯讀存取匯出留言。
questions.evidence: Turn off automatic renewal by noon Friday. We'll still have read-only access through Monday, but there won't be another charge. | I can export those by Monday afternoon.

vocabulary.note: 關閉自動續約不等於關閉帳戶；本題說明關閉續約後，星期一仍可唯讀存取。

questions.prompt: What does the first woman want to verify before the old account is closed?
questions.promptZh: 第一位女子想在關閉舊帳戶前確認什麼？

options.text: Whether all of the client comments were included
options.zh: 客戶的所有留言是否都包含在內
options.whyZh: 她說收到匯出資料後要確認每一則客戶留言都保留下來。

options.text: Whether anyone used the account over the weekend
options.zh: 週末是否有人使用帳戶
options.whyZh: 唯讀存取期間不等於她要查週末使用紀錄。

options.text: Whether the files need to be moved again
options.zh: 檔案是否需要再移轉一次
options.whyZh: 原始檔案上週就已移轉，她要查的是留言。

options.text: Whether the price of the new service has changed
options.zh: 新服務價格是否變動
options.whyZh: 目的是停止舊服務續約費，而非檢查新服務價格。

questions.explanationZh: 她說收到匯出資料後要確認每一則客戶留言都保留下來。
questions.evidence: I don't want to close the old account until I've checked that every client comment came through.

vocabulary.note: 此處說客戶留言已成功匯出或傳到，不是指人經過某地。

questions.prompt: What are the speakers making the panels for?
questions.promptZh: 兩位說話者製作飾板是為了什麼？

options.text: A set of office shelves
options.zh: 一組辦公室層架
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到辦公室層架。

options.text: The door of a storage cabinet
options.zh: 儲物櫃的門
options.whyZh: 飾板要並排安裝在櫃台，不是做櫃門。

options.text: A display wall in a showroom
options.zh: 展示間的陳列牆
options.whyZh: 對話未提到展示間或陳列牆。

options.text: The reception desk
options.zh: 接待櫃台
options.whyZh: 女子開頭直接說飾板要用在接待櫃台。

questions.explanationZh: 女子開頭直接說飾板要用在接待櫃台。
questions.evidence: We need twelve oak panels for the reception desk.

vocabulary.note: reception 在此指接待區，不是指接收訊號。

questions.prompt: Why does the man oppose turning some of the outlines sideways?
questions.promptZh: 男子為什麼反對把部分裁切輪廓轉成橫向？

options.text: The panels would no longer be the same size.
options.zh: 飾板的尺寸就會不一致。
options.whyZh: 旋轉輪廓並不會改變輪廓尺寸；他的顧慮是木紋。

options.text: The grain would run in different directions on the installed panels.
options.zh: 裝好的飾板木紋方向會不一致。
options.whyZh: 飾板並排時木紋應一致，旋轉部分輪廓會讓那些飾板的木紋方向不同。

options.text: The saw cannot cut across oak.
options.zh: 鋸台無法橫切橡木。
options.whyZh: 女子原先提出轉向裁切，男子反對的理由並非鋸台限制。

options.text: The darker sheet would have to be discarded.
options.zh: 顏色較深的板材就得丟棄。
options.whyZh: 深色是另一塊板材的配色顧慮，不是不可旋轉輪廓的理由。

questions.explanationZh: 飾板並排時木紋應一致，旋轉部分輪廓會讓那些飾板的木紋方向不同。
questions.evidence: The panels will sit side by side, so the grain needs to run the same way on all of them. Don't turn the outlines.

vocabulary.note: 木紋有方向；side by side 並排時，各片木材的方向會被一起看到。

questions.prompt: What will the woman most likely check about the spare sheet?
questions.promptZh: 女子最可能查看那塊備用板材的哪些條件？

options.text: Whether it has room for two panels that match the finished reference panel
options.zh: 是否有空間裁出兩片與手上那片成品相符的飾板
options.whyZh: 要補足兩片，她會看面積是否足夠；帶成品去則可比對木紋方向和顏色。

options.text: Whether it has room for a complete set of twelve panels
options.zh: 是否有空間裁完整的十二片飾板
options.whyZh: 現有板材能做十片，備用板只需補另外兩片。

options.text: Whether its darker side can be moved closer to the saw
options.zh: 顏色較深的一側能否移近鋸台
options.whyZh: 較深的一側涉及配色，不是擺在鋸台哪裡。

options.text: Whether it comes from a different supplier
options.zh: 是否來自另一家供應商
options.whyZh: 要核對的是尺寸與外觀，不是採購來源。

questions.explanationZh: 要補足兩片，她會看面積是否足夠；帶成品去則可比對木紋方向和顏色。
questions.evidence: Ten, but there's a partially used sheet behind the saw. I'll check whether it has room for the other two. | Take a finished panel with you. That sheet is darker on one side, and the finished desk should look even in color.

vocabulary.note: partially 表示部分；已用過的板料仍可能留有可裁切的空間。

questions.prompt: How many copies of the song does the choir need?
questions.promptZh: 合唱團需要幾份歌譜？

options.text: Ten
options.zh: 十份
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到十份。

options.text: Twelve
options.zh: 十二份
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到十二份。

options.text: Twenty
options.zh: 二十份
options.whyZh: 男子問是否仍需要二十份，女子回答是。

options.text: Thirty
options.zh: 三十份
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到三十份。

questions.explanationZh: 男子問是否仍需要二十份，女子回答是。
questions.evidence: Do we still need twenty copies of the new song? | Yes, but the print shop used the version from last month.

vocabulary.term: a copy of the new song
vocabulary.note: copy 在合唱排練情境是印好的單份樂譜，不是多一首歌。

questions.prompt: Why does the woman ask the man to remove a page from each folder?
questions.promptZh: 女子為什麼請男子從每個資料夾抽掉一頁？

options.text: To make room for a practice schedule
options.zh: 要騰出空間放排練時程表
options.whyZh: 資料夾要放更正後的歌譜頁，不是時程表。

options.text: To keep singers from using the wrong ending
options.zh: 避免團員唱到舊版的結尾
options.whyZh: 如果新舊兩頁都留著，團員可能不知道該唱哪一個結尾。

options.text: To keep the print shop from charging for extra copies
options.zh: 避免影印店另外收費
options.whyZh: 抽出舊頁不是為了避免影印費；對話沒談費用。

options.text: To create extra copies for the conductor
options.zh: 要多準備幾份給指揮
options.whyZh: 舊頁結尾已過時，不適合拿來當額外歌譜。

questions.explanationZh: 如果新舊兩頁都留著，團員可能不知道該唱哪一個結尾。
questions.evidence: Only the ending changed. | Please take the old page out, too. We can't stop rehearsal to explain which ending to sing.

vocabulary.note: take out 和 put in 是相反動作；更換頁面不只是加一頁。

questions.prompt: What will the choir members use the pencils for?
questions.promptZh: 合唱團員會用鉛筆做什麼？

options.text: To sign a record of who picked up a folder
options.zh: 簽名登記誰領了資料夾
options.whyZh: 女子沒有要求簽收。

options.text: To cross out the last page of the old version
options.zh: 把舊版最後一頁劃掉
options.whyZh: 舊頁會先抽掉，不需要請團員自己劃掉。

options.text: To write the shop's address on the folders
options.zh: 在資料夾上寫影印店地址
options.whyZh: 對話沒有要求標記影印店地址。

options.text: To mark when they should start singing
options.zh: 標記自己應該從哪裡開始唱
options.whyZh: 合唱語境中 the places where they come in 指團員在樂曲中進入、開始唱的位置。

questions.explanationZh: 合唱語境中 the places where they come in 指團員在樂曲中進入、開始唱的位置。
questions.evidence: I'll tell the group to bring a pencil to mark the places where they come in.

vocabulary.note: 音樂語境指在指定位置開始演唱或演奏，不是走進房間。

questions.prompt: What has the arts center requested?
questions.promptZh: 藝文中心提出了什麼要求？

options.text: An editable version of the poster
options.zh: 可編輯的海報檔
options.whyZh: 女子直接說藝文中心希望取得可編輯的檔案。

options.text: A larger version of the poster image
options.zh: 尺寸更大的海報圖片
options.whyZh: 他們需要自行編輯日期，並未要求較大的圖片。

options.text: A different layout for the campaign website
options.zh: 宣傳網站的新排版
options.whyZh: 網站只用來確認對方現用的字型，沒有請求網站排版。

options.text: A renewal of the group's image license
options.zh: 替藝文中心的圖片授權續約
options.whyZh: 對話討論現有字型授權範圍，沒有要求圖片授權續約。

questions.explanationZh: 女子直接說藝文中心希望取得可編輯的檔案。
questions.evidence: They'd like the editable file so they can put it in their own spring campaign.

vocabulary.note: editable 描述能否修改內容，和完成圖片只能觀看不同。

questions.prompt: Why can't the team simply send the original editable file for the arts center to use?
questions.promptZh: 團隊為什麼不能直接把原本的可編輯檔交給藝文中心使用？

options.text: The file is too large for the arts center's computers.
options.zh: 檔案太大，藝文中心的電腦無法處理。
options.whyZh: 沒有人提出檔案大小或硬體問題。

options.text: Its artwork still needs to be moved.
options.zh: 裡面的圖案仍需移動位置。
options.whyZh: 女子說對方要求鎖定圖案，不讓人更動。

options.text: Their font license does not cover editing on the center's computers.
options.zh: 團隊的字型授權不涵蓋在藝文中心的電腦上編輯。
options.whyZh: 授權只涵蓋團隊自己的電腦；對方不能沿用這份授權編輯原檔。

options.text: The arts center's website can't display the poster image.
options.zh: 藝文中心的網站無法顯示海報圖片。
options.whyZh: 授權限制與網站能不能顯示圖片無關。

questions.explanationZh: 授權只涵蓋團隊自己的電腦；對方不能沿用這份授權編輯原檔。
questions.evidence: our font license covers editing only on our own computers. They'd need their own license to edit that file.

vocabulary.note: cover 在授權語境表示包含某種用途；權限範圍不一定及於別人的電腦。

questions.prompt: Which version would let the center make the needed changes without buying a font license while keeping the artwork locked?
questions.promptZh: 哪個版本能讓藝文中心做所需的修改，又不用買字型授權，且能讓圖案維持鎖定？

options.text: A single flat image of the full poster using Lighthouse
options.zh: 整張改用 Lighthouse 並輸出成不可編輯圖片的海報
options.whyZh: 圖片無法讓對方自行編輯日期，即使使用了對方已有授權的字型也一樣。

options.text: A flat image for the artwork, with a separate editable date box in Lighthouse
options.zh: 圖案保留為不可編輯圖片，另加一個使用 Lighthouse 的可編輯日期欄
options.whyZh: 可編輯部分只有需要改的日期欄，且使用對方已有授權的 Lighthouse 字型。

options.text: A flat image for the artwork, with the original editable date box
options.zh: 圖案保留為不可編輯圖片，但日期欄仍用原有字型且可編輯
options.whyZh: 雖能編輯日期，原日期欄字型仍沒有涵蓋對方電腦的授權。

options.text: An editable copy of the full poster in Lighthouse
options.zh: 整張海報使用 Lighthouse，且全部內容皆可編輯
options.whyZh: 雖解決字型授權，但未保留圖案為不可編輯圖片，沒有同時滿足維持圖案不被編輯的條件。

questions.explanationZh: 可編輯部分只有需要改的日期欄，且使用對方已有授權的 Lighthouse 字型。
questions.evidence: We can send a finished image, but our font license covers editing only on our own computers. They'd need their own license to edit that file. | They asked us to lock the artwork in place, but they need to change the dates themselves. Is there a font they already have that looks close enough? | They have a current license for Lighthouse, the font on their website. And we can still send the artwork as a picture.

vocabulary.note: lock 在排版中可指固定圖層或圖稿；不表示日期文字也不能編輯。

questions.prompt: What machine are the speakers discussing?
questions.promptZh: 兩位說話者在討論哪一種設備？

options.text: A conveyor
options.zh: 輸送帶
options.whyZh: 對話沒談到輸送帶。

options.text: A packaging machine
options.zh: 包裝機
options.whyZh: 對話沒說這是包裝機。

options.text: A press
options.zh: 沖床
options.whyZh: 女子開頭直接詢問沖床是否能運轉到星期六。

options.text: An air compressor
options.zh: 空氣壓縮機
options.whyZh: 對話沒談到空氣壓縮機。

questions.explanationZh: 女子開頭直接詢問沖床是否能運轉到星期六。
questions.evidence: Can the press run through Saturday?

vocabulary.note: isn't due until Tuesday 表示「預定到星期二才需要換油」；行事曆日期不是實際的保養時數上限。

questions.prompt: Why does the man say the press needs service ahead of the date on the calendar?
questions.promptZh: 男子為什麼說沖床需要在行事曆所列日期之前保養？

options.text: It is running more hours than originally expected.
options.zh: 設備的運轉時數比原先預期多。
options.whyZh: 夜班增加了時數，沖床將提早達到保養上限。

options.text: The replacement oil came earlier than planned.
options.zh: 換油用的新油比預定更早到。
options.whyZh: 新油已到是安排保養的條件，卻不是時數上限提早達到的原因。

options.text: A test showed that the oil was already dirty.
options.zh: 測試顯示舊油已經變髒。
options.whyZh: 男子按時數判斷，沒說做過油品檢測。

options.text: The Saturday shift was canceled.
options.zh: 星期六的班取消了。
options.whyZh: 星期六早上仍要用設備，沒有取消。

questions.explanationZh: 夜班增加了時數，沖床將提早達到保養上限。
questions.evidence: Tuesday was our estimate, based on normal use. We added a night shift, so the press will reach its service limit by Friday evening. We go by operating hours, not the date on the calendar.

vocabulary.note: 在保養情境不是店面營業時間，而是設備累積運轉多久。

questions.prompt: What does the man want to find out before agreeing to the woman's plan?
questions.promptZh: 男子在答應女子的安排前，想先查明什麼？

options.text: Who ordered the new oil
options.zh: 是誰訂購新油
options.whyZh: 新油已到，不需要先查誰下單。

options.text: When the night shift started
options.zh: 夜班是什麼時候開始的
options.whyZh: 夜班用來說明運轉時數較長；現在要查的是保養作業前的等待時間。

options.text: How long Saturday's shift will be
options.zh: 星期六的班會有多長
options.whyZh: 他不是查星期六班長，而是查排油前設備要等多久。

options.text: How much time the oil needs to cool
options.zh: 舊油需要多久才會冷卻
options.whyZh: 舊油要冷卻後才能排掉，男子說要先查明這需要多久。

questions.explanationZh: 舊油要冷卻後才能排掉，男子說要先查明這需要多久。
questions.evidence: the old oil has to cool before they drain it. Let me find out how long that takes.

vocabulary.note: drain 是排出液體；油已到貨和舊油可以排放是兩件事。

questions.prompt: When does the man expect to get to the swap?
questions.promptZh: 男子預計什麼時候到交換會？

options.text: Before the swap opens
options.zh: 交換會開場前
options.whyZh: 男子說午餐後才會到，不會在開場前抵達。

options.text: After lunch
options.zh: 午餐後
options.whyZh: 男子直接說午餐後才到。

options.text: At noon
options.zh: 中午
options.whyZh: 中午左右是鄰居會回來的時間，不是男子說會到交換會的時間。

options.text: During lunch
options.zh: 午餐時間
options.whyZh: 男子說的是午餐後到，不是午餐時間到。

questions.explanationZh: 男子直接說午餐後才到。
questions.evidence: I won't get there until after lunch.

vocabulary.note: not ... until 表示在指定時間之前不會發生。

questions.prompt: Which information is still missing for the pumpkin seeds?
questions.promptZh: 南瓜種子的信封還缺少哪項資訊？

options.text: The kind of plant
options.zh: 植物的種類
options.whyZh: 男子已知道這是南瓜種子。

options.text: The neighbor's full name
options.zh: 鄰居的全名
options.whyZh: 規定未要求提供送種子者的姓名。

options.text: When the seeds were collected
options.zh: 種子的採收時間
options.whyZh: 男子沒有問鄰居何時採收，這正是信封上的必要資訊。

options.text: The variety of pumpkin
options.zh: 南瓜的品種
options.whyZh: 女子明說不知道品種也可以收。

questions.explanationZh: 男子沒有問鄰居何時採收，這正是信封上的必要資訊。
questions.evidence: each envelope has to say the kind of plant and the month and year the seeds were collected. | I know they're pumpkin seeds, but I didn't ask when she collected them.

vocabulary.note: 同一種植物可有多個栽培品種；本題標籤規則要求植物種類，不一定要求品種。

questions.prompt: What should the man do if he wants all three kinds of seeds accepted on Saturday?
questions.promptZh: 如果男子希望三種種子都能在星期六被收下，他應該怎麼做？

options.text: Send two envelopes with the woman, then bring the pumpkin seeds after he completes the label.
options.zh: 先託女子帶兩個信封，補好標籤後再把南瓜種子帶去。
options.whyZh: 兩包已有必要資訊，可先送；南瓜種子須補採收時間，午餐後仍可在三點前帶去。

options.text: Send all three envelopes with the woman and add his neighbor's name to the pumpkin label.
options.zh: 三包都託女子帶去，並把鄰居的姓名加在南瓜標籤上。
options.whyZh: 姓名不是必要資訊，不能代替採收時間。

options.text: Send the pumpkin seeds in the morning and keep the other two until their exact varieties are known.
options.zh: 早上先送南瓜種子，等查明另外兩包的確切品種再帶去。
options.whyZh: 規定不要求品種，反而是南瓜種子缺了採收時間。

options.text: Wait for the swap to end, then give all three envelopes to the woman.
options.zh: 等交換會結束，再把三個信封都交給女子。
options.whyZh: 活動三點結束；等到結束後便無法於交換會交件。

questions.explanationZh: 兩包已有必要資訊，可先送；南瓜種子須補採收時間，午餐後仍可在三點前帶去。
questions.evidence: The beans and basil have both details. | each envelope has to say the kind of plant and the month and year the seeds were collected. | Give me the other two before I leave. Your neighbor should be back around noon, so you can ask her about the pumpkin seeds then. The swap goes on until three. | I won't get there until after lunch. | I know they're pumpkin seeds, but I didn't ask when she collected them.

vocabulary.note: go on 指活動持續進行，不是表示活動三點開始。

questions.prompt: What can the new message system do?
questions.promptZh: 新的訊息系統能做什麼？

options.text: Unlock the building at lunch
options.zh: 在午餐時間解鎖大樓
options.whyZh: 談的是發送警示，不是控制門鎖。

options.text: Answer calls to the front desk
options.zh: 接聽服務台的電話
options.whyZh: 對話沒說系統會接電話。

options.text: Post staff schedules online
options.zh: 把值班表張貼到網路上
options.whyZh: 系統沒有排班或發佈時程的功能被提及。

options.text: Send building alerts by text message
options.zh: 透過簡訊發送大樓警示
options.whyZh: 女子第一句直接介紹這項新功能。

questions.explanationZh: 女子第一句直接介紹這項新功能。
questions.evidence: The message system can now send building alerts by text.

vocabulary.note: by text 指用簡訊這個管道，不是只以書面呈現。

questions.prompt: Why does the man advise against using the main list for the test?
questions.promptZh: 男子為什麼不建議用主要名單測試？

options.text: It does not include the front desk.
options.zh: 主要名單不包含服務台。
options.whyZh: 服務台在測試名單上；主要名單則會發給所有人。

options.text: Staff might mistake the test for a real alert.
options.zh: 員工可能把測試誤認成真正的警示。
options.whyZh: 即使不在辦公室也會收到，可能以為大樓真的關閉了。

options.text: Its messages are only delivered after lunch.
options.zh: 主要名單的訊息午餐後才會發送。
options.whyZh: 午餐只是提議的測試時段，不是主要名單的限制。

options.text: It can send only one message a day.
options.zh: 主要名單每天只能發一封訊息。
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到發送次數限制。

questions.explanationZh: 即使不在辦公室也會收到，可能以為大樓真的關閉了。
questions.evidence: If we use the main list, it will reach everyone, even people at home. They might think the building is closed.

vocabulary.note: reach 表示通知送達某人，不必是物理上到達某處。

questions.prompt: What does the man want the replies to establish?
questions.promptZh: 男子希望透過回覆確定什麼？

options.text: That both teams actually received the test alert
options.zh: 兩組人員都確實收到測試警示
options.whyZh: 發送紀錄不能證明收件，要求兩組回覆是要確認收到。

options.text: That the front desk changed its contact number
options.zh: 服務台已變更聯絡電話
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到更改電話。

options.text: That employees have returned from lunch
options.zh: 員工已吃完午餐回來
options.whyZh: 回覆是確認收到簡訊，不是確認是否回到辦公室。

options.text: That security has approved sending a real alert
options.zh: 保全已核准發送正式警示
options.whyZh: 要求回覆的是測試訊息，沒有要求核准真正的警示。

questions.explanationZh: 發送紀錄不能證明收件，要求兩組回覆是要確認收到。
questions.evidence: The front desk is on it, but security isn't. I'll add the security supervisor now. Ask both teams to reply with the word received, instead of just checking whether a message was sent.

vocabulary.note: reply with 可接具體回覆內容；送出訊息不等於已確認收到。

questions.prompt: What object will the museum display?
questions.promptZh: 博物館要展示哪一件物品？

options.text: A bronze lamp
options.zh: 一盞青銅燈
options.whyZh: 材料相同，但實際物品是鐘。

options.text: A bronze bell
options.zh: 一件青銅鐘
options.whyZh: 女方開頭明說要展示青銅鐘。

options.text: A framed river map
options.zh: 一張裝框的河川地圖
options.whyZh: 河川是展名，並不是這次要展出的物品。

options.text: A set of felt pads
options.zh: 一組毛氈墊
options.whyZh: 毛氈墊是待確認的用品，不是展品。

questions.explanationZh: 女方開頭明說要展示青銅鐘。
questions.evidence: The bronze bell is ready for the river exhibit. It weighs eleven kilograms, and its base is thirty centimetres wide.

vocabulary.note: 本對話指展出物品的展覽。

questions.prompt: What lets the team drop the low-platform requirement?
questions.promptZh: 為什麼這次可以不必使用矮平台？

options.text: The taller case will be replaced.
options.zh: 將改用較矮的展示櫃。
options.whyZh: 男方最後說照原計畫使用高展示櫃。

options.text: The bell will be placed outside the case.
options.zh: 青銅鐘會放在展示櫃外面。
options.whyZh: 仍要挑選能進展示櫃的展架。

options.text: The bell can hold its own label.
options.zh: 青銅鐘本身可托住標籤。
options.whyZh: 對話交代標籤貼到牆上，不是放在鐘上。

options.text: The label can be mounted separately.
options.zh: 標籤可以另外裝設。
options.whyZh: 把標籤放到牆上，就不必用矮平台支撐。

questions.explanationZh: 把標籤放到牆上，就不必用矮平台支撐。
questions.evidence: The case door is only forty centimetres wide, so the whole stand must fit through it. The shelf must not be narrower than the bell. Do we still need a low platform for the label? | No. The label can go on the wall. Please use the stand chart to choose what fits, then check that the felt pads are in the drawer.

vocabulary.note: 可支撐展示物的台面。

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which stand fits the bell and can pass through the case door?
questions.promptZh: 請看圖表。哪個展架能支撐這座鐘，並通過展示櫃門？

options.text: Harbor
options.zh: Harbor 型
options.whyZh: 架面寬三十二公分、承重十二公斤、外寬三十八公分，三項都符合。

options.text: Loom
options.zh: Loom 型
options.whyZh: 承重與外寬都符合，但架面只有二十八公分，比鐘底窄。

options.text: Quill
options.zh: Quill 型
options.whyZh: 架面與承重符合，但外寬四十二公分，無法通過四十公分的門。

options.text: Ridge
options.zh: Ridge 型
options.whyZh: 架面與外寬符合，但只能承重十公斤，支撐不了十一公斤的鐘。

questions.explanationZh: 架面寬三十二公分、承重十二公斤、外寬三十八公分，三項都符合。
questions.evidence: The bronze bell is ready for the river exhibit. It weighs eleven kilograms, and its base is thirty centimetres wide. | The case door is only forty centimetres wide, so the whole stand must fit through it. The shelf must not be narrower than the bell. Do we still need a low platform for the label? | Display stand chart. Harbor: outer width 38 cm, shelf width 32 cm, load limit 12 kg; Loom: outer width 36 cm, shelf width 28 cm, load limit 14 kg; Quill: outer width 42 cm, shelf width 35 cm, load limit 18 kg; Ridge: outer width 39 cm, shelf width 31 cm, load limit 10 kg.

vocabulary.note: 展架可負荷的最大重量。

questions.prompt: Why is the woman at the shelter?
questions.promptZh: 女方為什麼來到收容所？

options.text: To return an outdoor drop box
options.zh: 歸還戶外投遞箱
options.whyZh: 投遞箱是收容所設施，不是來歸還的物品。

options.text: To change her sister’s work schedule
options.zh: 更改姊姊的上班時間
options.whyZh: 上班只是姊姊沒親自到場的原因。

options.text: To collect a cat adopted by her sister
options.zh: 替姊姊接走她已認養的貓
options.whyZh: 女方開頭說來接 Hazel，認養由姊姊辦理。

options.text: To start a new adoption for herself
options.zh: 為自己重新辦理認養
options.whyZh: 認養已由姊姊辦完，她只是代領。

questions.explanationZh: 女方開頭說來接 Hazel，認養由姊姊辦理。
questions.evidence: I’ve come to collect Hazel, the grey cat. My sister completed the adoption yesterday. She’s at work, but she sent me the pickup code.

vocabulary.note: 完成認養手續的人。

questions.prompt: What additional step is needed before the woman can collect Hazel?
questions.promptZh: 女方接走 Hazel 前，還需要完成什麼步驟？

options.text: Her sister must send a note naming her from the adopter’s account.
options.zh: 姊姊須從認養人帳號傳代領通知，寫上她的名字。
options.whyZh: 女方是代領人，領取碼只夠認養人本人使用。

options.text: The woman must ask her sister to forward the pickup code again.
options.zh: 女方要請姊姊再轉傳一次領取碼。
options.whyZh: 她已收到領取碼；代領仍需要另一份有姓名的通知。

options.text: The woman must put the code in the outdoor drop box.
options.zh: 女方必須把領取碼投入戶外投遞箱。
options.whyZh: 投遞箱只收紙本表單；代領授權由認養人帳號送出。

options.text: Her sister must come back after work to complete the adoption again.
options.zh: 姊姊下班後須再辦一次認養。
options.whyZh: 認養已完成，帳號通知可讓代領人接走動物。

questions.explanationZh: 女方是代領人，領取碼只夠認養人本人使用。
questions.evidence: I’ve come to collect Hazel, the grey cat. My sister completed the adoption yesterday. She’s at work, but she sent me the pickup code. | A code works for the adopter. If another person collects the animal, we need a pickup note from the adopter’s account with that person’s name. You can wait while she sends it.

vocabulary.note: 認養人提供用來辨識指定代領人的訊息。

questions.prompt: What should the woman do about the carrier?
questions.promptZh: 女方應如何處理提籠？

options.text: Fix the latch in the car and return the old carrier to the shelter.
options.zh: 在車上修扣鎖，再把原本的提籠還給收容所。
options.whyZh: 原本的提籠是她的；她提出借用替代提籠。

options.text: Borrow one and return it in the outdoor drop box.
options.zh: 借一個，用完投入戶外投遞箱。
options.whyZh: 投遞箱只收紙本表單，不收提籠。

options.text: Use her own carrier and leave its broken latch open.
options.zh: 使用自己的提籠，壞掉的扣鎖不用扣。
options.whyZh: 收容所工作人員允許借用提籠，沒叫她用扣鎖壞掉的。

options.text: Borrow one at the side counter and bring it back by Sunday.
options.zh: 在旁邊的櫃檯借一個，最遲星期日帶回。
options.whyZh: 工作人員同意出借，並指定借用處、期限，以及不能用紙本投遞箱歸還。

questions.explanationZh: 工作人員同意出借，並指定借用處、期限，以及不能用紙本投遞箱歸還。
questions.evidence: I’ll ask her. The carrier is in my car, but it has a broken latch. Could I borrow one just for the ride home? | Yes. We lend carriers from the side counter. Return it here by Sunday; the outdoor drop box is only for paper forms.

vocabulary.note: 可用於短程運送小動物的容器。

questions.prompt: Which language is the returned handout in?
questions.promptZh: 送回的講義使用哪種語言？

options.text: Spanish
options.zh: 西班牙文
options.whyZh: 男方開頭說西班牙文講義已翻譯回來。

options.text: French
options.zh: 法文
options.whyZh: 沒有提到法文版本。

options.text: English
options.zh: 英文
options.whyZh: 對話是英文，但講義是西班牙文。

options.text: Japanese
options.zh: 日文
options.whyZh: 對話沒有提到日文。

questions.explanationZh: 男方開頭說西班牙文講義已翻譯回來。
questions.evidence: The Spanish handout is back from translation. The designer used the old draft, but only the contact number changed. The wording of the instructions is the same.

vocabulary.note: 提供給活動參與者的說明資料。

questions.prompt: Why does the woman skip another translation round?
questions.promptZh: 女方為什麼不再追加一輪翻譯？

options.text: The event has already taken place.
options.zh: 活動已經辦完。
options.whyZh: 活動日期甚至還沒公開確認。

options.text: The partner offices will translate it themselves.
options.zh: 合作辦公室會自行翻譯。
options.whyZh: 沒有說合作辦公室會翻譯講義。

options.text: The only revision is to the number, not the instructions.
options.zh: 只有電話號碼要改，操作說明沒變。
options.whyZh: 操作文字可沿用；換號碼後檢查版面即可，不必重譯。

options.text: The file has already been turned into an uneditable PDF.
options.zh: 檔案已轉成不能編輯的 PDF。
options.whyZh: 男方仍提到可編輯檔，而且是否重譯是看文字是否改變。

questions.explanationZh: 操作文字可沿用；換號碼後檢查版面即可，不必重譯。
questions.evidence: The Spanish handout is back from translation. The designer used the old draft, but only the contact number changed. The wording of the instructions is the same. | Then don’t send the layout back through translation. Ask the designer to replace the number, and send the updated page to me for a visual check.

vocabulary.note: 確認印製或輸出的文字、位置和顯示情形。

questions.prompt: The public notice confirms the event date before the layout check. Partners ask for the editable file today. What should they receive?
questions.promptZh: 公開公告先確認了活動日期，版面還沒檢查。合作辦公室今天要求可編輯檔，應該寄給他們什麼？

options.text: Send the editable layout now and the PDF once the notice is public.
options.zh: 先寄可編輯版面；公告公開後再寄 PDF。
options.whyZh: 可編輯檔不對外，且版面還沒通過檢查，不能只因公告已出就寄 PDF。

options.text: Send an update now, then send the PDF once the layout has also been checked.
options.zh: 先告知進度，等版面也檢查完，再寄 PDF。
options.whyZh: 公告先完成只滿足一項條件。可先通知進度，版面檢查及公告兩項都完成才提供 PDF。

options.text: Send the checked layout to partners for their approval before issuing a new notice.
options.zh: 把檢查後的版面寄給合作辦公室核准，再發新公告。
options.whyZh: 內部由女方檢查；不須合作辦公室核准，也不用重發公告。

options.text: Send the finished PDF as soon as the public notice appears, then check the layout.
options.zh: 公告一出就先寄完成版 PDF，之後才檢查版面。
options.whyZh: 輸出給合作辦公室的 PDF 前就要檢查版面。

questions.explanationZh: 公告先完成只滿足一項條件。可先通知進度，版面檢查及公告兩項都完成才提供 PDF。
questions.evidence: Then don’t send the layout back through translation. Ask the designer to replace the number, and send the updated page to me for a visual check. | Can I attach the editable file to the message for partner offices today? They want to prepare before Monday. | Don’t send the editable file. Export the partner PDF only after I’ve checked the layout. Hold it until the public notice has confirmed the date. Meanwhile, send the partners a short update on when to expect it.

vocabulary.note: 等某個前提成立後才寄出。

questions.prompt: What has the man lost?
questions.promptZh: 男方遺失了什麼？

options.text: The bicycle
options.zh: 自行車
options.whyZh: 他說車現在不在那裡，沒有說車遺失。

options.text: The rack key
options.zh: 自行車架的鑰匙
options.whyZh: 他明說鑰匙還在。

options.text: His flat number
options.zh: 他的公寓戶號
options.whyZh: 他忘的是哪一個車架，不是戶號。

options.text: The numbered tag
options.zh: 編號牌
options.whyZh: 編號牌從鑰匙圈掉了，鑰匙未遺失。

questions.explanationZh: 編號牌從鑰匙圈掉了，鑰匙未遺失。
questions.evidence: I still have my bike-rack key, but the number tag fell off my key ring. I don’t remember which rack is mine. The bicycle isn’t there now.

vocabulary.note: 標示停放架對應編號的小牌。

questions.prompt: What changes when a replacement is issued?
questions.promptZh: 補發之後，會改變的是什麼？

options.text: Both the rack and the lock
options.zh: 車架和鎖都會變
options.whyZh: 仍用原車架，也不換鎖。

options.text: The identifying number, but not the rack or lock
options.zh: 辨識編號會改，車架和鎖不變
options.whyZh: 新編號是發給同一架車位，鑰匙也可沿用。

options.text: The lock, but not the identifying number
options.zh: 鎖會換，但編號保留
options.whyZh: 規定不重用遺失的編號；鎖則不換。

options.text: The building office’s closing time
options.zh: 大樓辦公室的關門時間
options.whyZh: 辦公室照常六點關門。

questions.explanationZh: 新編號是發給同一架車位，鑰匙也可沿用。
questions.evidence: I can look up your flat number to find the rack. We don’t reuse lost tag numbers because a tag may still turn up. I’ll issue a new number for the same rack. | Keep your key. The lock stays the same. I’ll put the new number on the rack today and email it to you before we close at six. Collect a matching tag here another day.

vocabulary.note: 以新的物品或編號替代遺失的。

questions.prompt: How can the man find and use his rack when he returns tonight?
questions.promptZh: 男方今晚回來後如何找到並使用自己的車架？

options.text: Pick up the replacement tag after seven and have the lock opened from the office.
options.zh: 七點後去辦公室領補發牌，再請人開鎖。
options.whyZh: 辦公室六點關門，而且他有可用鑰匙。

options.text: Search for the old tag number and use a new key from the office.
options.zh: 找舊編號，再用辦公室的新鑰匙。
options.whyZh: 舊編號不重用，鑰匙也不用換。

options.text: Check the new number in his email and unlock the rack with his current key.
options.zh: 查看電子郵件中的新編號，再用原鑰匙開鎖。
options.whyZh: 七點後無法到辦公室，但可先收新編號；鎖不換，原鑰匙仍可用。

options.text: Wait until he can collect the physical tag before using the rack.
options.zh: 等可以領到實體牌後才能用車架。
options.whyZh: 她先把新編號寄來，原鑰匙可開鎖，不必等實體牌。

questions.explanationZh: 七點後無法到辦公室，但可先收新編號；鎖不換，原鑰匙仍可用。
questions.evidence: Do I need a different key, then? I’m coming back by bike after seven tonight. | Keep your key. The lock stays the same. I’ll put the new number on the rack today and email it to you before we close at six. Collect a matching tag here another day.

vocabulary.note: 可以拿在手上的牌，與電子郵件中的編號不同。

questions.prompt: Where will visitors look during the first demonstration?
questions.promptZh: 第一次示範時，訪客會看向哪裡？

options.text: At the first stars
options.zh: 第一批出現的星星
options.whyZh: 第一批星星出現後才移到大望遠鏡，不是首次示範的目標。

options.text: At the upper platform
options.zh: 上層平台
options.whyZh: 平台是稍後使用大望遠鏡的地點，不是現在要看的物體。

options.text: At the clock tower
options.zh: 鐘樓
options.whyZh: 講者明說先用小望遠鏡觀察鐘樓。

options.text: At the observatory stairs
options.zh: 天文台的樓梯
options.whyZh: 樓梯只是通行處，並未用來示範對焦。

questions.evidence: You'll be looking at the clock tower, not at the sky.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 講者明說先用小望遠鏡觀察鐘樓。

questions.prompt: Which sequence should visitors expect during the demonstrations?
questions.promptZh: 訪客在兩次示範中應會經歷什麼樣的順序？

options.text: Practise focusing with the small telescope in daylight, then move upstairs once stars can be seen.
options.zh: 天亮時先用小望遠鏡練習對焦，等看得見星星再上樓。
options.whyZh: 白天先用小望遠鏡練對焦；第一批星星可看見後才到上層平台。

options.text: Practise focusing with the large telescope in daylight, then use the small one once stars can be seen.
options.zh: 天亮時先用大望遠鏡練對焦，等看得見星星再改用小望遠鏡。
options.whyZh: 兩階段使用的望遠鏡顛倒；先小後大。

options.text: Wait for the stars before practising with either telescope, then go upstairs.
options.zh: 等星星出現後才用望遠鏡練對焦，然後上樓。
options.whyZh: 第一階段在天還亮時就會開始，不用等到看得到星星。

options.text: Start with the small telescope during daylight, then move to the large one while the sky is still too bright to see stars.
options.zh: 天亮時先用小望遠鏡，然後趁天空還亮到看不見星星時改用大望遠鏡。
options.whyZh: 先用小望遠鏡沒錯，但換到大望遠鏡要等看得見星星。

questions.evidence: While there is still daylight, we'll use the small telescope to show you how to bring a distant object into focus. You'll be looking at the clock tower, not at the sky. Once the first stars are visible, we'll move to the large telescope on the upper platform.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 白天先用小望遠鏡練對焦；第一批星星可看見後才到上層平台。

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker point out the marked spot?
questions.promptZh: 講者為什麼特別提到標示的位置？

options.text: To designate the place where the small telescope will be installed
options.zh: 為小望遠鏡指定架設地點
options.whyZh: 標示的位置讓訪客停留拍照，不是小望遠鏡的架設點。

options.text: To tell people where to wait for a camera
options.zh: 告訴大家在哪裡等候拿相機
options.whyZh: 並沒有相機發放或等候安排。

options.text: To ensure nobody looks at the tower from above
options.zh: 確保沒有人從高處看鐘樓
options.whyZh: 講者限制的是在樓梯上停下拍照，不是禁止從高處看鐘樓。

options.text: To keep the stairs clear while visitors take pictures
options.zh: 讓訪客拍照時仍保持樓梯暢通
options.whyZh: 在上方的標示處停下，可以避免擋住後面的人。

questions.evidence: There's a marked spot at the top where you can stop without blocking people behind you.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 在上方的標示處停下，可以避免擋住後面的人。

questions.prompt: Where was the meter placed last week?
questions.promptZh: 上週的儀器放在哪裡？

options.text: Under the bottom shelf
options.zh: 最低一層的下方
options.whyZh: 講話沒有說上週在下層測量。

options.text: On the handle of the cart
options.zh: 推車的把手上
options.whyZh: 講者明確說上週從推車把手取讀值。

options.text: Inside a glass jar
options.zh: 玻璃罐裡面
options.whyZh: 今天是放在通常擺罐子的位置，不是放進任何罐子，也不是上週的做法。

options.text: At the end of the aisle
options.zh: 走道的盡頭
options.whyZh: 平常的走道是推車的測試路線，不是上週儀器的架設位置。

questions.evidence: Last week's readings were taken on the handle

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 講者明確說上週從推車把手取讀值。

questions.prompt: What is the main reason for the new meter location?
questions.promptZh: 為什麼主要要變更儀器的放置位置？

options.text: To stop the jars from sliding off the cart
options.zh: 防止罐子從推車滑下來
options.whyZh: 改放量測儀器是為了測數值，不是用它固定罐子。

options.text: To leave enough space for workers to wrap the jars
options.zh: 給作業人員留足包裝罐子的空間
options.whyZh: 測試會在包裝前做，並沒有因包裝空間而移動儀器。

options.text: To measure the movement that the jars would experience
options.zh: 量到罐子實際可能受到的晃動
options.whyZh: 把儀器從把手移到罐子的實際位置，才能模擬罐子所受的震動。

options.text: To test how fast people push a loaded cart
options.zh: 測試工作人員推滿載推車的速度
options.whyZh: 講者指定步行速度，量的是震動，不是推車速度。

questions.evidence: Last week's readings were taken on the handle, which is convenient but doesn't tell us what the jars actually experience. For today's test, put the meter where the first jar would normally sit.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 把儀器從把手移到罐子的實際位置，才能模擬罐子所受的震動。

questions.prompt: Which result would best support the claim that the new lining reduces vibration?
questions.promptZh: 哪項結果最能支持新襯墊會減少震動的說法？

options.text: The new lining gives a lower reading on the top shelf than last week's reading on the handle.
options.zh: 新襯墊在最上層的讀值比上週在把手測的低。
options.whyZh: 量測位置變了，數值差異不能單獨歸因於襯墊。

options.text: The old lining gives a higher reading after the cart is pushed faster down the aisle.
options.zh: 用舊襯墊並加快推車後，讀值變高。
options.whyZh: 速度也改變了，無法把差異單獨歸因於襯墊。

options.text: Both kinds of lining give the same result at the first jar position.
options.zh: 兩種襯墊在第一個罐子的位置測出的結果相同。
options.whyZh: 相同結果不支持新襯墊有減震效果。

options.text: The new lining gives a lower reading than the old one on otherwise matching runs.
options.zh: 其他條件相同時，新襯墊的讀值比舊襯墊低。
options.whyZh: 位置、走道與速度都維持一致，僅改襯墊時，較低讀值才支持新襯墊減震。

questions.evidence: Push the cart down the usual aisle at walking speed. If the numbers are lower, that won't prove the new shelf lining works. We need another run with the old lining and the meter in the same place.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 位置、走道與速度都維持一致，僅改襯墊時，較低讀值才支持新襯墊減震。

questions.prompt: When is the repair show scheduled to begin?
questions.promptZh: 修繕節目預定什麼時候開始？

options.text: At noon
options.zh: 中午
options.whyZh: 講者明說修繕節目照常在中午開始。

options.text: Before the pledge drive finishes
options.zh: 募款節目結束前
options.whyZh: 募款節目要提早結束，好在修繕節目前完成交接。

options.text: Right after the first caller makes a donation
options.zh: 第一位來電者捐款後
options.whyZh: 修繕節目的開始時間不取決於有人捐款。

options.text: A few minutes later than usual
options.zh: 比平常晚幾分鐘
options.whyZh: 講者明說修繕節目照常，是募款節目提早幾分鐘結束。

questions.evidence: The Saturday repair show starts at noon, just as it usually does.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 講者明說修繕節目照常在中午開始。

questions.prompt: How does the producer plan to fit in an equipment check without changing the next programme's start time?
questions.promptZh: 製作人打算如何安排設備檢查，又不改變下一個節目的開始時間？

options.text: End the pledge drive at its usual time and check the microphone after the repair show starts.
options.zh: 募款節目照平常時間結束，等修繕節目開始後再試麥克風。
options.whyZh: 麥克風檢查要安排在兩個節目交接之間，募款節目會提早結束。

options.text: Keep the pledge drive on air and have the next host check her microphone during it.
options.zh: 募款節目繼續播出，讓接班主持人在節目進行中試麥克風。
options.whyZh: 講者要提早結束募款節目以空出試麥克風的時間，不是在募款節目中試。

options.text: Give the incoming host a few extra minutes by starting the repair show late.
options.zh: 將修繕節目延後幾分鐘開始，留時間給接班主持人。
options.whyZh: 要調整的是前一節目的結束時間，修繕節目仍準時在中午開始。

options.text: Finish the pledge drive early and use the gap for the incoming host to test her microphone.
options.zh: 提早結束募款節目，讓接班主持人利用空檔試麥克風。
options.whyZh: 前一節目提早結束，空檔用來試麥克風，讓下一節目準時開始。

questions.evidence: The Saturday repair show starts at noon, just as it usually does. We'll finish the pledge drive a few minutes early so the next host can check her microphone.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 前一節目提早結束，空檔用來試麥克風，讓下一節目準時開始。

questions.prompt: Which arrangement follows the producer's instructions for both the studio handover and the on-air thank-you?
questions.promptZh: 哪種安排同時符合製作人對錄音室交接和節目中致謝的指示？

options.text: Leave both the total and the tally sheets for the next host, who should read the total only.
options.zh: 把總額和統計表都留給下一位主持人，只請她念出總額。
options.whyZh: 只播總額沒有錯，但含電話號碼的統計表不能留在現場。

options.text: Leave the total where she can see it, remove the tally sheets, and use only the total in the message.
options.zh: 把總額留在她看得到的地方，帶走統計表，致謝時只念總額。
options.whyZh: 白板保留可公開的總額，帶走含個資的表單；主持人致謝時只公布總額。

options.text: Remove the tally sheets but copy callers' phone numbers onto the whiteboard with the total.
options.zh: 帶走統計表，但把來電者電話和總額一併抄到白板上。
options.whyZh: 應留下的只有總額；不能把統計表的來電者資料另抄到白板。

options.text: Erase the total and leave the tally sheets so the next host can thank each caller by name.
options.zh: 擦掉總額、留下統計表，讓下一位主持人逐一唱名致謝。
options.whyZh: 做法正好相反：總額需留下，統計表須帶走，也不能念出來電者資料。

questions.evidence: Please leave the donation total on the whiteboard. Take your tally sheets with you. They contain phone numbers from people who called the station. If the next host wants to thank listeners, she can read the total on air. Do not read out the names, phone numbers, or other personal details of people who called.

vocabulary.note: 依本題短講的情境理解。

questions.explanationZh: 白板保留可公開的總額，帶走含個資的表單；主持人致謝時只公布總額。

questions.prompt: Where should the cleaners get the blue pads?
questions.promptZh: 清潔人員應到哪裡拿藍色清潔墊？

options.text: From a cabinet beside the visitor entrance
options.zh: 遊客入口旁的櫃子
options.whyZh: 這裡沒有提到遊客入口儲放清潔墊。

options.text: From the cabinet next to the service lift
options.zh: 勤務電梯旁的櫃子
options.whyZh: 講者直接指定勤務電梯旁的櫃子。

options.text: From the tank team’s workroom
options.zh: 水槽維護小組的工作室
options.whyZh: 水槽維護小組負責處理靠水側的痕跡，不是藍色清潔墊的領取點。

options.text: From a shelf beneath the viewing panels
options.zh: 觀景板下方的置物架
options.whyZh: 講者說到櫃子領取，而不是從觀景板下方拿。

questions.evidence: Pick up the blue pads from the cabinet beside the service lift.
questions.explanationZh: 講者直接指定勤務電梯旁的櫃子。
questions.difficultyRationale: One explicit pickup location.

vocabulary.note: service lift 在此是後勤設施的位置地標，不是訪客側的設備。

questions.prompt: Why should staff not use the same pads they use on the glass?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員為什麼不應使用原本清潔玻璃的清潔墊？

options.text: The tank team needs all of the white pads today.
options.zh: 水槽維護小組今天需要用到所有白色清潔墊。
options.whyZh: 沒有提到其他小組要用白色墊，限制是材質不同。

options.text: The white pads are intended only for the water side.
options.zh: 白色清潔墊只供靠水側使用。
options.whyZh: 白色墊是清潔玻璃用的，不是靠水側專用。

options.text: The blue pads are the only ones that can clean the water side.
options.zh: 只有藍色清潔墊可以清理靠水的一側。
options.whyZh: 清潔人員只擦遊客側；講者沒說藍色墊是靠水側專用。

options.text: The new panels are a different material that the glass pads may mark.
options.zh: 新觀景板材質不同，玻璃用的墊可能留下痕跡。
options.whyZh: 新板看似玻璃但其實是壓克力，玻璃用的白色墊可能在上面留下痕跡。

questions.evidence: The new viewing panels look like glass, but they're acrylic. | The white pads we use on glass can leave marks on acrylic.
questions.explanationZh: 新板看似玻璃但其實是壓克力，玻璃用的白色墊可能在上面留下痕跡。
questions.difficultyRationale: Connect deceptive appearance to differing pad suitability.

vocabulary.note: 即使兩種板材外觀看似相同，清潔耗材也不能直接通用。

questions.prompt: A cleaner finds that a stubborn mark is on the water side. What should the cleaner do?
questions.promptZh: 清潔員發現擦不掉的痕跡在靠水的一側。應該怎麼做？

options.text: Send the panel number to the tank team.
options.zh: 將觀景板編號交給水槽維護小組。
options.whyZh: 靠水側的痕跡應記錄板號，請水槽維護小組處理，不要重擦。

options.text: Add a photo to the visitor-side cleaning log instead.
options.zh: 改把照片附在遊客側的清潔紀錄中。
options.whyZh: 拍照附在紀錄中這個做法，適用於確認在遊客側且擦不掉的痕跡。

options.text: Wipe the same spot again with a white pad.
options.zh: 用白色清潔墊重擦同一處。
options.whyZh: 靠水側痕跡不能靠重擦遊客側去除，也不應用玻璃用的白色墊。

options.text: Polish the visitor side and ask the tank team to inspect it later.
options.zh: 先將遊客側拋光，再請水槽維護小組稍後檢查。
options.whyZh: 清潔員不可自行拋光，靠水側的痕跡直接按板號交給水槽維護小組。

questions.evidence: If a mark remains, check whether it's on the water side. If it is, record its panel number for the tank team rather than cleaning the same spot again. If a mark is definitely on the visitor side and doesn't wipe off, add a photo to the cleaning log.
questions.explanationZh: 靠水側的痕跡應記錄板號，請水槽維護小組處理，不要重擦。
questions.difficultyRationale: Apply two different follow-up routes by surface rather than by how hard the mark is to remove.

vocabulary.note: 記下面板編號，讓水族展示槽的維護小組知道是哪一面，而不是請清潔員重擦。

questions.prompt: Which meter should staff read?
questions.promptZh: 員工應該讀取哪一個電表？

options.text: The building meter in the lobby
options.zh: 大廳的大樓總電表
options.whyZh: 講者明確說不要使用大廳的大樓總電表。

options.text: A meter on the machine control panel
options.zh: 機器控制面板上的電表
options.whyZh: 調查讀的是工作間電表，不是機台面板。

options.text: The small meter beside the workshop door
options.zh: 工作間門旁的小電表
options.whyZh: 講者直接指定工作間門旁的小電表。

options.text: The meter beside the staff entrance
options.zh: 員工入口旁的電表
options.whyZh: 指定的是工作間的門，沒有提到員工入口。

questions.evidence: Read the small meter beside the workshop door, not the building meter in the lobby.
questions.explanationZh: 講者直接指定工作間門旁的小電表。
questions.difficultyRationale: Direct instruction plus explicit foil.

vocabulary.note: beside 表示在旁邊；兩具電表的地點不同。

questions.prompt: Why should a worker take the reading at six on Friday even if a machine is running overtime?
questions.promptZh: 星期五有機器還在加班運轉時，為什麼仍應在傍晚六點讀表？

options.text: It avoids having to record the overtime job.
options.zh: 這樣就不用記錄加班工作。
options.whyZh: 讀表仍須記錄加班工作；兩者用途不同。

options.text: It keeps the measurements comparable across workshops.
options.zh: 這樣各工作間的讀數才有共同的比較基準。
options.whyZh: 固定時間可作為各工作間的共同基準；如讀數偏離平常，可再查看加班註記。

options.text: It captures only the electricity used by the overtime machine.
options.zh: 這樣只會記錄這台加班機器的用電。
options.whyZh: 指定的是工作間電表，而不是單台機器。

options.text: It allows staff to skip the Monday reading.
options.zh: 這樣星期一就不用再讀表。
options.whyZh: 星期一仍須讀第二次，沒有因星期五加班而取消。

questions.evidence: Take the six o'clock reading anyway, and mark the job on the sheet. A fixed time lets us compare workshops; the job note explains an unusual reading.
questions.explanationZh: 固定時間可作為各工作間的共同基準；如讀數偏離平常，可再查看加班註記。
questions.difficultyRationale: Connect the fixed time to comparability rather than the separate purpose of the note.

vocabulary.note: 固定時間取基準值，方便之後比較；不是說異常工況可以不記。

questions.prompt: A scheduled overtime job kept one machine running past six on Friday, and another machine started before the Monday reading. Which record should staff submit?
questions.promptZh: 有一台機器因排定的加班工作在星期五運轉超過六點，另一台在星期一讀表前就已啟動。員工應送出哪一種紀錄？

options.text: Friday’s reading after the overtime job; Monday’s reading and start time, with no total.
options.zh: 星期五加班工作完成後的讀數；星期一讀數及啟動時間，不填總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期一處理正確，但星期五仍應在六點讀表，不能等加班工作結束。

options.text: Friday’s six o’clock reading and job note; Monday’s reading and the unadjusted weekend total.
options.zh: 星期五六點讀數與工作註記；星期一讀數及未調整的週末總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期五處理正確，但星期一必須註記啟動時間且總用電留白。

options.text: Friday’s six o’clock reading without a job note; Monday’s reading and start time, with no total.
options.zh: 星期五六點讀數，不註記工作；星期一讀數及啟動時間，不填總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期一處理正確，但星期五還需註記正在進行的加班工作。

options.text: Friday’s six o’clock reading and job note; Monday’s reading and start time, with no total.
options.zh: 星期五六點讀數與工作註記；星期一讀數及啟動時間，不填總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期五按時讀表並註記加班；星期一記下讀數和啟動時間，把週末總用電留白。

questions.evidence: Take the six o'clock reading anyway, and mark the job on the sheet. | If a machine has already started, record the meter reading and the machine's start time. In that case, leave the weekend-total box empty
questions.explanationZh: 星期五按時讀表並註記加班；星期一記下讀數和啟動時間，把週末總用電留白。
questions.difficultyRationale: Combine two distinct contingency branches; every distractor satisfies one complete branch but fails the other.

vocabulary.note: figure 在此是數值；和直接相減得到的未調整讀值不同。

questions.prompt: Where will volunteers first meet?
questions.promptZh: 志工最初在哪裡集合？

options.text: At the hall’s side door
options.zh: 活動中心側門
options.whyZh: 講者直接說十點在側門集合。

options.text: In the yard
options.zh: 院子
options.whyZh: 院子是裝載的地點，不是集合點。

options.text: At the welcome desk
options.zh: 接待櫃檯
options.whyZh: 櫃檯可領取預約的寫字板，不是集合點。

options.text: Beside the donation boxes
options.zh: 捐贈箱旁
options.whyZh: 捐贈箱用於整理玩具，沒有指定在這裡集合。

questions.evidence: Meet at the side entrance of the community hall at ten.
questions.explanationZh: 講者直接說十點在側門集合。
questions.difficultyRationale: One explicitly stated assembly location.

vocabulary.note: 同棟建築可能有多個入口，集合點不能只記建築名稱。

questions.prompt: A volunteer on the clipboard waiting list arrives at ten ten without a clipboard. What should they expect?
questions.promptZh: 一名排在寫字板候補名單上的志工十點十分抵達，沒帶寫字板。他可以期待什麼？

options.text: They can collect any booked clipboard as soon as they arrive.
options.zh: 一抵達就可以領走任何預約的寫字板。
options.whyZh: 預約的寫字板會保留到十點十五分。

options.text: They must bring their own clipboard because none are lent to people on the waiting list.
options.zh: 候補者借不到寫字板，必須自行準備。
options.whyZh: 候補者有機會領到預約逾時未領的寫字板。

options.text: They may receive a clipboard after ten fifteen if a booked one goes unclaimed.
options.zh: 十點十五分後若有預約未領的寫字板，就有機會領到。
options.whyZh: 候補者要等領取期限過後，而且是否領到取決於有無未領的寫字板。

options.text: They will receive a clipboard from the yard as soon as it stops raining.
options.zh: 雨停後就一定能在院子裡領到寫字板。
options.whyZh: 寫字板在接待櫃檯發放，且候補取決於未領數量，不是天氣。

questions.evidence: If you booked a clipboard, pick it up at the welcome desk by ten fifteen. After that, we'll give unclaimed clipboards to volunteers on the waiting list.
questions.explanationZh: 候補者要等領取期限過後，而且是否領到取決於有無未領的寫字板。
questions.difficultyRationale: Apply the pickup priority and cutoff to a waiting-list arrival before the deadline; distinct from the late-arrival own-clipboard case.

vocabulary.note: 指已預訂但未被領走的物品，不是原本就沒有預訂。

questions.prompt: An adult and an eleven-year-old arrive at ten twenty during rain. They booked a clipboard but have also brought their own. What can they do together?
questions.promptZh: 一名成人帶著十一歲孩子在下雨時於十點二十分抵達。他們原本預約了寫字板，也自行帶了一個。他們可以一起做什麼？

options.text: Sort indoors and count on receiving the booked clipboard.
options.zh: 在室內分類，並一定能領到原先預約的寫字板。
options.whyZh: 室內照常，但預約只保留至十點十五分，不能保證仍可領取。

options.text: Sort indoors using the clipboard they brought.
options.zh: 用自備的寫字板在室內分類。
options.whyZh: 室內活動不受下雨影響，孩子可由成人陪同；逾時也可用自備寫字板加入。

options.text: Wait for the rain to stop, then load boxes together in the yard.
options.zh: 等雨停，再一起到院子裝載箱子。
options.whyZh: 孩子未滿十二歲，不可參與院子裝載，即使雨停也不能一起裝。

options.text: Collect toys outdoors while waiting for the indoor sorting to resume.
options.zh: 在戶外收玩具，等室內分類重新開始。
options.whyZh: 下雨時停止的是院子裝載，室內分類沒有中斷。

questions.evidence: Younger volunteers can sort toys indoors with an adult. | If it rains, we'll stop loading in the yard, but the indoor sorting will continue. | If you booked a clipboard, pick it up at the welcome desk by ten fifteen. | If you arrive late, you can still join the sorting with a clipboard you bring.
questions.explanationZh: 室內活動不受下雨影響，孩子可由成人陪同；逾時也可用自備寫字板加入。
questions.difficultyRationale: Combine supervision/age, unaffected indoor venue, cutoff and own-clipboard exception.

vocabulary.note: 此處指在室內按類別分揀玩具，不是到院子搬運箱子。

questions.prompt: Where should staff collect a sound meter?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員應該在哪裡領取音量計？

options.text: At the office
options.zh: 辦公室
options.whyZh: 辦公室不是音量計的領取地點，也不是歸還地點。

options.text: At their assigned corner
options.zh: 指定的街角
options.whyZh: 街角已有支架，但音量計要另外領取。

options.text: At the nearest bus stop
options.zh: 最近的公車站
options.whyZh: 公車只是可能影響讀數的事件，不是領取點。

options.text: From the council van
options.zh: 市議會的廂型車
options.whyZh: 講者開頭直接指定到廂型車領取。

questions.evidence: Collect a sound meter from the council van.
questions.explanationZh: 講者開頭直接指定到廂型車領取。
questions.difficultyRationale: Explicit pickup location.

vocabulary.note: council 在此指地方政府／議會；van 是廂型車。

questions.prompt: Why should staff note when an idling bus arrives and leaves?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員為什麼要記下怠速公車抵達與離開的時間？

options.text: To decide when to move the equipment
options.zh: 決定什麼時候搬動設備
options.whyZh: 有公車怠速時應記錄時段，沒有要求搬設備。

options.text: To help separate unusual noise from ordinary background noise
options.zh: 協助區分特殊噪音和一般背景噪音
options.whyZh: 保留讀數並加註事件時段，才能分析特殊事件對背景讀數的影響。

options.text: To check whether the bus was late
options.zh: 確認公車是否誤點
options.whyZh: 記錄是為了解釋噪音，不是核對班表。

options.text: To replace the regular ten-minute measurement
options.zh: 取代原本的十分鐘量測
options.whyZh: 仍須連續量測滿十分鐘，不能用事件註記取代。

questions.evidence: Write down when it arrived and left instead of deleting the reading. We need to distinguish an unusual event from the background level.
questions.explanationZh: 保留讀數並加註事件時段，才能分析特殊事件對背景讀數的影響。
questions.difficultyRationale: Paraphrase rationale distinct from retaining raw record and duration.

vocabulary.note: 車輛沒行駛，仍可能因引擎運轉製造額外噪音。

questions.prompt: A pavement closure blocks access to an assigned corner. Which plan follows the survey instructions?
questions.promptZh: 人行道封閉，工作人員到不了指定街角。哪一種做法符合調查指示？

options.text: Call the coordinator first. If the coordinator approves another corner, note both sites before measuring.
options.zh: 先聯絡調查協調人員。若獲准換地點，應在量測前記下原地點和替代地點。
options.whyZh: 應先聯絡並取得同意，開始量測前要把兩個地點都寫在表單上。

options.text: Call first, but record only the new corner if the coordinator approves it.
options.zh: 先聯絡；如果獲准改用替代地點，就只記下新地點。
options.whyZh: 先聯絡正確，但獲准時須記下兩個地點，不能只記替代地點。

options.text: Start at another corner, note both sites, and call the coordinator after the survey.
options.zh: 先到另一個街角量測並記下兩個地點，調查結束後再聯絡。
options.whyZh: 兩個地點都應記下，但必須先聯絡並獲准，不能先量測。

options.text: Take the meter to the office and leave the location blank.
options.zh: 把音量計帶到辦公室，地點欄留白。
options.whyZh: 指定的替代程序是聯絡協調人員，在獲准後記下兩個地點。

questions.evidence: If you can't reach your assigned corner because a pavement is closed, call me before choosing another place. If I approve a different corner, write both sites on the sheet before you start, so we can keep their readings separate.
questions.explanationZh: 應先聯絡並取得同意，開始量測前要把兩個地點都寫在表單上。
questions.difficultyRationale: Combine approval-before-moving and recording both locations before measurement; B/C satisfy different steps but not the sequence.

vocabulary.note: assigned 指事先分配給某人的地點；改點不是任意另找一處。

questions.prompt: What must staff upload to claim a monthly bus pass?
questions.promptZh: 申請公車月票補助須上傳什麼？

options.text: A parking voucher
options.zh: 停車券
options.whyZh: 停車是另一項申請，不能用停車券申請月票補助。

options.text: A copy of their pay statement
options.zh: 薪資單影本
options.whyZh: 薪資是入帳方式，不是申請附件。

options.text: The receipt for the pass
options.zh: 月票收據
options.whyZh: 講者說要把月票收據上傳到入口網站。

options.text: Their office travel schedule
options.zh: 辦公室通勤時程表
options.whyZh: 講者沒有要求上傳通勤時程表。

questions.evidence: Claim a monthly bus pass by uploading the receipt to the benefits portal.
questions.explanationZh: 講者說要把月票收據上傳到入口網站。
questions.difficultyRationale: Explicit document.

vocabulary.note: allowance 是特定用途的津貼；申報方式仍要看所需憑證。

questions.prompt: When will a bus-pass claim submitted on Saturday appear in pay?
questions.promptZh: 星期六送出的公車月票補助申請，會在哪個月的薪資入帳？

options.text: In this month’s pay without any further action
options.zh: 不必另做處理，會在本月薪資入帳
options.whyZh: 星期五之後才送出，不能列入本月薪資。

options.text: In this month’s pay if the pass covers Saturday
options.zh: 若月票星期六有效，就會列入本月薪資
options.whyZh: 決定入帳月份的是申請日，不是月票有效日。

options.text: Only after a parking request is approved
options.zh: 停車補助申請核准後才入帳
options.whyZh: 兩項申請需分開，未說月票要等停車申請。

options.text: In next month’s pay
options.zh: 下個月的薪資
options.whyZh: 星期六晚於星期五的截止日，應列入下個月薪資。

questions.evidence: Claims submitted by Friday will appear in this month's pay; later claims will go into next month's pay.
questions.explanationZh: 星期六晚於星期五的截止日，應列入下個月薪資。
questions.difficultyRationale: Apply an inclusive payroll cutoff to a weekday not spoken.

vocabulary.zh: 最遲於星期五提交的申請
vocabulary.note: by + 截止時間通常含該時點；逾期則進入不同處理週期。

questions.prompt: A worker will submit a bus-pass claim on Saturday. On Wednesday she drove to the satellite office and did not use her pass. What can she do?
questions.promptZh: 一名員工打算星期六送出公車月票補助申請。星期三她開車到分部，當天沒用月票。她可以怎麼做？

options.text: Include both expenses in one request to receive both in this month’s pay.
options.zh: 把兩項費用併在一份申請，讓兩筆都在本月薪資入帳。
options.whyZh: 月票申請已過星期五，且兩項申請必須分開。

options.text: Expect the pass reimbursement next month and request a parking voucher separately for Wednesday.
options.zh: 等下個月領月票補助，並另外申請星期三的停車券。
options.whyZh: 月票申請晚於截止日；星期三未使用月票，可另申請當天停車券。

options.text: Expect the pass reimbursement next month but give up the parking voucher because her pass covered Wednesday.
options.zh: 下個月領月票補助，但月票星期三有效，不能申請停車券。
options.whyZh: 月票有效不等於當天使用；實際未使用就不排除星期三的停車券。

options.text: Request the Wednesday parking voucher separately and expect the Saturday pass claim in this month’s pay.
options.zh: 另外申請星期三的停車券，並等星期六的月票申請在本月薪資入帳。
options.whyZh: 停車處理正確，但星期六的月票申請要下個月才入帳。

questions.evidence: Later claims will go into next month's pay. | You can still claim parking on a day you drove instead, provided you did not travel on the pass that day. | Keep the two requests separate.
questions.explanationZh: 月票申請晚於截止日；星期三未使用月票，可另申請當天停車券。
questions.difficultyRationale: Integrate cutoff, actual vs covered usage, and separate workflow. Two near-miss answers satisfy one branch.

vocabulary.term: provided you did not travel on the pass
vocabulary.zh: 前提是你當天沒有用該票搭車
vocabulary.note: provided 表示條件；持有涵蓋當天的票和當天實際用票不同。

questions.prompt: Why does the venue require matte fabric?
questions.promptZh: 場地方為什麼要求用霧面布？

options.text: The lights will point directly at it.
options.zh: 燈光會直接照在布上。
options.whyZh: 講者說燈光會直接照射，因此場地方要求使用霧面。

options.text: The fabric will hang outdoors.
options.zh: 布料會掛在戶外。
options.whyZh: 沒有提到戶外使用。

options.text: The supplier charges less for it.
options.zh: 供應商對霧面布收費較低。
options.whyZh: 要求霧面是場地的照明考量，不是價格問題。

options.text: It can be made from two pieces.
options.zh: 霧面布可以用兩塊拼成。
options.whyZh: 講者要求用一整塊，不可拼接。

questions.evidence: The venue requires matte fabric because the lights will shine straight at it.
questions.explanationZh: 講者說燈光會直接照射，因此場地方要求使用霧面。
questions.difficultyRationale: Explicit cause.

vocabulary.note: matte 指表面不亮、不易反光，適合直射燈光的情境。

questions.prompt: Look at the chart. Which backdrop should the listener select?
questions.promptZh: 看表格。聽眾應該選哪一款背景布？

options.text: Alder
options.zh: Alder
options.whyZh: Alder 是霧面且在預算內，但寬度不到三公尺。

options.text: Birch
options.zh: Birch
options.whyZh: Birch 寬度足夠也在預算內，但表面有光澤，不符合場地要求。

options.text: Cedar
options.zh: Cedar
options.whyZh: Cedar 寬度足夠且是霧面，但超出八十元預算。

options.text: Elm
options.zh: Elm
options.whyZh: Elm 是霧面、至少三公尺寬，且不超過八十元。

questions.evidence: A single piece at least three metres wide. | The venue requires matte fabric. | We can spend up to eighty dollars. | Chart rows: Alder 2.8 m/Matte/68; Birch 3.2 m/Gloss/75; Cedar 3.6 m/Matte/86; Elm 3.0 m/Matte/80.
questions.explanationZh: Elm 是霧面、至少三公尺寬，且不超過八十元。
questions.difficultyRationale: Integrate spoken minima, finish and inclusive budget with chart; each distractor violates exactly one.

vocabulary.note: 規格及預算符合後，仍要確認現貨狀態。

questions.prompt: Which plan follows the payment rules and qualifies for regular delivery at no extra charge?
questions.promptZh: 哪一種安排符合付款規定，又能用不另收費的例行配送？

options.text: Fill out the form and pay now so the supplier can deliver on time.
options.zh: 現在填表並付款，讓供應商能準時送達。
options.whyZh: 可先填表，但地址尚未確認，現在不得付款。

options.text: Wait for address confirmation, then place the order on Thursday afternoon.
options.zh: 等地址確認後，在星期四下午下單。
options.whyZh: 等地址確認正確，但星期四下午已過中午的例行配送截止時間。

options.text: Prepare the form now, pay after address confirmation, and order by noon on Thursday.
options.zh: 現在先填表，確認地址後再付款，最晚星期四中午下單。
options.whyZh: 可先備好訂單，付款須等地址確認，而且要在星期四中午截止前完成下單。

options.text: Pay by Thursday noon, then confirm the address after placing the order.
options.zh: 最晚星期四中午先付款，下單後才確認地址。
options.whyZh: 守住下單期限不代表可先付款；地址確認必須在付款之前。

questions.evidence: Put the backdrop on the order form now, but don't pay until the venue coordinator confirms the delivery address. She expects to confirm it on Wednesday. If we order by noon on Thursday, the supplier can send it with the regular delivery at no extra charge.
questions.explanationZh: 可先備好訂單，付款須等地址確認，而且要在星期四中午截止前完成下單。
questions.difficultyRationale: Apply payment prerequisite and free-delivery ordering deadline; two near misses each satisfy one.

vocabulary.note: 填表、確認地址及付款是不同步驟，先後順序可能受限制。

questions.prompt: Where has the shoe exchange moved?
questions.promptZh: 換鞋處搬到哪裡？

options.text: To the scoring desk
options.zh: 計分櫃檯
options.whyZh: 計分櫃檯是辦理報到的地方。

options.text: Beside lane six
options.zh: 六號球道旁
options.whyZh: 講者直接說換鞋處已搬到六號球道旁。

options.text: To the old counter
options.zh: 舊櫃檯
options.whyZh: 舊櫃檯改作處理計分表。

options.text: Outside the tournament entrance
options.zh: 比賽入口外
options.whyZh: 講者沒有提到入口外。

questions.evidence: We've moved the shoe exchange next to lane six.
questions.explanationZh: 講者直接說換鞋處已搬到六號球道旁。
questions.difficultyRationale: Direct new location vs old.

vocabulary.note: exchange 在場館指領取或更換鞋具的櫃位，不是換匯。

questions.prompt: What can an early player do while waiting for a late partner?
questions.promptZh: 先抵達的選手等遲到的搭檔時，可以做什麼？

options.text: Start the first tournament game alone.
options.zh: 自己先開始第一場正式比賽。
options.whyZh: 正式比賽要等雙方到齊。

options.text: Check in for both players without notifying anyone.
options.zh: 不用通知任何人，代兩名選手報到。
options.whyZh: 搭檔遲到時應一抵達就告知櫃檯。

options.text: Tell the desk and practise on a free lane.
options.zh: 告知櫃檯，並在空球道練習。
options.whyZh: 先通知櫃檯，再於有空位的球道練習，不算正式比賽。

options.text: Wait at the old counter until their partner arrives.
options.zh: 在舊櫃檯等搭檔抵達。
options.whyZh: 舊櫃檯現用於處理計分表，不是等候指示。

questions.evidence: If your partner is late, tell the desk as soon as you arrive. You can practise on a free lane while you wait, but your first tournament game won't start without both players.
questions.explanationZh: 先通知櫃檯，再於有空位的球道練習，不算正式比賽。
questions.difficultyRationale: Differentiate allowed practice (plus immediate notification) from scored play.

vocabulary.note: free 在此指有空、未使用，不一定指免費。

questions.prompt: Who can receive a shoe-rental refund?
questions.promptZh: 誰可以拿到租鞋退款？

options.text: A player who booked rental shoes before the first game
options.zh: 第一場比賽前就租鞋的選手
options.whyZh: 開賽前租鞋不予退款。

options.text: A player whose own shoes were damaged during practice and who rented shoes before the first game
options.zh: 練習時自備鞋損壞，在第一場正式比賽前租鞋的選手
options.whyZh: 自備鞋在正式比賽中損壞才符合退款條件，練習時損壞不算。

options.text: A player who changed shoe sizes before the tournament
options.zh: 賽前更換租鞋尺寸的選手
options.whyZh: 更換尺寸不是退費條件，開賽前的租鞋也不退費。

options.text: A player who rented centre shoes after damaging their own pair during a tournament game
options.zh: 自備球鞋在正式比賽中損壞後，改租球館球鞋的選手
options.whyZh: 這種因比賽中損壞而臨時租鞋才符合退款條件，講者也提醒保留收據。

questions.evidence: The desk will refund the rental charge if your own shoes are damaged during a tournament game and you rent shoes from the centre. Shoes rented before your first tournament game, including rentals for practice, are not refundable.
questions.explanationZh: 這種因比賽中損壞而臨時租鞋才符合退款條件，講者也提醒保留收據。
questions.difficultyRationale: Separate normal pre-play rental from one during-game exception.

vocabulary.note: refundable 指符合特定條件可退費；光有收據不代表一定符合。

questions.prompt: Bring your library card when you ___ a book from the self-service shelf.
questions.promptZh: 從自助書架___書籍時，請帶著借書證。

options.text: borrowed
options.zh: 借了
options.whyZh: when 子句說明一般借閱情況，不是已完成的過去事件。

options.text: borrow
options.zh: 借閱
options.whyZh: 一般情況用現在式，主詞 you 搭配 borrow。

options.text: borrowing
options.zh: 借閱中
options.whyZh: 主詞 you 後需要動詞；borrowing 前沒有助動詞。

options.text: borrows
options.zh: 借閱（第三人稱）
options.whyZh: 主詞是 you，不用第三人稱單數的 -s。

questions.explanationZh: 一般情況用現在式，主詞 you 搭配 borrow。
questions.evidence: Bring your library card when you borrow a book from the self-service shelf.

vocabulary.note: 不需由館員代為操作。

questions.prompt: The library can renew a book ___ no other reader has placed a hold on it. If there is a hold, you must return the book.
questions.promptZh: ___沒有其他讀者預約，圖書館就可以讓你續借這本書。如果有人預約，就必須歸還。

options.text: even though
options.zh: 即使／儘管
options.whyZh: 表示讓步，不會把沒有預約設為續借條件。

options.text: as if
options.zh: 彷彿
options.whyZh: 表示看起來似乎如此，不是館方的續借條件。

options.text: unless
options.zh: 除非
options.whyZh: 搭配 no other reader 會變成沒有其他人預約時反而不能續借。

options.text: provided that
options.zh: 只要
options.whyZh: 表示條件：沒有其他讀者預約，就可以續借。

questions.explanationZh: 表示條件：沒有其他讀者預約，就可以續借。
questions.evidence: The library can renew a book provided that no other reader has placed a hold on it. If there is a hold, you must return the book.

vocabulary.note: 登記等候某本書，好在歸還後取得。

questions.prompt: The building manager posted a ___ notice beside the intercom.
questions.promptZh: 大樓管理員在對講機旁張貼了___通知。

options.text: temporary
options.zh: 臨時的
options.whyZh: 形容詞 temporary 修飾名詞 notice。

options.text: temporarily
options.zh: 暫時地
options.whyZh: 副詞不能直接修飾此處的名詞 notice。

options.text: temporariness
options.zh: 短暫性
options.whyZh: 抽象名詞指短暫性，不能自然地表示臨時公告。

options.text: temporal
options.zh: 時間上的
options.whyZh: 指與時間相關，不是此處的臨時公告。

questions.explanationZh: 形容詞 temporary 修飾名詞 notice。
questions.evidence: The building manager posted a temporary notice beside the intercom.

vocabulary.note: 用於大樓內外通話。

questions.prompt: Residents on every floor received the same alert, but only those on the top floor were ___ by the rooftop tank repair.
questions.promptZh: 每層住戶都收到同一則通知，但只有頂樓住戶受到屋頂水塔維修的___。

options.text: informed
options.zh: 告知
options.whyZh: 每層都已收到通知，並非只有頂樓住戶知道。

options.text: notified
options.zh: 通知
options.whyZh: 前半句明說所有樓層都接獲通知，與 only those 的範圍不符。

options.text: affected
options.zh: 影響
options.whyZh: 前面說所有人都收到通知，後面則限於實際受維修影響的頂樓住戶。

options.text: consulted
options.zh: 徵詢意見
options.whyZh: 句子說維修影響住戶，沒有說住戶的意見被徵求。

questions.explanationZh: 前面說所有人都收到通知，後面則限於實際受維修影響的頂樓住戶。
questions.evidence: Residents on every floor received the same alert, but only those on the top floor were affected by the rooftop tank repair.

vocabulary.note: 與被告知或諮詢不同。

questions.prompt: The store will exchange shoes tried on indoors; shoes worn outside, ___, are not eligible.
questions.promptZh: 鞋子只在室內試穿可換貨；___，穿到戶外的鞋子不符合條件。

options.text: for instance
options.zh: 例如
options.whyZh: 後半句並非可換貨的例子，而是相反的情況。

options.text: by contrast
options.zh: 相較之下
options.whyZh: 對照室內試穿可換與戶外穿過不可換。

options.text: likewise
options.zh: 同樣地
options.whyZh: 前後待遇相反，不能用同樣地。

options.text: in other words
options.zh: 換句話說
options.whyZh: 後一句是相反情況，不是重述室內試穿可換貨的規則。

questions.explanationZh: 對照室內試穿可換與戶外穿過不可換。
questions.evidence: The store will exchange shoes tried on indoors; shoes worn outside, by contrast, are not eligible.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指符合換貨條件。

questions.prompt: The store could not refund the alteration fee, and the shelf price had not changed. Instead, the cashier offered to ___ the fee already paid against the replacement’s price, leaving less to pay at checkout.
questions.promptZh: 店家無法退還修改費，替換品的標價也沒變。收銀員提議把顧客已付的修改費___替換品的費用，這樣結帳時就能少付一些。

options.text: waive
options.zh: 免除
options.whyZh: 費用已經支付，不是讓顧客免繳一筆原本應付的費用。

options.text: transfer
options.zh: 轉移
options.whyZh: 轉移帳務款項不等於將已付費用拿來抵扣替換品；題幹明說結帳時應付餘額會減少。

options.text: refund
options.zh: 退還
options.whyZh: 題幹已明說無法退款；這裡沒有把已付款項退還顧客。

options.text: credit
options.zh: 抵扣
options.whyZh: credit a fee against a price 表示用已付款項抵扣另筆費用；標價不變、顧客不拿退款，但結帳時少付。

questions.explanationZh: credit a fee against a price 表示用已付款項抵扣另筆費用；標價不變、顧客不拿退款，但結帳時少付。
questions.evidence: The store could not refund the alteration fee, and the shelf price had not changed. Instead, the cashier offered to credit the fee already paid against the replacement’s price, leaving less to pay at checkout.

vocabulary.note: 把一筆已付的費用用來抵扣另一筆應付款。

questions.prompt: This month’s community newsletter ___ a map of the new public garden.
questions.promptZh: 本月的社區通訊___一張新公共花園的地圖。

options.text: includes
options.zh: 包含
options.whyZh: 單數主詞 newsletter 以 includes 表示本期內容。

options.text: include
options.zh: 包含（原形）
options.whyZh: 單數主詞在現在式需要 includes。

options.text: including
options.zh: 包括（分詞）
options.whyZh: 句子沒有其他限定動詞；including 不能單獨當謂語。

options.text: inclusion
options.zh: 納入
options.whyZh: 名詞不能擔任這裡的主要動詞。

questions.explanationZh: 單數主詞 newsletter 以 includes 表示本期內容。
questions.evidence: This month’s community newsletter includes a map of the new public garden.

vocabulary.note: 定期發送的簡短刊物。

questions.prompt: Sales were still falling, but by less each month. The company newsletter reported that the pace of the decline had ___.
questions.promptZh: 銷售仍在下滑，但月月降幅縮小。公司通訊指出下滑的速度已___。

options.text: doubled
options.zh: 加倍
options.whyZh: 前句說每月降幅縮小；下降速度加倍會讓降幅變大。

options.text: accelerated
options.zh: 加快
options.whyZh: 下降加快會使降幅擴大，與每月降得更少矛盾。

options.text: slowed
options.zh: 放緩
options.whyZh: 銷售仍下滑，只是下滑的速度變慢，和銷售已上升不同。

options.text: reversed
options.zh: 逆轉
options.whyZh: 下降趨勢逆轉可能變成上升，不能用來表達仍在下降、只是變慢。

questions.explanationZh: 銷售仍下滑，只是下滑的速度變慢，和銷售已上升不同。
questions.evidence: Sales were still falling, but by less each month. The company newsletter reported that the pace of the decline had slowed.

vocabulary.note: 描述某數值下降有多快。

questions.prompt: Attendance at the pottery workshop is free, but places are limited, so participants must sign up ___ rather than simply arrive on the day.
questions.promptZh: 陶藝工作坊免費，但名額有限，因此參加者必須___報名，不能當天直接到場。

options.text: in turn
options.zh: 依序
options.whyZh: 表示輪流做事，無法對應不能當天直接到場。

options.text: on average
options.zh: 平均而言
options.whyZh: 用於平均數，不表示必須事前登記。

options.text: in person
options.zh: 親自
options.whyZh: 表示報名方式；句子在對比事前報名與當天直接前往，不是在規定是否親自。

options.text: in advance
options.zh: 事先
options.whyZh: 名額有限，不能當天直接到場，因此需要事先登記。

questions.explanationZh: 名額有限，不能當天直接到場，因此需要事先登記。
questions.evidence: Attendance at the pottery workshop is free, but places are limited, so participants must sign up in advance rather than simply arrive on the day.

vocabulary.note: 向主辦方登記參加。

questions.prompt: The calendar invitation lists the start time in Taipei. Before accepting it from abroad, check the ___ local time on your calendar.
questions.promptZh: 行事曆邀請以台北時間顯示開始時間。在海外接受邀請前，請查看行事曆上___的當地時間。

options.text: consecutive
options.zh: 連續的
options.whyZh: 連續形容相接的時間或事件，與不同時區的同一時間點不符。

options.text: corresponding
options.zh: 相對應的
options.whyZh: 要找同一個開始時間換算到所在時區後的當地時間。

options.text: temporary
options.zh: 暫時的
options.whyZh: 句子要求時區換算，不是查看暫定時間。

options.text: unrelated
options.zh: 無關的
options.whyZh: 當地時間必須對應同一場活動，不是無關的時間。

questions.explanationZh: 要找同一個開始時間換算到所在時區後的當地時間。
questions.evidence: The calendar invitation lists the start time in Taipei. Before accepting it from abroad, check the corresponding local time on your calendar.

vocabulary.note: 此處指同一時間點在另一時區的表示。

questions.prompt: Maya will ___ the calendar invitation to the supplier after lunch.
questions.promptZh: Maya 午餐後會把行事曆邀請___給供應商。

options.text: forwards
options.zh: 轉寄（第三人稱）
options.whyZh: will 後用原形，不用第三人稱單數形式。

options.text: forwarded
options.zh: 轉寄了
options.whyZh: will 已表示未來，後面不用過去式。

options.text: forward
options.zh: 轉寄
options.whyZh: will 後接動詞原形 forward。

options.text: forwarding
options.zh: 正在轉寄
options.whyZh: 沒有 be，will 後不能直接接 forwarding。

questions.explanationZh: will 後接動詞原形 forward。
questions.evidence: Maya will forward the calendar invitation to the supplier after lunch.

vocabulary.note: 把收到的郵件或邀請再寄給他人。

questions.prompt: Please attach the supplier’s price list ___ the purchase request.
questions.promptZh: 請將供應商的價目表附___這份採購申請。

options.text: to
options.zh: 於
options.whyZh: 固定搭配是 attach A to B，把 A 附到 B 上。

options.text: at
options.zh: 在（某處或某時）
options.whyZh: at 表示地點或時點，不能構成此處附加資料的搭配。

options.text: from
options.zh: 從
options.whyZh: from 表示來源，與要把價目表附到申請的方向相反。

options.text: among
options.zh: 在……之間
options.whyZh: among 表示在群體內，不表示把檔案附到某份申請。

questions.explanationZh: 固定搭配是 attach A to B，把 A 附到 B 上。
questions.evidence: Please attach the supplier’s price list to the purchase request.

vocabulary.note: 採購前提出的內部請求。

questions.prompt: The buyer had saved only the supplier’s quote; no purchase order had been created. Once the budget was approved, she was able to ___ the first order with the supplier.
questions.promptZh: 採購人員先前只留存供應商的報價，尚未建立採購訂單。預算核准後，她就能向供應商___第一筆訂單。

options.text: track
options.zh: 追蹤
options.whyZh: 訂單還沒發出，沒有成交訂單可追蹤。

options.text: amend
options.zh: 修改
options.whyZh: 尚未送出訂單；此處的下一步是正式下單，不是變更已送給供應商的訂單。

options.text: cancel
options.zh: 取消
options.whyZh: 目前僅留存報價，預算也核准了；沒有已送出的訂單需要取消。

options.text: place
options.zh: 下／提交
options.whyZh: 預算核准後可正式向供應商下單；先前只是留存報價。

questions.explanationZh: 預算核准後可正式向供應商下單；先前只是留存報價。
questions.evidence: The buyer had saved only the supplier’s quote; no purchase order had been created. Once the budget was approved, she was able to place the first order with the supplier.

vocabulary.note: 負責人確認同意後，下一步才能執行。

questions.prompt: The supplier’s quote expires on Friday. After Friday it is no longer ___.
questions.promptZh: 供應商的報價星期五到期；星期五之後就不再___。

options.text: validity
options.zh: 效力
options.whyZh: is no longer 後要形容報價狀態；validity 是名詞。

options.text: valid
options.zh: 有效
options.whyZh: valid 是形容詞，表示報價到期後不再有效。

options.text: validly
options.zh: 有效地
options.whyZh: 副詞不能在此表示報價本身的狀態。

options.text: validate
options.zh: 驗證
options.whyZh: validate 是動詞，不能直接接在 is no longer 後。
