questions.explanationZh: valid 是形容詞，表示報價到期後不再有效。
questions.evidence: The supplier’s quote expires on Friday. After Friday it is no longer valid.

vocabulary.note: 效期結束，不能沿用原條件。

questions.prompt: The same covers must stay on the worktables, be cleaned in place, and be reused in the next workshop session. Use ___ covers to protect tables that cannot be washed.
questions.promptZh: 同一批桌罩必須留在工作桌上，原地清潔，並在下一場工作坊重複使用。請用___的桌罩保護無法水洗的桌面。

options.text: woven
options.zh: 編織的
options.whyZh: 編織材質不一定能在兩場活動之間直接清潔。

options.text: absorbent
options.zh: 吸水的
options.whyZh: 能吸水不代表能快速把表面清潔乾淨。

options.text: wipe-clean
options.zh: 擦拭即可清潔的
options.whyZh: 可擦拭的桌罩能在兩場活動之間清潔，不必直接清洗桌面。

options.text: disposable
options.zh: 一次性的
options.whyZh: 一次性桌罩用完要另換，並不提供可反覆清潔的工作表面；題目問的是可清潔表面。

questions.explanationZh: 可擦拭的桌罩能在兩場活動之間清潔，不必直接清洗桌面。
questions.evidence: The same covers must stay on the worktables, be cleaned in place, and be reused in the next workshop session. Use wipe-clean covers to protect tables that cannot be washed.

vocabulary.note: 常用來形容可用布擦乾淨的材料或表面。

questions.prompt: Please speak quietly. The station attendant is ____ an announcement over the loudspeaker.
questions.promptZh: 請放低音量。車站服務人員正在透過廣播____通知。

options.text: make
options.zh: 發布（原形）
options.whyZh: is 後不能直接用動詞原形。

options.text: making
options.zh: 發布（現在分詞）
options.whyZh: is + making 表示正在發布通知；make an announcement 是固定搭配。

options.text: made
options.zh: 發布（過去式／過去分詞）
options.whyZh: the station attendant 是發出通知的人；is made 不是這裡所需的主動進行式。

options.text: makes
options.zh: 發布（第三人稱單數）
options.whyZh: makes 可單獨用於簡單現在式，不能接在 is 後。

questions.explanationZh: is + making 表示正在發布通知；make an announcement 是固定搭配。
questions.evidence: Please speak quietly. The station attendant is making an announcement over the loudspeaker.

vocabulary.note: 用於向一群人發出聲音或廣播。

questions.prompt: Mei records initial reports and Ravi takes over active leaks, so when a caller confirms the water is still flowing, Ravi is the person ___ the case should be referred.
questions.promptZh: Mei 負責登記初次通報，持續漏水的案件由 Ravi 接手，所以來電者確認水仍流不停時，應將案件轉交___ Ravi。

options.text: by whom
options.zh: 由誰
options.whyZh: by whom 指執行轉介的人；題幹的 Ravi 是接手案件的人。

options.text: for whom
options.zh: 為誰
options.whyZh: for whom 表目的或受益人，不表示應將案件轉給哪位處理人。

options.text: from whom
options.zh: 從誰
options.whyZh: from whom 指案件來源；Ravi 在這裡是接手的人，不是收到案件之前的來源。

options.text: to whom
options.zh: 給誰
options.whyZh: refer a case to someone 表示把案件移交給某人；Ravi 是來電確認仍漏水後的承接人。

questions.explanationZh: refer a case to someone 表示把案件移交給某人；Ravi 是來電確認仍漏水後的承接人。
questions.evidence: Mei records initial reports and Ravi takes over active leaks, so when a caller confirms the water is still flowing, Ravi is the person to whom the case should be referred.

vocabulary.note: 把案件交給適合的人或部門繼續處理。

questions.prompt: At the community kitchen, the first van brings ingredients and the second takes away prepared meals. The empty containers stacked by the door belong to the ____ van, which leaves after lunch.
questions.promptZh: 社區廚房的第一輛貨車送來食材，第二輛將備好的餐點送出去。門邊堆放的空容器是給午餐後離開的 ____ 貨車用的。

options.text: outgoing
options.zh: 對外運出的
options.whyZh: 第二輛車把餐點運走，且午餐後離開；outgoing 指從廚房往外運。

options.text: incoming
options.zh: 從外面進來的
options.whyZh: 送食材到廚房的是 incoming；此處指把熟食帶走的車。

options.text: stationary
options.zh: 靜止的
options.whyZh: which leaves after lunch 說明此車會離開，不是固定不動。

options.text: unloaded
options.zh: 已卸貨的
options.whyZh: 出發時將載走餐點；文中也沒說這輛車已卸貨。

questions.explanationZh: 第二輛車把餐點運走，且午餐後離開；outgoing 指從廚房往外運。
questions.evidence: At the community kitchen, the first van brings ingredients and the second takes away prepared meals. The empty containers stacked by the door belong to the outgoing van, which leaves after lunch.

vocabulary.note: 指已完成備餐、可供應或配送的餐點。

questions.prompt: Two identical fees appeared on the customer’s statement, but the billing clerk reversed one of them yesterday. The customer was told that the duplicate charge had ____.
questions.promptZh: 客戶帳單出現兩筆相同費用，不過帳務人員昨天已沖回其中一筆。客戶收到通知，重複收取的費用已 ____。

options.text: reversed
options.zh: 沖回；撤銷（過去分詞）
options.whyZh: had reversed 是主動語態，但重複費用是被沖回的對象。

options.text: been reversing
options.zh: 一直在沖回
options.whyZh: had been reversing 是主動進行，不能表達這筆費用已被沖回。

options.text: been reversed
options.zh: 被沖回
options.whyZh: 費用是動作承受者，且沖回發生在通知前，用過去完成式被動 had been reversed。

options.text: being reversed
options.zh: 正在被沖回
options.whyZh: had 不能直接接 being reversed；而且第一句表示昨天已完成。

questions.explanationZh: 費用是動作承受者，且沖回發生在通知前，用過去完成式被動 had been reversed。
questions.evidence: Two identical fees appeared on the customer’s statement, but the billing clerk reversed one of them yesterday. The customer was told that the duplicate charge had been reversed.

vocabulary.note: 指同一筆應收費用被收取超過一次。

questions.prompt: The bicycle shop will keep the old brake cable unless you ask for ____ back.
questions.promptZh: 自行車行會留著舊煞車線，除非你開口索回 ____。

options.text: them
options.zh: 它們
options.whyZh: them 指複數，與單數 cable 不符。

options.text: it
options.zh: 它
options.whyZh: it 是單數受詞代名詞，指那條舊煞車線。

options.text: its
options.zh: 它的
options.whyZh: its 是所有限定詞，之後要有名詞。

options.text: itself
options.zh: 它自己
options.whyZh: 此句不是煞車線為自己做事；ask for it back 才是索回該物。

questions.explanationZh: it 是單數受詞代名詞，指那條舊煞車線。
questions.evidence: The bicycle shop will keep the old brake cable unless you ask for it back.

vocabulary.note: 指請對方把某件物品還給自己。

questions.prompt: Twelve volunteers signed up for the park cleanup, which needs at least eight people. The organizer has filled all the places, so people on the waiting list ____ come unless the organizer contacts them.
questions.promptZh: 十二名志工報名清理公園，活動至少需要八人。所有名額已滿，因此候補者除非接到主辦人通知，否則 ____ 到場。

options.text: should not
options.zh: 不應
options.whyZh: 名額已滿；unless 指只有主辦人聯絡才例外，候補者未收到通知不應到場。

options.text: must still
options.zh: 仍然必須
options.whyZh: 這會變成未被聯絡時仍必須到場，與候補安排相反。

options.text: would rather
options.zh: 寧可
options.whyZh: 主辦人說的是安排，不是候補人員個人的偏好。

options.text: are about to
options.zh: 正要
options.whyZh: 句子沒有預告候補者即將抵達，而是在說是否應到場。

questions.explanationZh: 名額已滿；unless 指只有主辦人聯絡才例外，候補者未收到通知不應到場。
questions.evidence: Twelve volunteers signed up for the park cleanup, which needs at least eight people. The organizer has filled all the places, so people on the waiting list should not come unless the organizer contacts them.

vocabulary.note: 名額滿時登記，等有空位再獲通知。

questions.prompt: At the grocery co-op, the display price applies only to a full basket. Individual pears are priced by weight, so a shopper taking just two pears should ____.
questions.promptZh: 合作社的展示價格只適用於整籃購買。單買梨子按重量計價，因此只拿兩顆梨子的顧客應 ____。

options.text: pay the displayed price for one full basket
options.zh: 支付一整籃的展示價格
options.whyZh: 顧客只拿兩顆，不能套用整籃售價。

options.text: use the displayed price for each pear
options.zh: 把展示價格當成每顆梨子的售價
options.whyZh: 展示價格是整籃價，不是單顆定價。

options.text: divide the basket price by the number of pears it holds
options.zh: 以每籃梨子的顆數平分整籃價格
options.whyZh: 散裝梨子按重量，不是把籃裝價格按顆數攤分。

options.text: have the two pears weighed to determine the price
options.zh: 把那兩顆梨子秤重後計價
options.whyZh: 買的是兩顆散裝梨子，要按實際重量計價，無法套用整籃售價。

questions.explanationZh: 買的是兩顆散裝梨子，要按實際重量計價，無法套用整籃售價。
questions.evidence: At the grocery co-op, the display price applies only to a full basket. Individual pears are priced by weight, so a shopper taking just two pears should have the two pears weighed to determine the price.

vocabulary.note: 以商品重量決定應付金額。

questions.prompt: Staff may enter to collect tools with a supervisor, but a contractor whose permit lists inspection as the only authorized task may not collect tools, ___ a supervisor is present.
questions.promptZh: 有主管陪同時，內部員工可以進去取工具，但許可證只准進行檢查的承包人員，___有主管在場，也不能取工具。

options.text: unless
options.zh: 除非
options.whyZh: 這會把有主管在場變成承包人員可取工具的例外，但許可證只准進行檢查。

options.text: as long as
options.zh: 只要
options.whyZh: 這會把主管在場當成禁止取工具的條件；真正的限制是許可證只列檢查，不取決於主管是否在場。

options.text: even if
options.zh: 即使
options.whyZh: 凸顯對內部員工有效的主管陪同條件，不能擴大承包人員的工作許可。主管在場也不能讓承包人員取工具。

options.text: only if
options.zh: 只有在……時
options.whyZh: 這會把主管在場變成禁止取工具的必要條件；題意是有無主管都不能改變許可範圍。

questions.explanationZh: 凸顯對內部員工有效的主管陪同條件，不能擴大承包人員的工作許可。主管在場也不能讓承包人員取工具。
questions.evidence: Staff may enter to collect tools with a supervisor, but a contractor whose permit lists inspection as the only authorized task may not collect tools, even if a supervisor is present.

vocabulary.note: 讓步連接詞，表示假設情況成立也不改變主要結果。

questions.prompt: Before leaving the staff laundry room, please ____ the lint screen.
questions.promptZh: 離開員工洗衣間前，請 ____ 棉絮濾網。

options.text: cleaned
options.zh: 清理了
options.whyZh: 正向祈使句在 please 後要用原形，不用過去式 cleaned。

options.text: clean
options.zh: 清理
options.whyZh: please clean 是禮貌的祈使句，要求離開前清理濾網。

options.text: cleans
options.zh: 清理（第三人稱單數）
options.whyZh: 這是直接要求讀者做事，不用第三人稱單數 cleans。

options.text: cleaning
options.zh: 清理（動名詞）
options.whyZh: please 後不能單用 cleaning 作為此祈使句的主要動詞。

questions.explanationZh: please clean 是禮貌的祈使句，要求離開前清理濾網。
questions.evidence: Before leaving the staff laundry room, please clean the lint screen.

vocabulary.note: 用於收集衣物棉絮，常見於乾衣設備。

questions.prompt: At the board game club, each player should write ____ own first name on a name tag.
questions.promptZh: 在桌遊社，每位玩家應在名牌上寫下 ____ 名字。

options.text: theirs
options.zh: 他們的（獨立用法）
options.whyZh: theirs 是所有代名詞，不能直接和 own first name 連用。

options.text: them
options.zh: 他們（受格）
options.whyZh: them 通常當受詞，不表達名字屬於誰。

options.text: they
options.zh: 他們（主格）
options.whyZh: they 通常當主詞，不能修飾 own first name。

options.text: their
options.zh: 自己的；他們的
options.whyZh: their own first name 表示每位玩家寫自己的名字；their 可以指性別不特定的單一個人。

questions.explanationZh: their own first name 表示每位玩家寫自己的名字；their 可以指性別不特定的單一個人。
questions.evidence: At the board game club, each player should write their own first name on a name tag.

vocabulary.note: 貼在衣服或掛在身上、顯示姓名的小牌。

questions.prompt: The bike club’s sample protection plan pays for repairs after a crash. It does not pay for worn parts replaced during routine service. A worn chain found during a yearly tune-up is therefore ____ the plan.
questions.promptZh: 自行車社舉例說明的保障方案支付撞車後的維修費，但不支付例行保養時更換磨損零件的費用。年度保養時發現的磨損鏈條，因此 ____ 此方案。

options.text: outside the scope of
options.zh: 不在……涵蓋範圍內
options.whyZh: 磨損零件在例行保養時更換，符合不給付條件，因此不在方案範圍內。

options.text: subject to a higher limit under
options.zh: 適用……較高的給付上限
options.whyZh: 例行保養更換磨損零件根本不給付，沒有適用較高給付上限的問題。

options.text: automatically covered by
options.zh: 由……自動給付
options.whyZh: 例行保養中的磨損零件被明確排除，不會自動給付。

options.text: reimbursed ahead of
options.zh: 在……之前獲得補償
options.whyZh: ahead of 表時間先後，此處是在判斷適用範圍；又沒有任何補償承諾。

questions.explanationZh: 磨損零件在例行保養時更換，符合不給付條件，因此不在方案範圍內。
questions.evidence: The bike club’s sample protection plan pays for repairs after a crash. It does not pay for worn parts replaced during routine service. A worn chain found during a yearly tune-up is therefore outside the scope of the plan.

vocabulary.note: 依週期進行的常規檢查或維護，不指事故後的維修。

questions.prompt: The reception desk will reopen ____ Tuesday, after the staff holiday.
questions.promptZh: 員工休假結束後，接待櫃檯將 ____ 星期二重新開放。

options.text: in
options.zh: 在（較長期間）
options.whyZh: in 常用於月份、年份或較長期間，不用於指定的星期幾。

options.text: at
options.zh: 在（時刻）
options.whyZh: at 常接明確時刻，例如 at nine；此處是星期二。

options.text: on
options.zh: 在（某日）
options.whyZh: on Tuesday 是星期幾前的常用介系詞。

options.text: into
options.zh: 進入；持續到
options.whyZh: into 可表示延伸至某時段，例如 well into Tuesday；reopen into Tuesday 不能表達星期二重新開放。

questions.explanationZh: on Tuesday 是星期幾前的常用介系詞。
questions.evidence: The reception desk will reopen on Tuesday, after the staff holiday.

vocabulary.note: 暫停營業、關閉或休假後恢復開放。

questions.prompt: The lab assistant put a cover over the scanner ____ dust was falling from the ceiling.
questions.promptZh: 實驗室助理用罩子把掃描器蓋上，____ 天花板正在落下灰塵。

options.text: despite
options.zh: 儘管
options.whyZh: despite 後要接名詞或動名詞等結構，不能直接接 dust was falling 的完整子句。

options.text: due to
options.zh: 由於
options.whyZh: due to 後通常接名詞片語；此處是完整原因子句。

options.text: because of
options.zh: 因為（接名詞片語）
options.whyZh: because of 可接 the falling dust，但題目接的是 dust was falling from the ceiling。

options.text: because
options.zh: 因為
options.whyZh: because 可引導完整的原因子句，解釋助理為何給掃描器加罩。

questions.explanationZh: because 可引導完整的原因子句，解釋助理為何給掃描器加罩。
questions.evidence: The lab assistant put a cover over the scanner because dust was falling from the ceiling.

vocabulary.note: 此處指蓋住設備、防止灰塵落入的物品。

questions.prompt: Elena will read the plant supervisor’s statement at the customer meeting. The supervisor wrote it and takes responsibility for it, but has asked Elena to speak ____ him.
questions.promptZh: Elena 將在客戶會議上宣讀廠務主管的聲明。聲明由主管撰寫並由他負責，但他請 Elena ____ 他發言。

options.text: on behalf of
options.zh: 代表
options.whyZh: 主管撰寫並對內容負責，Elena 受託代他宣讀，正是 speak on behalf of someone。

options.text: in opposition to
options.zh: 反對
options.whyZh: 她受託傳達主管的聲明，沒有表示異議。

options.text: in addition to
options.zh: 除了……之外還
options.whyZh: 文中只指定 Elena 代讀，沒有說主管也將另外發言。

options.text: without regard to
options.zh: 不考慮
options.whyZh: 她有明確委託，內容依主管書面聲明，不是忽略主管。

questions.explanationZh: 主管撰寫並對內容負責，Elena 受託代他宣讀，正是 speak on behalf of someone。
questions.evidence: Elena will read the plant supervisor’s statement at the customer meeting. The supervisor wrote it and takes responsibility for it, but has asked Elena to speak on behalf of him.

vocabulary.note: 正式表達立場、責任或資訊的文字或發言。

questions.prompt: At this neighborhood tool library, the front desk ____ at seven on Fridays.
questions.promptZh: 這間社區工具圖書館的服務櫃檯每逢星期五七點 ____。

options.text: close
options.zh: 關閉（原形）
options.whyZh: 主詞是單數 the front desk，描述例行時間須搭配第三人稱單數 closes。

options.text: closes
options.zh: 關閉（第三人稱單數）
options.whyZh: on Fridays 表固定週期；單數主詞用簡單現在式 closes。

options.text: closing
options.zh: 關閉（現在分詞）
options.whyZh: closing 不能在此單獨當主要動詞。

options.text: have closed
options.zh: 已關閉（現在完成式）
options.whyZh: 單數主詞不能用 have，此處也不是說已完成的某次關閉。

questions.explanationZh: on Fridays 表固定週期；單數主詞用簡單現在式 closes。
questions.evidence: At this neighborhood tool library, the front desk closes at seven on Fridays.

vocabulary.note: 提供接待、登記或借用服務的櫃檯。

questions.prompt: Choose the best option for the blank.
questions.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的選項。

options.text: verifying
options.zh: 正在驗證
options.whyZh: can 後接動詞原形，不能直接接 verifying。

options.text: verify
options.zh: 核對
options.whyZh: can verify 是正確形式；會員證可用來核對帳戶。

options.text: verified
options.zh: 已核對
options.whyZh: can 後不接過去式或分詞 verified。

options.text: verification
options.zh: 核對程序
options.whyZh: verification 是名詞，不能當 can 後的動詞。

questions.explanationZh: can verify 是正確形式；會員證可用來核對帳戶。

vocabulary.note: 按照證件確認帳戶資訊。

questions.evidence: Your tool stays at the pickup desk for two open days after we send the notice. Bring your membership card so staff can verify your account.

questions.prompt: Choose the best option for the blank.
questions.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的選項。

options.text: keep
options.zh: 保留
options.whyZh: 回覆後會把工具交給下一位，並不是保留自己的預約。

options.text: extend
options.zh: 延長

questions.evidence:
To: Members with a pickup notice
Subject: Releasing a hold

Your tool stays at the pickup desk for two open days after we send the notice. Bring your membership card so staff can verify your account.

If you no longer need the tool and want the next member to have it, you can release a hold by replying before it expires. A reply canceling your hold does not extend the pickup window. When staff receive that message before expiry, they offer the tool to the next person in line.

There is a separate option for members who still need the tool. Reply before expiry to ask for one extra open day. We can grant it only if nobody is waiting. For a Sunday deadline, a reply cannot secure a Tuesday pickup if someone else is waiting: cancellation hands the tool to the next member, and an extension cannot be granted.

The desk closes at 6 p.m. on open days, and it is closed on Mondays. A hold with a Sunday deadline will not remain active simply because Monday is not an open day.

options.text: Collect the coat at the side door, then return during front-counter hours to approve the cuffs.
options.zh: 從側門領大衣，改在前方櫃檯的營業時間回來核准袖口施工。
options.whyZh: 星期四側門延後領件，下襬已付清；但新工作只能在前方櫃檯核准。

options.text: Approve the cuffs, but leave the coat until both changes are complete.
options.zh: 核准袖口施工，但把大衣留到兩項修改都完成。
options.whyZh: 六點半不能核准新工作，而且可以先帶走大衣。

options.text: Do neither, because partial work cannot be picked up.
options.zh: 兩項都不能做，因為部分完工不能領件。
options.whyZh: 領件單明寫可在未決定袖口前帶走大衣。

questions.explanationZh: 星期四側門延後領件，下襬已付清；但新工作只能在前方櫃檯核准。
questions.evidence: You can take the coat home now without deciding about the cuffs. … late pickup is only for work already paid for. Use the front counter to approve any new work.

vocabulary.note: 正式同意開始新的工作。

questions.prompt: Iris signs on Friday. The shop orders the fabric on Monday and receives it on Wednesday. When can the four-business-day period begin?
questions.promptZh: Iris 星期五簽單，店家星期一訂布料、星期三收到。四個工作天的施工期從何時起算？

options.text: On Wednesday, after the fabric reaches the shop
options.zh: 星期三布料送到店之後
options.whyZh: 布料一到即可開工；題幹已說明實際到貨日是星期三。

options.text: When she signs the work order
options.zh: 她簽署工單時
options.whyZh: 簽單是下訂前的動作，還要等布料到貨。

options.text: When she first selected a fabric
options.zh: 她第一次選布時
options.whyZh: 首次選布的款式已缺貨，那不是開始日期。

options.text: When the shop orders the fabric on Monday
options.zh: 店家星期一訂購布料時
options.whyZh: 星期一是可訂購日，不等於布料到貨日。

questions.explanationZh: 布料一到即可開工；題幹已說明實際到貨日是星期三。
questions.evidence: We can order material on Monday. The cuff work can begin as soon as the fabric arrives and takes four business days.

vocabulary.note: 營業、辦公或施工的日子，不等於任何日曆日。

questions.prompt: Where was the caption lag reported?
questions.promptZh: 哪裡有人回報字幕延遲？

options.text: On the recording copy
options.zh: 錄影副本上
options.whyZh: 紀錄說錄影副本的字幕仍與發言同步。

options.text: In both side rooms
options.zh: 兩個分會場
options.whyZh: 紀錄說分會場沒有收到投訴。

options.text: On the audience screen in the main room
options.zh: 主會場的觀眾螢幕上
options.whyZh: 09:05 的回報指主會場觀眾字幕延遲。

options.text: In the caption glossary
options.zh: 字幕詞庫內
options.whyZh: 詞庫新增姓名是另一起內容需求。

questions.explanationZh: 09:05 的回報指主會場觀眾字幕延遲。
questions.evidence: audience captions lagged in the main room.

vocabulary.note: 顯示或訊號落後於實際發生時間。

questions.prompt: What does the 09:15 entry imply about the initial timing problem?
questions.promptZh: 09:15 的紀錄顯示一開始的字幕延遲可能出在哪裡？

options.text: The speaker was too far from the microphone.
options.zh: 講者離麥克風太遠。
options.whyZh: 沒有收音距離的證據；支援人員找到的是螢幕訊號來源問題。

options.text: The recording copy had to be created again.
options.zh: 錄影副本必須重新製作。
options.whyZh: 錄影字幕本來同步，錄影系統也未被改動。

options.text: A spelling change delayed all screens.
options.zh: 拼字修正造成所有螢幕延遲。
options.whyZh: 拼字相關的內容需求出現在稍後，且問題只在主會場被回報。

options.text: The screen was receiving a feed intended for a different stage of the event.
options.zh: 螢幕接收的是給活動另一個階段使用的訊號。
options.whyZh: 觀眾螢幕接到彩排訊號而不是正式活動訊號；切換並確認後恢復。

questions.explanationZh: 觀眾螢幕接到彩排訊號而不是正式活動訊號；切換並確認後恢復。
questions.evidence: the audience screen was using the rehearsal feed. … We did not touch the recording system.

vocabulary.note: 供螢幕、音訊或錄影系統使用的訊號。

questions.prompt: How should support classify the organizer’s 12:10 request?
questions.promptZh: 支援人員應把主辦人12:10 提出的要求歸在哪一類？

options.text: As evidence that the event feed has failed again
options.zh: 正式活動訊號再次故障的證據
options.whyZh: 主辦人要新增姓名，沒有回報再度延遲。

options.text: As a separate caption-content request
options.zh: 一宗獨立的字幕內容需求
options.whyZh: 要求是新增姓名；紀錄明確表示不算時間問題復發。

options.text: As a change to the recording system
options.zh: 錄影系統變更
options.whyZh: 要求對象是字幕詞庫，不是錄影系統。

options.text: As a request to repeat the rehearsal
options.zh: 重做彩排的要求
options.whyZh: 主辦人沒有要求更換訊號或重做彩排。

questions.explanationZh: 要求是新增姓名；紀錄明確表示不算時間問題復發。
questions.evidence: Please file that separately as a content request; it is not a recurrence of the timing incident.

vocabulary.note: 這裡是字幕系統用來辨識專有名詞的清單。

questions.prompt: At 2:30 the event feed starts lagging again. A quick switch fixes the problem. What should the incident record show?
questions.promptZh: 兩點半，正式活動訊號的字幕再次延遲。快速切換訊號後恢復正常。事件紀錄應如何處理？

options.text: Keep the room and time in the record, even though the fix worked.
options.zh: 即使已經修好，仍在紀錄保留會場與發生時間。
options.whyZh: 14:20 的流程要求記下發生地點及時間，且即使立刻修好也要留存。

options.text: Reopen the glossary request and add the host’s name.
options.zh: 重開詞庫需求並加上主持人的名字。
options.whyZh: 詞庫需求和時間事件應分開。

options.text: Wait to see whether the fix succeeds before writing anything.
options.zh: 先等修復結果，再寫紀錄。
options.whyZh: 紀錄要求切換前就記下細節，即使立刻修好也要保留。

options.text: Turn off captions on the recording copy.
options.zh: 關閉錄影副本字幕。
options.whyZh: 流程沒有要求關錄影字幕。

questions.explanationZh: 14:20 的流程要求記下發生地點及時間，且即使立刻修好也要留存。
questions.evidence: If lag returns on the event feed, note the room and time before switching feeds. … Record the details even if an immediate change restores the captions.

vocabulary.note: 指相同問題再出現。

questions.prompt: Who made the clip of shoe repair?
questions.promptZh: 誰錄製了修鞋的片段？

options.text: A visitor to the sound trail
options.zh: 聲音路線的訪客
options.whyZh: 店主搬遷前親自錄製；文章只說訪客現在可以聽這段錄音。

options.text: A worker at the market entrance
options.zh: 市場入口的工作人員
options.whyZh: 入口只涉及路線走法。

options.text: One of the editors
options.zh: 一位編輯
options.whyZh: 編輯負責日後處理檔案，不是該段錄音者。

options.text: The shopkeeper
options.zh: 鞋店店主
options.whyZh: 文章明說店主親自錄製。

questions.explanationZh: 文章明說店主親自錄製。
questions.evidence: She recorded it herself before the shop moved.

vocabulary.note: 鞋子的底部。

questions.prompt: What may the editors do to a recording if it is longer than needed?
questions.promptZh: 若錄音長於所需，編輯可能怎麼處理？

options.text: Send it back and require the resident to cut it.
options.zh: 退回給居民，要求自行剪短。
options.whyZh: 居民須交原始錄音，編輯可自行縮短。

options.text: Keep the recorded sound but use a shorter portion of it.
options.zh: 保留原錄音的聲音，但只取較短的片段。
options.whyZh: 編輯可剪短，但不能加入原本沒有的音效。

options.text: Reject it automatically, even if the sound fits the project.
options.zh: 即使符合主題，也因太長自動退件。
options.whyZh: 文章說可以剪短，未設自動退件。

options.text: Replace its quieter sections with sound effects.
options.zh: 用音效取代比較安靜的段落。
options.whyZh: 文章說不會加入音效。

questions.explanationZh: 編輯可剪短，但不能加入原本沒有的音效。
questions.evidence: Please hand in the unedited file; the editors may shorten it, but they will not add sound effects.

vocabulary.note: 尚未由錄音者刪減或拼接。

questions.prompt: A resident has the café owner’s permission to record inside but captured a customer whose words can be understood. How can the resident submit the recording as it is?
questions.promptZh: 居民獲咖啡館店主允許在店內錄音，但錄到一位客人說話，而且聽得懂內容。若要原樣繳交，還要怎麼做？

options.text: Ask the editor to obtain the customer’s permission after submission.
options.zh: 送出後再請編輯取得客人允許。
options.whyZh: 提交前就須取得說話者允許，且義務在提交者。

options.text: Send the file immediately because the owner has approved the recording.
options.zh: 因店主已同意錄音，立即送出檔案。
options.whyZh: 店主只能同意在店內錄音，不能代替錄音裡那位話語可被聽懂的客人同意。

options.text: Obtain permission from the customer before sending the unedited file.
options.zh: 在送出未剪輯錄音前，取得那位客人的允許。
options.whyZh: 店主只批准店內錄音，不能替客人同意。原文說若聽得懂錄到的人在說什麼，交件前就要取得那位說話者的同意；要求交原始錄音，不能靠自行剪掉該段來提交原檔。

options.text: Submit without consent because the customer is not the person recording.
options.zh: 客人不是錄音者，所以不用取得同意即可提交。
options.whyZh: 規則取決於錄音裡誰說的話聽得懂，不取決於誰操作錄音器材。

questions.explanationZh: 店主只批准店內錄音，不能替客人同意。原文說若聽得懂錄到的人在說什麼，交件前就要取得那位說話者的同意；要求交原始錄音，不能靠自行剪掉該段來提交原檔。
questions.evidence: If a voice can be understood in the recording, get that speaker's permission before submitting it. … A shop owner can approve recording inside a shop, but cannot give permission on someone else's behalf. … Please hand in the unedited file

vocabulary.note: 以另一人的名義或替那個人做某事。

questions.prompt: A visitor starts at the south entrance. What will they miss if they stay on that route?
questions.promptZh: 訪客從南入口出發。如果只沿該路線走，會錯過什麼？

options.text: The old shoe shop stop
options.zh: 老鞋店這一站
options.whyZh: 老鞋店是第一站，從南入口只能到後三站。

options.text: The last three stops
options.zh: 最後三站
options.whyZh: 南入口正可到達最後三站。

options.text: All of the market stops
options.zh: 市場內的所有站點
options.whyZh: 南入口仍可走到最後三站。

options.text: Only the trail leaflet
options.zh: 只會錯過路線摺頁
options.whyZh: 文章沒有規定南入口拿不到摺頁，限制的是路線。

questions.explanationZh: 老鞋店是第一站，從南入口只能到後三站。
questions.evidence: At the old shoe shop, a locked door once stopped visitors from seeing the repair bench. Now it is the first stop … The south entrance gives access to the last three stops only.

vocabulary.note: 表示一個入口或路線可以到達何處。

questions.prompt: Why are the pieces on Tray J eligible for viewing despite the band on the underside?
questions.promptZh: J 盤樣品底面有一條未上釉的窄帶，為什麼仍可供看色？

options.text: The colour being shown is even on the glazed face, despite the holder mark underneath.
options.zh: 要展示的上釉面顏色均勻，底面的窄帶是固定座留下的。
options.whyZh: 看色針對均勻的上釉面；底面窄帶是試驗固定座遮蔽所致。

options.text: The unglazed band is intended to be the reference colour.
options.zh: 未上釉的窄帶就是用來比對的標準色。
options.whyZh: 可看色的原因是上釉面均勻，不是把裸露窄帶當作標準色。

options.text: The band was removed by polishing after firing.
options.zh: 窄帶於燒製後已磨除。
options.whyZh: 底面窄帶還在，沒有磨除紀錄。

options.text: The pieces have already passed a strength test.
options.zh: 樣品已通過強度試驗。
options.whyZh: 本單不評估強度，也沒記載通過強度試驗。

questions.explanationZh: 看色針對均勻的上釉面；底面窄帶是試驗固定座遮蔽所致。
questions.evidence: Purpose: Select pieces for the customer’s colour viewing, not for a strength test. … Even colour across the glazed face. … where the test holder covered it. These pieces may be shown for colour.

vocabulary.note: 物件面向下方的一側。

questions.prompt: What needs to accompany the Tray K comparison piece?
questions.promptZh: 要保留的 K 盤比對樣品應附上什麼？

options.text: A sample from Tray L
options.zh: 一件 L 盤樣品
options.whyZh: L 盤樣品須進不良品箱，不是 K 盤的附件。

options.text: The close-up photograph of the bubbles
options.zh: 氣泡的表面特寫
options.whyZh: 氣泡特寫對應 L 盤，要放交接資料夾。

options.text: A strength-test certificate
options.zh: 強度測試證明
options.whyZh: 此試作單不是強度試驗，未要求此證明。

options.text: Its original tray tag
options.zh: 原盤標籤
options.whyZh: K 盤要保留一件放比對層架；任一層架上的樣品都須留原盤標籤。

questions.explanationZh: K 盤要保留一件放比對層架；任一層架上的樣品都須留原盤標籤。
questions.evidence: Keep one on the comparison shelf … A piece stored on either shelf must keep its tray tag.

vocabulary.note: 用於保留樣品，供後續比較或查證。

questions.prompt: What can the next shift use to inspect the appearance of the bubbles without taking a reject piece from the bin?
questions.promptZh: 下一班若想查看氣泡外觀，但不從不良品箱取樣，可以用什麼？

options.text: A colour sample placed on the viewing shelf
options.zh: 看色層架上的顏色樣品
options.whyZh: 看色層架留的是 J 盤，不是有氣泡的 L 盤。

options.text: The retained comparison piece from Tray K
options.zh: K 盤保留的比對樣品
options.whyZh: K 盤保留件顯示色差，不是氣泡。

options.text: The close-up stored in the handover folder
options.zh: 交接資料夾中的表面特寫
options.whyZh: L 盤表面須先拍特寫，照片放交接資料夾，無須取出不良品。

options.text: A polished piece saved for customer viewing
options.zh: 磨過並保留供客戶看色的樣品
options.whyZh: 說明明確禁止磨掉氣泡再送去看色。

questions.explanationZh: L 盤表面須先拍特寫，照片放交接資料夾，無須取出不良品。
questions.evidence: Place these pieces in the reject bin after taking one close-up of the surface. … Put the photo, not a reject piece, in the handover folder.

vocabulary.note: 為看清表面細節而近距離拍攝的照片。

questions.prompt: What does the notice forbid people to leave in the tub?
questions.promptZh: 通知禁止把什麼留在回收桶裡？

options.text: Pear peel
options.zh: 梨皮
options.whyZh: 梨皮是蔬果廚餘，符合回收規定。

options.text: A bag marketed as compostable
options.zh: 標榜可堆肥的袋子
options.whyZh: 所有包裝都不收，包括標榜可堆肥的袋子。

options.text: Carrot ends
options.zh: 胡蘿蔔剩下的頭尾
options.whyZh: 屬於家中的蔬菜廚餘。

options.text: Apple cores
options.zh: 蘋果核
options.whyZh: 屬於家中的水果廚餘。

questions.explanationZh: 所有包裝都不收，包括標榜可堆肥的袋子。
questions.evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable.

vocabulary.note: 表示能在適當條件下轉變成堆肥；不代表本回收點一定收。

questions.prompt: What should someone do if the chalkboard says “Indoor drop-off”?
questions.promptZh: 如果黑板寫著「改到室內回收」，應該怎麼做？

options.text: Wait until 11 for the shed to reopen.
options.zh: 等到十一點，看小屋會不會重新開門。
options.whyZh: 室內回收已經指定市場大廳；並未說小屋十一點會重開。

options.text: Leave the scraps at the garden gate.
options.zh: 把廚餘放在菜園門口。
options.whyZh: 大門旁的黑板用來看公告，不是回收點。

options.text: Take acceptable scraps to the hall after 11.
options.zh: 十一點過後才把符合規定的廚餘送到市場大廳。
options.whyZh: 更換地點不改時間；仍是九點至十一點。

options.text: Take acceptable scraps to the hall during the normal hours.
options.zh: 在原定時段把符合規定的廚餘送到市場大廳。
options.whyZh: 同一時段指前段的九點至十一點，改的是地點，不是品項與時間。

questions.explanationZh: 同一時段指前段的九點至十一點，改的是地點，不是品項與時間。
questions.evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable. | If the shed is closed because of heavy rain, check the chalkboard by the gate. When it reads “Indoor drop-off”, bring your scraps to the market hall during the same hours. When it reads “Cancelled”, take everything home. Neither sign changes what the volunteers accept.

vocabulary.note: 把物品拿到指定地點交給工作人員。

questions.prompt: On a dry first Saturday, a visitor brings scraps in a pail and an empty bucket for compost. How should they handle the two containers?
questions.promptZh: 每月第一個星期六沒有下雨，訪客帶了一個裝廚餘的桶子，還帶了一個空桶想領成品堆肥。兩個容器要怎麼用？

options.text: Empty the scraps into the marked tub, take the empty pail back, and use a separate bucket for finished compost.
options.zh: 把廚餘倒進指定桶，帶走倒空的桶子，另用一個桶子領成品堆肥。
options.whyZh: 送廚餘的容器要倒空後帶回；領成品堆肥要另外準備一個桶子。

options.text: Leave the scraps pail with the volunteers and collect the compost in any discarded container.
options.zh: 把裝廚餘的桶子留給志工，再用任何廢棄容器領堆肥。
options.whyZh: 送廚餘的容器必須帶回，領堆肥的桶子也要自備。

options.text: Keep the scraps in the pail and ask the volunteers to add compost on top.
options.zh: 不倒出廚餘，請志工直接把成品堆肥裝在上面。
options.whyZh: 廚餘要倒入指定回收桶，成品堆肥則另桶裝。

options.text: Empty the scraps and collect the compost in the same pail.
options.zh: 倒掉廚餘後，用同一個桶子領成品堆肥。
options.whyZh: 通知要求另帶一個桶子領堆肥，不能把同一個桶子當成兩用。

questions.explanationZh: 送廚餘的容器要倒空後帶回；領成品堆肥要另外準備一個桶子。
questions.evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable. | Finished compost becomes available on the first Saturday of each month. Bring a separate bucket to collect it. In the market hall, volunteers can take incoming scraps but cannot give out finished compost. If scrap drop-off moves indoors on a compost collection day, the finished-compost collection is postponed; collect your share at the shed the following Saturday.

vocabulary.note: 已經完成處理、可領回使用的堆肥。

questions.prompt: On the first Saturday, rain moves drop-off indoors. A member brings apple cores and an empty bucket at 10 a.m. What can the member accomplish?
questions.promptZh: 每月第一個星期六，回收因下雨改到室內。有位會員上午十點帶來蘋果核和一個空桶。他可以怎麼做？

options.text: Leave the scraps and fill the bucket at the hall.
options.zh: 在市場大廳回收廚餘，並裝一桶成品堆肥。
options.whyZh: 大廳可收廚餘，但不發放成品堆肥。

options.text: Leave neither item until the next Saturday.
options.zh: 這次什麼都不交，兩件事都等下星期六再辦。
options.whyZh: 十點在回收時段內，今天的大廳可收蘋果核。

options.text: Leave the scraps at the hall and return to the shed next Saturday for compost.
options.zh: 把廚餘交給大廳志工，下星期六再到小屋領堆肥。
options.whyZh: 時間與廚餘都符合室內回收；成品不在大廳發放，因改到室內而沒領到者可下星期六補領。

options.text: Leave the scraps at the shed today and take the bucket to the hall next Saturday.
options.zh: 今天把廚餘放在小屋，下星期六帶桶子到市場大廳。
options.whyZh: 今天應去大廳交廚餘，補領成品在小屋，不是在大廳。

questions.explanationZh: 時間與廚餘都符合室內回收；成品不在大廳發放，因改到室內而沒領到者可下星期六補領。
questions.evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable. | If the shed is closed because of heavy rain, check the chalkboard by the gate. When it reads “Indoor drop-off”, bring your scraps to the market hall during the same hours. When it reads “Cancelled”, take everything home. Neither sign changes what the volunteers accept. | Finished compost becomes available on the first Saturday of each month. Bring a separate bucket to collect it. In the market hall, volunteers can take incoming scraps but cannot give out finished compost. If scrap drop-off moves indoors on a compost collection day, the finished-compost collection is postponed; collect your share at the shed the following Saturday.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指出席領取成品堆肥，不是送來廚餘。

questions.prompt: Who enters the names of people who attend live?
questions.promptZh: 誰負責登記現場參加人員的姓名？

options.text: The host supervisor
options.zh: 受支援團隊主管
options.whyZh: 主管可調整工作，但不負責登記現場訓練。

options.text: The usual team’s supervisor
options.zh: 原所屬團隊主管
options.whyZh: 公告說不要請兩位主管登記，由講師負責現場場次。

options.text: The trainer
options.zh: 講師
options.whyZh: 首段明確說現場場次由講師登記。

options.text: The person covering the loading counter
options.zh: 支援裝貨服務台的人
options.whyZh: 這是受工作限制的人，不是登記者。

questions.explanationZh: 首段明確說現場場次由講師登記。
questions.evidence: The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count.

vocabulary.note: 在當場參加，而非事後觀看錄影。

questions.prompt: Liam watched the replay while Ana attended live. How is each person’s completion recorded?
questions.promptZh: Liam 看了錄影，Ana 則參加現場。兩人的訓練完成情況怎麼登記？

options.text: The trainer enters both names, whether or not a quiz was submitted.
options.zh: 不論有沒有交測驗，兩人的姓名都由講師登記。
options.whyZh: 只有現場場次由講師登記；看錄影者須交測驗。

options.text: Liam submits the quiz from his training account; the trainer enters Ana’s name.
options.zh: Liam 用自己的訓練帳號交測驗；Ana 由講師登記姓名。
options.whyZh: 看錄影與到場各有一套認列流程，不可互換。

options.text: Liam asks the host supervisor to check the replay; Ana submits an online quiz.
options.zh: Liam 請受支援團隊主管確認錄影；Ana 則在線上交測驗。
options.whyZh: 主管無法認列時數，且現場由講師登記，不須用錄影流程。

options.text: Neither action is needed if both staff members opened the replay.
options.zh: 只要兩人都打開過錄影，就不用做任何事。
options.whyZh: 光開錄影不算完成，也不能取代現場登記。

questions.explanationZh: 看錄影與到場各有一套認列流程，不可互換。
questions.evidence: The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count.

vocabulary.note: 活動結束後可觀看的錄影。

questions.prompt: A cover-shift supervisor finds the training on the host team’s list only. What should the employee do the next morning?
questions.promptZh: 支援班主管發現，訓練只登記在受支援團隊的紀錄上。員工隔天早上該怎麼做？

options.text: Check the usual team’s record and send training the date and briefing title if the entry is missing.
options.zh: 檢查原所屬團隊的紀錄；若沒有該筆，將日期和說明會名稱寄給訓練服務台。
options.whyZh: 訓練應記在原團隊；隔天發現原團隊沒有才以日期和名稱通報。

options.text: Leave the host entry as the only record and wait for the usual team to copy it.
options.zh: 讓受支援團隊的登記成為唯一紀錄，等原團隊自行複製。
options.whyZh: 規定應記在原團隊；若缺漏要通報，不是被動等候。

options.text: Ask both supervisors to enter it again to make sure no record is missing.
options.zh: 請兩位主管各補登一次，確保沒有漏記。
options.whyZh: 通知明說不要讓兩位主管重複登記。

options.text: Send the host supervisor the briefing title only and ask for credit in the host team.
options.zh: 只將說明會名稱寄給受支援團隊主管，請他補登到該團隊。
options.whyZh: 對象是訓練服務台，而且需要名稱與完成日期，並記在原團隊。

questions.explanationZh: 訓練應記在原團隊；隔天發現原團隊沒有才以日期和名稱通報。
questions.evidence: A cover shift is a shift you work for another team. Training done during a cover shift belongs on your usual team’s record, not the host team’s record. Check your record the next morning. If an entry is missing, send the completion date and briefing title to the training desk. Do not ask both supervisors to enter it.

vocabulary.note: 暫時代另一組的人值班。

questions.prompt: Nora submitted the replay quiz while covering Dispatch. The next morning no training credit appears, and she is due to cover Dispatch again, this time at the loading counter. What is the appropriate response?
questions.promptZh: Nora 支援出貨組時交了錄影測驗。翌日早上紀錄仍無訓練時數，而她原定再次支援出貨組，這次在裝貨服務台。怎麼處理才符合通知？

options.text: Ask the Dispatch supervisor to add the credit and keep the loading assignment.
options.zh: 請出貨組主管補登時數，並照原安排去裝貨服務台。
options.whyZh: 受支援組主管不能核准時數。紀錄尚未補上前也不可支援裝貨服務台。

options.text: Ask both supervisors to record the briefing and work at the customer desk without notifying training.
options.zh: 請兩位主管各登記說明會，再去顧客服務台，不必告知訓練服務台。
options.whyZh: 排班可調整，但不能請兩位主管重複登記；仍須向訓練服務台提供資料。

options.text: Work at the loading counter because the quiz was submitted, then report the missing credit later.
options.zh: 既然已交測驗，就先去裝貨服務台，之後再通報時數缺漏。
options.whyZh: 限制依據是有無登記，不是已交測驗但未入帳。

options.text: Send the date and briefing title to training, and ask the host supervisor to move her to the customer desk for that shift.
options.zh: 將完成日期和說明會名稱寄給訓練服務台，並請受支援團隊主管將該班改到顧客服務台。
options.whyZh: 補登與排班是兩個不同權責。紀錄缺漏時向訓練服務台通報；主管可先另派至顧客服務台。

questions.explanationZh: 補登與排班是兩個不同權責。紀錄缺漏時向訓練服務台通報；主管可先另派至顧客服務台。
questions.evidence: The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count. | A cover shift is a shift you work for another team. Training done during a cover shift belongs on your usual team’s record, not the host team’s record. Check your record the next morning. If an entry is missing, send the completion date and briefing title to the training desk. Do not ask both supervisors to enter it. | For staff due to cover the loading counter, there is a separate access rule. Anyone without recorded training may cover the customer desk but not the loading counter. If your credit is missing, the host supervisor can change your assignment for that shift; the supervisor cannot approve training credit. The training desk will still need the information above.

vocabulary.note: 把完成的訓練列入正式紀錄。

questions.prompt: Where are the names of the drinks kept until scoring ends?
questions.promptZh: 評分結束前，飲料的品名放在哪裡？

options.text: On the removable cup stickers
options.zh: 在可撕下的杯貼上
options.whyZh: 杯貼提供兩字母代碼，不公開品名。

options.text: In the space for a numeric score
options.zh: 在填寫數字分數的位置
options.whyZh: 評分欄是給小組成員填記結果，不是公開品名的位置。

options.text: On the tasting tray map
options.zh: 在試飲托盤配置圖上
options.whyZh: 備料台用配置圖補製樣品；本文說品名表封存於信封。

options.text: In a sealed envelope
options.zh: 在封好的信封裡
options.whyZh: 首段直接交代評分都完成前將品名封存。

questions.explanationZh: 首段直接交代評分都完成前將品名封存。
questions.evidence: The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring.

vocabulary.note: 信封封口後，內容不能直接看見。

questions.prompt: Jo’s cup sticker falls off. Jo thinks the drink’s colour gives away its identity. How should Jo proceed?
questions.promptZh: Jo 的杯貼掉了。Jo 覺得可以靠顏色認出飲料。按規定該怎麼做？

options.text: Guess the drink from its colour and score it under that name.
options.zh: 依顏色猜出飲料，並用品名記分。
options.whyZh: 不能靠顏色辨認，也只能用杯貼代碼記分。

options.text: Return the cup to the preparation desk for a newly coded sample; leave the score sheet at the seat.
options.zh: 把杯子交回備料台，換一杯有代碼的樣品；評分表留在座位。
options.whyZh: 杯貼脫落時須由備料台依配置圖換杯，否則無法按指定代碼記分。

options.text: Take the score sheet to the preparation desk and ask to see the drink name.
options.zh: 把評分表帶到備料台，要求查看品名。
options.whyZh: 評分表留在座位；所有人完成評分前不公開品名。

options.text: Write “not tasted” and finish without requesting another cup.
options.zh: 標成「未試飲」並結束，不要求換樣品。
options.whyZh: 此情況是代碼掉落，規定要換一杯，不是因飲食限制跳過。

questions.explanationZh: 杯貼脫落時須由備料台依配置圖換杯，否則無法按指定代碼記分。
questions.evidence: The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring. | If a sticker comes off, do not try to identify the drink by colour or smell. Give the cup to the preparation desk and ask for a fresh sample. The desk uses the tray map to prepare a new coded cup. Keep your score sheet at your seat while waiting.

vocabulary.note: 以識別碼而非品牌名稱標示的樣品。

questions.prompt: A panel member avoiding soy sees an orange dot on cup MB. What should the score sheet show?
questions.promptZh: 一位不吃大豆的小組成員在 MB 杯上看到橘色圓點。評分表應如何填？

options.text: A zero for MB and no entries for the other drinks
options.zh: MB 填零分，其餘飲料都不填
options.whyZh: 未試飲不等於零分；其他可試飲的飲料仍可照常評分。

options.text: The product name instead of MB, followed by a score
options.zh: 用品名取代 MB，後面填分數
options.whyZh: 評分只用代碼，且須跳過含大豆的 MB。

options.text: “Not tasted” for MB, while the other drinks can still receive scores
options.zh: MB 標「未試飲」，其餘飲料仍可評分
options.whyZh: 橘點表示含大豆，須跳過 MB 並註記；不是取消整場試飲。

options.text: A request for a fresh MB cup before the member records any scores
options.zh: 要求換一杯 MB，再開始打分
options.whyZh: 換杯是用於杯貼掉落；同代碼的樣品仍含大豆。

questions.explanationZh: 橘點表示含大豆，須跳過 MB 並註記；不是取消整場試飲。
questions.evidence: The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring. | An orange dot on a sticker means the drink contains soy. Panel members avoiding soy should skip that sample but can score the others. Mark “not tasted” for any skipped cup; do not enter a numeric score.

vocabulary.note: 表示未品嚐，因此不填分數。

questions.prompt: When does the main pool open on Wednesday?
questions.promptZh: 主池星期三幾點開放？

options.text: At 7 a.m.
options.zh: 上午七點
options.whyZh: 通知開頭直接寫明主池七點開放。

options.text: At 8:30 a.m.
options.zh: 上午八點半
options.whyZh: 八點半開始測試升降椅，不是開池。

options.text: At 9 a.m.
options.zh: 上午九點
options.whyZh: 九點開放的是溫水池。

options.text: Only after both pools’ equipment tests finish
options.zh: 兩個池的設備都測完後
options.whyZh: 通知沒說要等兩個池的設備測試；主池仍七點開放。

questions.explanationZh: 通知開頭直接寫明主池七點開放。
questions.evidence: The main pool opens at 7 a.m. on Wednesday. The warm pool opens at 9 a.m. Both use the usual entrance and changing rooms.

vocabulary.note: 場館主要的泳池，與另設的溫水池區分。

questions.prompt: Why does the notice direct some swimmers to the warm pool?
questions.promptZh: 為什麼通知請部分泳客改去溫水池？

options.text: It opens before the lift test starts.
options.zh: 它在升降椅開始測試前就開放。
options.whyZh: 測試八點半開始，溫水池九點才開。

options.text: It has a separate entrance and changing rooms.
options.zh: 它有另外的入口和更衣室。
options.whyZh: 兩池都使用平時相同的入口和更衣室。

options.text: Its entry ramp does not depend on the lift being ready.
options.zh: 它的下水坡道不受升降椅是否就緒影響。
options.whyZh: 使用者可走不受測試影響的坡道，不必等主池升降椅。

options.text: Anyone with a morning ticket can already use both pools.
options.zh: 持晨間票的人原本就可以使用兩個池。
options.whyZh: 晨間票通常限指定泳池，特定情況才可轉票。

questions.explanationZh: 使用者可走不受測試影響的坡道，不必等主池升降椅。
questions.evidence: The main pool opens at 7 a.m. on Wednesday. The warm pool opens at 9 a.m. Both use the usual entrance and changing rooms. | Staff will test the main-pool lift at 8:30. Before they confirm the test is complete, swimmers who need help entering the water should ask reception to reserve a place in the warm pool. Its ramp is independent of the lift test. Do not enter the main pool by lift until a staff member confirms it is available.

vocabulary.note: 可分開運作，不需要先完成另一件事。

questions.prompt: At 8:45 a.m., a main-pool ticket holder who needs the lift arrives. The test is not yet confirmed complete and staff advise a change of pool. What can the swimmer do?
questions.promptZh: 上午八點四十五分，一位持主池票、需要升降椅的泳客抵達。工作人員尚未確認測試完成，並建議改池。他可以怎麼做？

options.text: Use the main-pool lift now because that pool is open.
options.zh: 主池既然開放，就立刻使用升降椅。
options.whyZh: 泳池開放不等於升降椅已確認可用。

options.text: Go to the warm-pool gate and transfer the ticket to enter immediately.
options.zh: 到溫水池入口轉票，立刻進入。
options.whyZh: 池畔入口不能轉票，八點四十五分溫水池也尚未開放。

options.text: Pay for a second ticket at reception and enter the warm pool immediately.
options.zh: 到櫃檯另買一張票，立刻進溫水池。
options.whyZh: 依建議改池可免費轉票，而且溫水池九點才開。

options.text: Transfer the ticket at reception without a fee and wait until the warm pool opens.
options.zh: 到櫃檯免費轉票，等溫水池開放。
options.whyZh: 符合免費轉票條件，地點是櫃檯；轉票不會讓溫水池提早開放。

questions.explanationZh: 符合免費轉票條件，地點是櫃檯；轉票不會讓溫水池提早開放。
questions.evidence: The main pool opens at 7 a.m. on Wednesday. The warm pool opens at 9 a.m. Both use the usual entrance and changing rooms. | Staff will test the main-pool lift at 8:30. Before they confirm the test is complete, swimmers who need help entering the water should ask reception to reserve a place in the warm pool. Its ramp is independent of the lift test. Do not enter the main pool by lift until a staff member confirms it is available. | A morning ticket normally covers only the pool named on the ticket. If a lift user changes pools on staff advice, reception can transfer the main-pool ticket to the warm pool at no charge. The transfer does not open the warm pool early, and it cannot be done at the poolside gate.

vocabulary.note: 把同一張票改為可進入另一個池。

questions.prompt: Which screening has open captions?
questions.promptZh: 哪一場有公開字幕？

options.text: The 6:10 screening
options.zh: 六點十分的場次
options.whyZh: 六點十分是 Sienna 能到達的時間，不是開演時間。

options.text: The 6:20 screening
options.zh: 六點二十分的場次
options.whyZh: 公告明說六點二十分場有公開字幕。

options.text: The 8:10 screening
options.zh: 八點十分的場次
options.whyZh: 公告明說八點十分場沒有字幕。

options.text: Both evening screenings
options.zh: 兩個晚場都有
options.whyZh: 只有六點二十分有公開字幕。

questions.explanationZh: 公告明說六點二十分場有公開字幕。
questions.evidence:
Document 1 · Cinema notice
Clover Cinema | Wednesday screenings
The 6:20 screening has open captions. The 8:10 screening does not. Doors open fifteen minutes before each screening.
A voucher covers one seat, not a companion’s seat. Redeem it online before noon on the day of the screening. You can also buy regular seats online before noon. Any seat still available after noon may be bought at the door at the regular price. Unused vouchers can be moved to a later date by emailing the office; the box office cannot do this.

vocabulary.note: 所有觀眾都看得到、不需自行開啟的字幕。

questions.prompt: When did Sienna see four seats available?
questions.promptZh: Sienna 何時看到還有四席？

options.text: At noon
options.zh: 中午
options.whyZh: 中午是兌換期限，並非查看座位的時間。

options.zh: 六點十分
options.whyZh: 這是她可以抵達的時間。

options.text: Fifteen minutes before the screening
options.zh: 開演前十五分鐘
options.whyZh: 這是開放入場的時間。

options.text: At 10 that morning
options.zh: 當天上午十點
options.whyZh: 訊息明說上午十點看見四席。

questions.explanationZh: 訊息明說上午十點看見四席。
questions.evidence:
Document 2 · Message from Sienna
To: Jules
I can get there at 6:10. Please choose the screening with captions. I received only one voucher, but we both need seats. The website showed four seats left at 10 this morning. Could you take care of the tickets before lunch? If you can only get one seat, don’t redeem the voucher yet. I’d rather move it to next Wednesday than go alone.

vocabulary.note: 目前仍可購入或預約的座位。

questions.prompt: Why is one voucher not enough for what Sienna wants?
questions.promptZh: 為什麼一張抵用券不足以達成 Sienna 的安排？

options.text: It covers only one of the two people who need seats.
options.zh: 它只能抵用兩人所需座位中的一席。
options.whyZh: Sienna 與 Jules 都需要座位，但公告說一張券只抵一席。

options.text: The voucher cannot be used for a captioned film.
options.zh: 抵用券不能用於有字幕的電影。
options.whyZh: 公告未排除有字幕的場次。

options.text: The voucher is valid only when a companion buys a seat at the door.
options.zh: 同行者必須在現場買票，抵用券才有效。
options.whyZh: 公告未設這種限制；抵用券要在中午前上網兌換。

options.text: The captioned show had only one seat left at 10.
options.zh: 有字幕的場次上午十點時只剩一席。
options.whyZh: Sienna 說網站當時顯示四席。

questions.explanationZh: Sienna 與 Jules 都需要座位，但公告說一張券只抵一席。
questions.evidence:
Document 1 · Cinema notice
Clover Cinema | Wednesday screenings
The 6:20 screening has open captions. The 8:10 screening does not. Doors open fifteen minutes before each screening.
A voucher covers one seat, not a companion’s seat. Redeem it online before noon on the day of the screening. You can also buy regular seats online before noon. Any seat still available after noon may be bought at the door at the regular price. Unused vouchers can be moved to a later date by emailing the office; the box office cannot do this.

Document 2 · Message from Sienna
To: Jules
I can get there at 6:10. Please choose the screening with captions. I received only one voucher, but we both need seats. The website showed four seats left at 10 this morning. Could you take care of the tickets before lunch? If you can only get one seat, don’t redeem the voucher yet. I’d rather move it to next Wednesday than go alone.

vocabulary.note: 與自己一起出席的人。

questions.prompt: If Jules finds two seats online for Sienna’s preferred screening before noon, how can Jules follow her request?
questions.promptZh: 如果 Jules 在中午前上網找到 Sienna 想看的場次有兩席，怎麼做才符合她的要求？

options.text: Book two seats for the 8:10 screening and use the voucher for both.
options.zh: 訂八點十分的兩席，兩席都用抵用券。
options.whyZh: 該場沒有字幕，且一張券只能抵一席。

options.text: Redeem one seat now and wait until the door opens to secure any second seat.
options.zh: 先兌換一席，等開門後再確定是否有第二席。
options.whyZh: 兩席已可取得，應避免先兌換卻讓同行者可能沒有座位。

options.text: Book two seats for 6:20 online, redeeming the voucher for one and paying for the other.
options.zh: 在線上訂六點二十分的兩席，一席用抵用券，另一席付款。
options.whyZh: 六點二十分有字幕；在中午前可線上兌換一席，另一席另買。

options.text: Wait until after noon and redeem the voucher at the box office.
options.zh: 等到中午過後，到現場售票處兌換。
options.whyZh: 抵用券只能在當天中午前上網兌換。

questions.explanationZh: 六點二十分有字幕；在中午前可線上兌換一席，另一席另買。

questions.prompt: If only one seat is available, how should Jules handle the unused voucher?

options.text: Redeem it now and ask the box office to move the seat later.
options.zh: 先兌換，再請售票處把這個座位改到其他日期。
options.whyZh: Sienna 說只剩一席先不要兌換，售票處也不辦改期。

options.whyZh: Sienna 寧可下週一起看；公告規定未使用的券要寄信給辦公室改期。

questions.prompt: What should Chen do about the clasp if the cape is still needed for a short time?

options.whyZh: 雖然 Yun 有膠帶，借用辦法不准自行黏貼。

questions.prompt: Where should volunteers enter this Saturday?
questions.promptZh: 志工這個星期六應從哪裡進入？

options.text: At the stairs by the river
options.zh: 河邊的樓梯
options.whyZh: 河邊樓梯因施工封閉。

options.text: At the entrance beside the wall
options.zh: 靠牆的入口
options.whyZh: Rowan 要大家本週改走靠牆的新入口。

options.text: At the maintenance van
options.zh: 維修貨車旁
options.whyZh: 維修貨車只與視線遮擋有關，不是入口。

options.text: At the rescue desk
options.zh: 救援站櫃檯
options.whyZh: 救援站是通報對象，不是橋的入口。

questions.explanationZh: Rowan 要大家本週改走靠牆的新入口。
questions.evidence:
Email | Rowan to Saturday volunteers
Use the new wall-side entrance this week; work crews have closed the stairs near the river. Our 8:00–9:00 session stays the same. Have one person watch the glass while the other fills in the sheet. If a crew vehicle blocks your view, write down the start and end of the obstruction instead of guessing what happened.

vocabulary.note: 依本題文件脈絡理解。

questions.prompt: Which logged observations count as bird strikes?
questions.promptZh: 紀錄中哪些觀察算是鳥撞？

options.text: Only the swallows
options.zh: 只有燕子
options.whyZh: 兩隻燕子只從面板前飛過，沒有碰到玻璃。

options.text: Only the pigeon
options.zh: 只有鴿子
options.whyZh: 規則不要求鳥留在地上；麻雀也有碰到玻璃。

options.text: The swallows and the sparrow
options.zh: 燕子和麻雀
options.whyZh: 燕子不算，且此選項忽略了實際碰到玻璃的鴿子。

options.text: The sparrow and the pigeon
options.zh: 麻雀和鴿子
options.whyZh: 觀察卡以碰到玻璃為準；紀錄指出麻雀與鴿子都碰到面板。

questions.explanationZh: 觀察卡以碰到玻璃為準；紀錄指出麻雀與鴿子都碰到面板。
questions.evidence:
Volunteer field card | Riverglass Bird Rescue
At the east pedestrian bridge, count a bird strike only if you see a bird touch the glass railing. A bird flying past the panel is not a strike. Enter groups of birds as separate sightings if you can tell them apart. Do not collect feathers or handle birds; call the rescue desk if a bird remains on the ground. | Field log | Saturday | Ivy and Leon
8:13 Two swallows passed in front of panel 4; both continued across the river.
8:26 One sparrow touched panel 2 and flew away.
8:41–8:47 A maintenance van hid panels 1 and 2.
8:52 One pigeon touched panel 4 and stayed on the ground; Ivy phoned the rescue desk.

questions.prompt: Why is there a six-minute range rather than a bird count in the log?
questions.promptZh: 紀錄為何列出六分鐘的區間，而沒有填鳥的數量？

options.text: An obstruction made part of the railing impossible to watch.
options.zh: 遮擋使部分欄杆無法觀察。
options.whyZh: 貨車擋住兩塊玻璃板；指示要求記錄遮擋時段，不憑猜測填數。

options.text: The volunteers had to leave the bridge for six minutes.
options.zh: 志工必須離開橋面六分鐘。
options.whyZh: 紀錄只說視線受阻，沒說人曾離開。

options.text: Two crew members came to count the birds.
options.zh: 兩名施工人員來數鳥。
options.whyZh: 郵件說兩名志工分工，沒說施工人員來數鳥。

options.text: The rescue desk closed for six minutes.
options.zh: 救援站關了六分鐘。
options.whyZh: 紀錄未提及救援站停業；六分鐘對應貨車遮擋。

questions.explanationZh: 貨車擋住兩塊玻璃板；指示要求記錄遮擋時段，不憑猜測填數。

questions.prompt: What did Ivy do at 8:52?
questions.promptZh: Ivy 在上午八點五十二分做了什麼？

options.text: Picked up a feather
options.zh: 撿起一根羽毛
options.whyZh: 觀察卡反而禁止撿羽毛，且紀錄沒寫 Ivy 撿羽毛。

options.text: Moved a van
options.zh: 移動一輛貨車
options.whyZh: 貨車在先前的時段擋住面板，並未記錄 Ivy 移車。

options.text: Called the rescue desk
options.zh: 打電話給救援站
options.whyZh: 8:52 的紀錄明載 Ivy 打給救援站。

options.text: Closed the bridge stairs
options.zh: 關閉人行橋樓梯
options.whyZh: 關閉樓梯的是施工人員。

questions.explanationZh: 8:52 的紀錄明載 Ivy 打給救援站。

questions.prompt: What is the strongest conclusion the team can draw about panel 2 that morning?
questions.promptZh: 就當天早上 2 號玻璃板的情況，這組志工最能合理得出什麼結論？

options.text: Exactly one bird touched panel 2 during the whole session.
options.zh: 整段觀察時段恰好有一隻鳥碰到 2 號板。
options.whyZh: 一段時間內看不到 2 號板，因此無法保證整段時段只有一次。

options.text: At least one strike was observed, but part of the session is unaccounted for.
options.zh: 觀察到至少一次撞擊，但有一段時段無法確定。
options.whyZh: 麻雀碰到 2 號板是可記錄撞擊；8:41 至 8:47 的遮擋卻不能推斷為零次。

options.text: No strike was observed because the sparrow flew away.
options.zh: 未觀察到撞擊，因為麻雀飛走了。
options.whyZh: 碰到玻璃即符合撞擊定義；之後是否飛走不影響認列。

options.text: Panel 2 had more strikes than panel 4.
options.zh: 2 號板的撞擊比 4 號板多。
options.whyZh: 可確認的兩板各有一次；遮擋期間的未知情形不能用來判定多寡。

questions.explanationZh: 麻雀碰到 2 號板是可記錄撞擊；8:41 至 8:47 的遮擋卻不能推斷為零次。

questions.prompt: Where should staff put loose labels?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員應把散放的標籤放在哪裡？

options.text: On the back of each tile
options.zh: 每塊磁磚背面
options.whyZh: 規定禁止把標籤黏到磁磚上。

options.text: Under the loading desk
options.zh: 裝貨櫃檯下方
options.whyZh: 裝貨櫃檯是領防雨套的地方，不是放標籤的位置。

options.text: Inside the weather cover
options.zh: 防雨套裡
options.whyZh: 防雨套用來保護貨物，不是標籤的指定收納處。

options.text: In the envelope inside the lid
options.zh: 盒蓋內側的信封裡
options.whyZh: 裝箱說明指定把標籤放進夾在盒蓋內側的信封。

questions.explanationZh: 裝箱說明指定把標籤放進夾在盒蓋內側的信封。
questions.evidence:
Packing instruction | Moss Harbor Ceramic Tile Library
Each tile loan travels in a reusable tray. A tray marked D contains display tiles only, and a tray marked H contains handling samples that visitors may touch. Put loose labels in the envelope clipped inside the lid. Do not tape a label to a tile, even for a short trip.

vocabulary.note: 依本題文件脈絡理解。

questions.prompt: Which tray should the packing desk send with the afternoon driver?
questions.promptZh: 裝箱櫃檯應將哪一盤交給下午的司機？

options.text: The display tray headed to South Hall
options.zh: 送往南館的展示托盤
options.whyZh: 展示托盤需要簽名，下午司機能向收件人員取得簽名。

options.text: Only the visitor handling samples
options.zh: 僅供訪客觸摸的樣品
options.whyZh: 可摸樣品不需簽收，且可以在中午前送出。

options.text: Any tray that has a loose label
options.zh: 任何有散放標籤的托盤
options.whyZh: 有沒有散放標籤不決定司機；重點是是否需要簽名。

options.text: Only a tray that lacks a cover
options.zh: 只送沒有防雨套的托盤
options.whyZh: 公告沒以防雨套決定取件；Kei 還要求兩批都有防雨套。

questions.explanationZh: 展示托盤需要簽名，下午司機能向收件人員取得簽名。
questions.evidence:
Courier bulletin | Monday pickup
The morning driver can take either type of tray but does not obtain signatures at delivery. The afternoon driver picks up at 3:30 p.m. and can collect a signature from the receiving staff. Wet-weather covers are available at the loading desk; keep the tray flat even when a cover is fitted. | Message | Kei to packing desk
On Monday, please send the display tray from our packing desk to South Hall’s borrowing desk. That delivery needs a signed handoff record. Send the visitor handling samples to the other site; that delivery needs no signature and can leave before lunch. Rain is expected; please fit weather covers to both loads.

vocabulary.note: 依本題文件脈絡理解。

questions.prompt: What does the courier bulletin say about the morning driver's restriction?
questions.promptZh: 依快遞公告，上午司機的限制是什麼？

options.text: It depends on whether the trays are marked D or H.
options.zh: 限制取決於托盤標有 D 還是 H。
options.whyZh: 公告說上午司機可收兩類托盤，標示不構成限制。

options.text: It applies only to trips in wet weather.
options.zh: 只有雨天的運送受限。
options.whyZh: 公告的簽收限制不取決於天氣，防雨套另外提供。

options.text: It concerns handoff paperwork rather than the type of tray.
options.zh: 限制的是交接文件，而不是托盤種類。
options.whyZh: 上午司機可運兩種托盤，但送達時不會請收件人簽名。

options.text: It prevents returns to the South Hall borrowing desk.
options.zh: 不可送回南館借用櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 限制只與簽收文件有關，沒有依目的地限制上午司機。

questions.explanationZh: 上午司機可運兩種托盤，但送達時不會請收件人簽名。

questions.prompt: Which letter should the staff at the destination for visitor samples expect on their tray?
questions.promptZh: 收到訪客樣品的場地，工作人員應看到托盤標有哪個字母？

options.text: D, because it is the first tray to go out
options.zh: D，因為它是先送出的托盤
options.whyZh: D 代表展示用途，不代表出貨順序；展示托盤還需要下午簽收。

options.text: H, because visitors may handle the contents
options.zh: H，因為訪客可以觸摸盤內樣品
options.whyZh: Kei 說這批是訪客可摸樣品；裝箱說明規定這類使用 H 盤。

options.text: D, because the tray goes to a different site
options.zh: D，因為托盤送往不同場地
options.whyZh: 不同場地不是分類依據。D 盤只裝展示磁磚。

options.text: H, because the staff must sign for the tray
options.zh: H，因為工作人員必須簽收這個托盤
options.whyZh: 訪客樣品的托盤確實標 H，但不需要簽收，理由不成立。

questions.explanationZh: Kei 說這批是訪客可摸樣品；裝箱說明規定這類使用 H 盤。

questions.prompt: Which note could the loading desk use for both deliveries on Monday?
questions.promptZh: 星期一裝貨櫃檯可以在兩批貨上都使用哪一則提醒？

options.text: Use a signed slip and send the tray at 3:30 p.m.
options.zh: 使用需簽名的單據，並在下午三點半送出托盤。
options.whyZh: 只有展示托盤有簽名要求；可摸樣品可以更早送出。

options.text: Mark the tray H and put it in a weather cover.
options.zh: 在托盤標 H，再套上防雨套。
options.whyZh: 防雨套兩批都用，但標示 H 只適用可摸樣品。

options.text: Leave the cover at the desk and ask for a signature.
options.zh: 把防雨套留在櫃檯，並請收件人員簽名。
options.whyZh: Kei 要兩批都套上防雨套，簽名則不適用兩批。

options.text: Use a weather cover and keep the tray level.
options.zh: 套上防雨套，並讓托盤保持水平。
options.whyZh: Kei 明確要求兩批都套上防雨套；快遞公告也要求加裝防雨套後仍保持水平。

groups.title: Closing the rinse-water loop

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Our water bill went up again, so I asked the coating team where we could reuse water. They said the final rinse must use fresh water. Otherwise, the coating may not stick.
turns.zh: 水費又漲了，所以我問塗裝組哪個環節可以重複用水。他們說最後一道沖洗必須用未使用過的新水。否則，塗層可能附著不牢。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then let's collect the water after that rinse and use it for the first wash on the next batch. That's where we remove most of the dirt anyway.
turns.zh: 那就把最後一道沖洗用過的水收集起來，用在下一批的第一道清洗。原本大部分的髒污就是在那一步去除的。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Good idea. The catch is that our collection tank is nearly full. I'll ask maintenance to empty it before the afternoon run.
turns.zh: 好主意。不過有個問題：回收槽快滿了。我會請維護人員在下午開工前把它排空。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll put a separate meter on the line. Purchasing will want to see how much fresh water we save before we try this on the second line.
turns.zh: 我會在這條線裝獨立的水表。在第二條線試做之前，採購部會想先知道我們省了多少新水。

groups.passage:
F: Our water bill went up again, so I asked the coating team where we could reuse water. They said the final rinse must use fresh water. Otherwise, the coating may not stick.

F: Good idea. The catch is that our collection tank is nearly full. I'll ask maintenance to empty it before the afternoon run.

製程工程師：那就把最後一道沖洗用過的水收集起來，用在下一批的第一道清洗。原本大部分的髒污就是在那一步去除的。
塗裝主管：好主意。不過有個問題：回收槽快滿了。我會請維護人員在下午開工前把它排空。
製程工程師：我會在這條線裝獨立的水表。在第二條線試做之前，採購部會想先知道我們省了多少新水。
groups.audioScript:
Our water bill went up again, so I asked the coating team where we could reuse water. They said the final rinse must use fresh water. Otherwise, the coating may not stick.
Then let's collect the water after that rinse and use it for the first wash on the next batch. That's where we remove most of the dirt anyway.
Good idea. The catch is that our collection tank is nearly full. I'll ask maintenance to empty it before the afternoon run.
I'll put a separate meter on the line. Purchasing will want to see how much fresh water we save before we try this on the second line.

groups.titleZh: 博物館放映場的字幕安排

turns.text: My mother needs captions. Can we bring her to the museum's film on Friday, or should we wait for the repeat showing next week?
turns.zh: 我媽媽需要字幕。我們可以帶她去看博物館星期五的電影，還是該等下週重映？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Friday's early show has captions on the main screen. The late show offers captions only on a device you borrow. Those devices are all reserved.
turns.zh: 星期五的早場會在大銀幕上顯示字幕。晚場只能用借來的裝置看字幕，但那些裝置都已經被預約了。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can make the early show. The seats at the front are sold out, though, and she can't read small text at a distance.
turns.zh: 我們趕得上早場。不過前排座位賣光了，而她離遠了就看不清小字。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Try the middle section. We checked the captions from there yesterday. The side seats are closer, but the speaker stands block the bottom of the screen.
turns.zh: 可以試試中間區。我們昨天從那裡確認過字幕看得清楚。側邊座位雖然比較近，但喇叭支架會擋住銀幕下方。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The design team moved its files to the new storage service last week. Can we close the old account before it renews on Monday?
turns.zh: 設計組上週已把檔案移到新的儲存服務。我們可以在星期一續約前關閉舊帳戶嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not yet. The new service has the files, but it doesn't have the comments our clients added. I can export those by Monday afternoon.
turns.zh: 還不行。新服務已有檔案，但沒有客戶加的留言。我可以最晚在星期一下午把那些留言匯出。

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You don't have to close the account today. Turn off automatic renewal by noon Friday. We'll still have read-only access through Monday, but there won't be another charge.
turns.zh: 今天不用關閉帳戶。最晚星期五中午關掉自動續約即可。我們星期一當天仍可唯讀存取，而且不會再被扣款。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Please send me the export when it's ready. I don't want to close the old account until I've checked that every client comment came through.
turns.zh: 匯出完成後請傳給我。我想等到確認每則客戶留言都保留下來，再關閉舊帳戶。

groups.title: Cutting panels with a consistent grain
groups.titleZh: 裁出木紋方向一致的飾板

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: We need twelve oak panels for the reception desk. If I turn every other outline sideways, I can cut all twelve from the sheets we have.
turns.zh: 接待櫃台需要十二片橡木飾板。如果我把每隔一片的裁切輪廓轉成橫向，就能用現有板材裁完十二片。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The panels will sit side by side, so the grain needs to run the same way on all of them. Don't turn the outlines. How many can you cut with the grain running lengthwise?
turns.zh: 這些飾板會並排安裝，所以木紋方向要一致。先別旋轉輪廓。木紋沿著長邊的話，你能裁幾片？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Ten, but there's a partially used sheet behind the saw. I'll check whether it has room for the other two.
turns.zh: 十片。不過鋸台後面有一塊用過一部分的板材，我會去看看還夠不夠裁另外兩片。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Take a finished panel with you. That sheet is darker on one side, and the finished desk should look even in color.
turns.zh: 帶一片做好的飾板去比對。那塊板材有一側顏色比較深，完工後的櫃台顏色要一致。

groups.title: Preparing sheet music for rehearsal

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can pick up the choir music before rehearsal. Do we still need twenty copies of the new song?
turns.zh: 我可以在排練前去拿合唱團的歌譜。新曲還需要二十份嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, but the print shop used the version from last month. I emailed a corrected final page this morning. Only the ending changed.
turns.zh: 要，不過影印店印的是上個月的版本。我今天早上有寄更正後的最後一頁。只有結尾有改。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They've already put all twenty copies in folders. If the shop prints the final page again, I can put it in each folder.
turns.zh: 他們已經把二十份都放進資料夾了。如果店家重印最後一頁，我可以把它放進每個資料夾。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Please take the old page out, too. We can't stop rehearsal to explain which ending to sing. I'll tell the group to bring a pencil to mark the places where they come in.
turns.zh: 也請把舊的一頁抽出來。我們不能停下排練來解釋該唱哪個結尾。我會請大家帶鉛筆，標記自己要從哪裡開始唱。

groups.title: Clearing a font for a partner's campaign
groups.titleZh: 確認合作宣傳的字型授權

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The community arts center likes our poster. They'd like the editable file so they can put it in their own spring campaign.
turns.zh: 社區藝文中心喜歡我們的海報。他們想要可編輯的檔案，好用在自己的春季宣傳活動。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can send a finished image, but our font license covers editing only on our own computers. They'd need their own license to edit that file.
turns.zh: 我們可以寄完成的圖片，但我們的字型授權只允許在自己的電腦上編輯。他們要編輯那個檔案，就得有自己的授權。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: They asked us to lock the artwork in place, but they need to change the dates themselves. Is there a font they already have that looks close enough?
turns.zh: 他們請我們把圖案鎖定不讓人更動，但需要自己更改日期。他們手邊有沒有外觀夠接近的字型？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They have a current license for Lighthouse, the font on their website. And we can still send the artwork as a picture.
turns.zh: 他們網站用的是 Lighthouse，也有仍然有效的授權。圖案則還是可以用圖片的形式寄給他們。

groups.title: Servicing a press before the weekend

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Can the press run through Saturday? The maintenance calendar says its oil change isn't due until Tuesday.
turns.zh: 這台沖床可以運轉到星期六結束嗎？保養行事曆寫著下星期二才需要換油。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Tuesday was our estimate, based on normal use. We added a night shift, so the press will reach its service limit by Friday evening. We go by operating hours, not the date on the calendar.
turns.zh: 星期二是照平常用量估算的。我們加開了夜班，所以沖床到星期五晚上就會達到保養時數上限。我們要看運轉時數，不是看行事曆上的日期。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Can maintenance come right after the Friday afternoon shift? We don't need the press again until Saturday morning.
turns.zh: 維護人員能在星期五午班結束後馬上過來嗎？那之後到星期六早上才會再用到沖床。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll ask. The spare oil has arrived, but the old oil has to cool before they drain it. Let me find out how long that takes.
turns.zh: 我會去問。換油用的新油到了，但舊油要先冷卻才能排掉。我先確認要等多久。

groups.title: Taking seeds to a neighborhood swap

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I've got three envelopes of seeds for Saturday's swap. I won't get there until after lunch. Can someone take them for me in the morning?
turns.zh: 我有三個裝種子的信封要帶去星期六的交換會。我午餐後才會到，早上有人能幫我先帶去嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can take them. Are they labeled? We accept seeds even if you don't know the variety, but each envelope has to say the kind of plant and the month and year the seeds were collected.
turns.zh: 我可以幫你帶。有寫標籤嗎？不知道品種也能收，不過每個信封都要標明是哪種植物的種子，以及採收的年和月。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The beans and basil have both details. My neighbor gave me the pumpkin seeds. I know they're pumpkin seeds, but I didn't ask when she collected them.
turns.zh: 豆子和羅勒都有寫。南瓜種子是鄰居給我的。我知道是南瓜種子，但沒問她什麼時候採收的。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Give me the other two before I leave. Your neighbor should be back around noon, so you can ask her about the pumpkin seeds then. The swap goes on until three.
turns.zh: 我出門前先把另外兩包給我。你鄰居應該中午左右會回來，你到時可以問她南瓜種子的事。交換會會持續到三點。

groups.title: Testing building alerts without alarming staff
groups.titleZh: 測試大樓警示但不驚擾員工

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The message system can now send building alerts by text. Can we run a test during lunch, when people are out of the office?
turns.zh: 訊息系統現在可以用簡訊發送大樓警示。我們能趁午餐時間大家不在辦公室的時候測試嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: If we use the main list, it will reach everyone, even people at home. They might think the building is closed. The system has a separate list for test messages.
turns.zh: 如果用主要名單，所有人都會收到，連在家的人也是。他們可能以為大樓關閉了。系統另有一份測試訊息名單。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Let's use that list, then. Do both the front desk and security get those messages?
turns.zh: 那就用那份名單吧。服務台和保全都會收到嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The front desk is on it, but security isn't. I'll add the security supervisor now. Ask both teams to reply with the word received, instead of just checking whether a message was sent.
turns.zh: 服務台有列在上面，但保全沒有。我現在就加進保全主管。請兩組都回覆「已收到」，別只確認訊息有沒有送出。

groups.title: Choosing a museum display stand
groups.passage:
Woman: The bronze bell is ready for the river exhibit. It weighs eleven kilograms, and its base is thirty centimetres wide.
Man: The case door is only forty centimetres wide, so the whole stand must fit through it. The shelf must not be narrower than the bell. Do we still need a low platform for the label?
Woman: No. The label can go on the wall. Please use the stand chart to choose what fits, then check that the felt pads are in the drawer.
Man: Right. I’ll keep the tall case as planned; I’m only replacing the stand.
groups.passageZh:
女：這件青銅鐘已準備好放進河川展。它重十一公斤，底座寬三十公分。

女：不用，標籤可貼在牆上。請看展架表選合適的，再確認抽屜裡有沒有毛氈墊。
男：好，我會照原計畫使用高展示櫃，只換展架。

groups.title: Collecting a cat from a shelter
groups.passage:
Woman: I’ve come to collect Hazel, the grey cat. My sister completed the adoption yesterday. She’s at work, but she sent me the pickup code.
Man: A code works for the adopter. If another person collects the animal, we need a pickup note from the adopter’s account with that person’s name. You can wait while she sends it.
Woman: I’ll ask her. The carrier is in my car, but it has a broken latch. Could I borrow one just for the ride home?
Man: Yes. We lend carriers from the side counter. Return it here by Sunday; the outdoor drop box is only for paper forms.

女：我來接那隻叫 Hazel 的灰貓。我姊昨天辦完認養，她在上班，不過已把領取碼傳給我。
男：領取碼是給認養人用的。如果由別人代領，我們需要認養人從自己的帳號傳來代領通知，寫明代領人姓名。你可以在這裡等她傳。
女：我會請她處理。提籠在車上，但扣鎖壞了。我可以借一個用到回家就好嗎？
男：可以。請到旁邊的櫃檯借提籠，最遲星期日拿回這裡。戶外投遞箱只收紙本表單。

groups.title: Sending a translated handout
groups.passage:
Man: The Spanish handout is back from translation. The designer used the old draft, but only the contact number changed. The wording of the instructions is the same.
Woman: Then don’t send the layout back through translation. Ask the designer to replace the number, and send the updated page to me for a visual check.
Man: Can I attach the editable file to the message for partner offices today? They want to prepare before Monday.
Woman: Don’t send the editable file. Export the partner PDF only after I’ve checked the layout. Hold it until the public notice has confirmed the date. Meanwhile, send the partners a short update on when to expect it.
groups.passageZh:
男：西班牙文講義已翻譯回來。設計人員用的是舊稿，但改過的只有聯絡電話，操作說明的文字都一樣。
女：那就不要把版面再送去翻譯。請設計人員換掉電話，再把更新的那一頁寄給我做版面檢查。
男：今天我可以把可編輯檔附在寄給合作辦公室的信裡嗎？他們想在星期一之前準備。
女：不要寄可編輯檔。我確認版面後，才輸出給合作辦公室的 PDF；等公開公告確認日期後才能寄出。在那之前，先簡短告知對方大概何時會收到。

groups.title: Restoring a bike-rack tag
groups.passage:
Man: I still have my bike-rack key, but the number tag fell off my key ring. I don’t remember which rack is mine. The bicycle isn’t there now.
Woman: I can look up your flat number to find the rack. We don’t reuse lost tag numbers because a tag may still turn up. I’ll issue a new number for the same rack.
Man: Do I need a different key, then? I’m coming back by bike after seven tonight.
Woman: Keep your key. The lock stays the same. I’ll put the new number on the rack today and email it to you before we close at six. Collect a matching tag here another day.
groups.passageZh:
男：自行車架的鑰匙還在，可是鑰匙圈上的編號牌掉了。我不記得自己是哪一格，車子現在也不在那裡。
女：我可以用你的公寓戶號查到車架。遺失的編號不會重用，因為原本的牌還可能被找到。我會為同一個車架發新編號。
男：那鑰匙也要換嗎？我今晚七點後會騎車回來。
女：鑰匙留著，鎖不換。我今天會把新編號標在車架上，並在六點關門前寄給你。鑰匙圈上相同編號的牌，改天再來領。

groups.title: A twilight telescope demonstration

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Welcome to the Westbank observatory. While there is still daylight, we'll use the small telescope to show you how to bring a distant object into focus. You'll be looking at the clock tower, not at the sky. Once the first stars are visible, we'll move to the large telescope on the upper platform. Please don't take pictures from the stairs. There's a marked spot at the top where you can stop without blocking people behind you.
turns.zh: 歡迎來到 Westbank 天文台。天還亮的時候，我們會用小望遠鏡示範如何對焦遠方的物體。大家看的會是鐘樓，不是天空。等第一批星星看得見，我們就移到上層平台的大望遠鏡。請不要在樓梯上拍照。樓梯上方有一處標示好的位置，可以停下來而不堵住後面的人。

groups.title: Measuring vibration on a packing shelf

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Before we wrap any of today's glass jars, I want to measure the vibration on the top shelf of the packing cart. Last week's readings were taken on the handle, which is convenient but doesn't tell us what the jars actually experience. For today's test, put the meter where the first jar would normally sit. Push the cart down the usual aisle at walking speed. If the numbers are lower, that won't prove the new shelf lining works. We need another run with the old lining and the meter in the same place.
turns.zh: 今天開始包裝玻璃罐前，我想先量包裝推車最上層的震動。上週是在把手上測的，雖然方便，卻不能說明罐子實際受到多大的震動。今天請把儀器放在平常放第一個罐子的位置。以步行速度推車走平常的走道。如果數值變低，也不能證明新襯墊有效。我們還得換回舊襯墊，並在相同位置裝好儀器，再跑一次測試。

groups.title: A live radio handover after a pledge drive
groups.titleZh: 募款節目後的直播交接

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A quick note before we hand the studio over. The Saturday repair show starts at noon, just as it usually does. We'll finish the pledge drive a few minutes early so the next host can check her microphone. Please leave the donation total on the whiteboard. Take your tally sheets with you. They contain phone numbers from people who called the station. If the next host wants to thank listeners, she can read the total on air. Do not read out the names, phone numbers, or other personal details of people who called.
turns.zh: 交接錄音室前提醒一下。星期六的修繕節目照常在中午開始。我們會提早幾分鐘結束募款節目，讓下一位主持人能試麥克風。請把捐款總額留在白板上。統計表請帶走，上面有打電話到電台的聽眾電話。下一位主持人若想感謝聽眾，可以在節目中念出總額。請勿在節目中念出打電話到電台者的姓名、電話號碼或其他個人資料。

groups.title: Cleaning viewing panels at the aquarium
groups.titleZh: 水族館觀景板的清潔工作

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: A quick update for the aquarium cleaning team. The new viewing panels look like glass, but they're acrylic. Pick up the blue pads from the cabinet beside the service lift. The white pads we use on glass can leave marks on acrylic. On your first pass, wipe the visitor side only. If a mark remains, check whether it's on the water side. If it is, record its panel number for the tank team rather than cleaning the same spot again. If a mark is definitely on the visitor side and doesn't wipe off, add a photo to the cleaning log. Leave polishing to maintenance; it may make the panel harder to see through if it's done incorrectly.
turns.zh: 向水族館清潔小組說明一下。新的觀景板看起來像玻璃，但材質是壓克力。請到勤務電梯旁的櫃子領取藍色清潔墊。清潔玻璃用的白色清潔墊可能在壓克力上留下痕跡。第一遍只擦拭面向遊客的那一側。如果仍有痕跡，先確認是否在靠水的一側。若是，請記下觀景板編號，交由水槽維護小組處理，不要重擦同一處。如果確認痕跡在遊客側，又擦不掉，請拍照附在清潔紀錄中。拋光工作交給維護人員；操作不當可能讓觀景板變得不易看透。

groups.title: Recording weekend electricity readings

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: A reminder about the weekend electricity survey. Read the small meter beside the workshop door, not the building meter in the lobby. We need a baseline at six p.m. on Friday, after the last shift clocks out. If a machine is still running a scheduled overtime job, don't stop it for the survey. Take the six o'clock reading anyway, and mark the job on the sheet. A fixed time lets us compare workshops; the job note explains an unusual reading. On Monday, take the second reading before anyone starts a machine. If a machine has already started, record the meter reading and the machine's start time. In that case, leave the weekend-total box empty; the energy team will calculate an adjusted figure.
turns.zh: 提醒大家週末的用電調查。請讀取工作間門旁的小電表，不要看大廳的大樓總電表。我們需要星期五傍晚六點、最後一班打卡下班後的基準讀數。如果有機器還在執行排定的加班工作，不要為了調查而停機。照樣在六點讀表，並在表單註記該項工作。固定時間讀表有助於比較各工作間；加班註記則可解釋異常讀數。星期一要在任何人啟動機器之前讀第二次。如果已有機器啟動，請記下電表讀數與機器的啟動時間。這時請將週末總用電欄留白，能源管理小組會換算調整後的數值。

groups.passageZh: 提醒大家週末的用電調查。請讀取工作間門旁的小電表，不要看大廳的大樓總電表。我們需要星期五傍晚六點、最後一班打卡下班後的基準讀數。如果有機器還在執行排定的加班工作，不要為了調查而停機。照樣在六點讀表，並在表單註記該項工作。固定時間讀表有助於比較各工作間；加班註記則可解釋異常讀數。星期一要在任何人啟動機器之前讀第二次。如果已有機器啟動，請記下電表讀數與機器的啟動時間。這時請將週末總用電欄留白，能源管理小組會換算調整後的數值。

groups.title: Sorting donations at a toy drive
groups.titleZh: 玩具捐贈活動的分類工作

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Thanks for helping with Saturday's toy drive. Meet at the side entrance of the community hall at ten. Volunteers aged twelve and over can load boxes in the yard. Younger volunteers can sort toys indoors with an adult. If it rains, we'll stop loading in the yard, but the indoor sorting will continue. If you booked a clipboard, pick it up at the welcome desk by ten fifteen. After that, we'll give unclaimed clipboards to volunteers on the waiting list. If you arrive late, you can still join the sorting with a clipboard you bring. Check that a toy has all its pieces before putting it into a donation box.
turns.zh: 謝謝大家來幫忙星期六的玩具捐贈活動。十點在社區活動中心的側門集合。年滿十二歲的志工可以在院子裝載箱子，較年幼的志工可由成人陪同，在室內分類玩具。下雨的話，院子裡的裝載作業會停止，但室內分類照常。如果預約了寫字板，請最晚十點十五分到接待櫃檯領取。之後，未領的寫字板會交給候補志工。如果你晚到，仍可用自備的寫字板加入分類。請先確認玩具零件齊全，再放進捐贈箱。

groups.title: An evening traffic-noise survey

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Before tonight's traffic-noise survey, collect a sound meter from the council van. Clip it to the stand at your assigned corner. Record the reading at nine, but keep the meter running for the full ten minutes. If a bus idles beside you, write down when it arrived and left instead of deleting the reading. We need to distinguish an unusual event from the background level. After the survey, return the meter to the van, not to the office. If you can't reach your assigned corner because a pavement is closed, call me before choosing another place. If I approve a different corner, write both sites on the sheet before you start, so we can keep their readings separate.
turns.zh: 今晚進行交通噪音調查前，請到市議會的廂型車領取音量計，並將它夾在指定街角的支架上。請在九點記下讀數，但音量計要持續運作滿十分鐘。如果有公車在旁邊怠速，請記下它抵達和離開的時間，不要刪除讀數。我們需要區分特殊事件和背景噪音。調查結束後，請把音量計還到廂型車，不是辦公室。若因人行道封閉而到不了指定的街角，請先打給我，不要自行另選地點。如果我同意換到另一個街角，請在開始量測前把原地點和替代地點都寫在表單上，以便分開處理兩處的讀數。

groups.title: Combining two kinds of commuter assistance

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Here is an update on the commuter allowance. You can claim a monthly bus pass by uploading the receipt to the benefits portal. Claims submitted by Friday will appear in this month's pay; later claims will go into next month's pay. Staff who drive to the satellite office can also claim a parking voucher, but only for a day they did not use a subsidised pass. Record the travel date on the voucher request. If you bought a pass covering the whole month, you can still claim parking on a day you drove instead, provided you did not travel on the pass that day. Keep the two requests separate.
turns.zh: 以下是通勤補助的新說明。您可以把月票收據上傳到福利入口網站，申請公車月票補助。最遲星期五送出的申請會列入這個月的薪資；過了星期五才送出的申請則列入下個月的薪資。開車到分部辦公室的員工也可以申請停車券，但限於當天未使用受補助月票的情況。請在停車券申請中記下通勤日期。即使您購買了整個月都有效的月票，只要某天改開車、當天沒有用月票搭車，仍可申請那天的停車券。兩項申請請分開送。

groups.title: Choosing a reusable exhibition backdrop
groups.titleZh: 選擇可重複使用的展覽背景布

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: Here is the shortlist for the backdrop at our student exhibition. We need a single piece at least three metres wide, so no joining narrower pieces. The venue requires matte fabric because the lights will shine straight at it. We can spend up to eighty dollars. Please use the chart to choose from what the supplier has in stock. Put the backdrop on the order form now, but don't pay until the venue coordinator confirms the delivery address. She expects to confirm it on Wednesday. If we order by noon on Thursday, the supplier can send it with the regular delivery at no extra charge.
turns.zh: 這是學生展覽背景布的候選清單。我們需要一整塊至少三公尺寬的背景布，不能用較窄的布拼接。場地方要求用霧面布，因為燈光會直接照在布上。預算最多八十元。請看表格，從供應商現有庫存選一款。現在先把背景布填入訂單，但要等場地協調人員確認送貨地址後再付款。她預計星期三確認。只要最晚星期四中午下單，供應商就能併入例行配送，不另外收費。

groups.title: Doubles bowling tournament check-in

turns.speaker: S
turns.text: A reminder for pairs in Sunday's doubles bowling tournament. Check in together at the scoring desk by ten thirty. If your partner is late, tell the desk as soon as you arrive. You can practise on a free lane while you wait, but your first tournament game won't start without both players. We've moved the shoe exchange next to lane six; the old counter is being used for score sheets. Please keep your receipt if you rent shoes. The desk will refund the rental charge if your own shoes are damaged during a tournament game and you rent shoes from the centre. Shoes rented before your first tournament game, including rentals for practice, are not refundable.
turns.zh: 提醒參加星期日保齡球雙人賽的各組選手：請最晚十點半兩人一同到計分櫃檯報到。如果搭檔遲到，請一抵達就告知櫃檯。等待時可以在空球道練習，但兩人都到齊才會開始第一場正式比賽。換鞋處搬到了六號球道旁，舊櫃檯現在用來處理計分表。若租鞋請保留收據。如果自備球鞋在正式比賽中損壞，因而向球館租鞋，櫃檯會退還租金。第一場正式比賽開始前租的鞋不退費，包括為了練習而租的鞋。
