groups.passage:
To: Members with a pickup notice
Subject: Releasing a hold

Your tool stays at the pickup desk for two open days after we send the notice. Bring your membership card so staff can [131] ____ your account.

If you no longer need the tool and want the next member to have it, you can [132] ____ a hold by replying before it expires. A reply canceling your hold does not extend the pickup window. When staff receive that message before expiry, they offer the tool to the next person in line.

There is a separate option for members who still need the tool. Reply before expiry to ask for one extra open day. We can grant it only if nobody is waiting. [133] ____

The desk closes at 6 p.m. on open days, and it is closed on Mondays. A hold with a Sunday deadline will not remain active simply because Monday is [134] ____.

如果你不再需要這件工具，並希望讓給下一位候補者，可在期限前回覆，[132] ____ 預留。回覆取消預留，不會延長取件時間。若工作人員在到期前收到這類訊息，就會把工具提供給下一位候補者。

若仍需要工具，你也有另一個選項。請在到期前回覆，申請多保留一個開館日。只有無人等候時，我們才可批准。[133] ____

櫃檯在開館日下午六點關閉，星期一不開館。若期限是星期日，不會因星期一 [134] ____ 而繼續保留。

八號公車乘車通知
主旨：星期六站點改道

星期六道路施工，東圖書館旁的路邊站將封閉。公車仍按平常的時刻行駛，但不會停靠該處。封閉站點的標示會 [139] ____ 乘客前往圖書館後方的臨時站。

可以從湖街抵達臨時站。無法走樓梯的 [140] ____應改到花園門站上車，那裡有坡道，可從人行道上車，也可由車上通往人行道。公車會在圖書館原定發車時間兩分鐘後抵達花園門站。

臨時站只供上車，不提供下車。[141] ____

星期日的時刻表和站點 [142] ____；改道僅限星期六。
groups.reviewPassage:
Route 8 rider notice
Subject: Saturday stop diversion

Road work will close the curb beside East Library on Saturday. The bus will still run on its usual schedule, but it will no longer stop there. A sign at the closed curb will direct riders to the temporary stop behind the library.

The temporary stop can be reached from Lake Street. Riders who cannot use stairs should instead board at Garden Gate, where a ramp connects the bus entrance and exit to the sidewalk. The bus visits Garden Gate two minutes after its scheduled library departure.

The temporary stop is for boarding only; it cannot be used to get off the bus. To get off near the library without using stairs, use Garden Gate rather than the temporary stop.

The Sunday schedule and stop locations are unchanged; the diversion applies on Saturday only.
groups.reviewPassageZh:
八號公車乘車通知
主旨：星期六站點改道

星期六道路施工，東圖書館旁的路邊站將封閉。公車仍按平常的時刻行駛，但不會停靠該處。封閉站點的標示會引導乘客前往圖書館後方的臨時站。

可以從湖街抵達臨時站。無法走樓梯的乘客應改到花園門站上車，那裡有坡道，可從人行道上車，也可由車上通往人行道。公車會在圖書館原定發車時間兩分鐘後抵達花園門站。

臨時站只供上車，不提供下車。若想在圖書館附近下車且不走樓梯，請到花園門站下車，不要在臨時站下車。

星期日的時刻表和站點不變；改道僅限星期六。

groups.title: Follow-up on a facilities report
groups.passage:
To: Office occupants
Subject: An update on facilities requests

When reporting a problem, please [143] ____ the room number and a short description. A photo is useful but not required.

A request marked “received” is in our queue. It is not necessarily [144] ____ to a technician yet. If you find out that a door which was merely noisy now fails to lock, the new information matters more than a second report. [145] ____

For an immediate safety hazard, call the desk rather than waiting for a reply. Our phone number is [146] ____ the noticeboard by the lift.
groups.passageZh:
收件者：辦公室使用人員
主旨：設施維修通報的後續處理

通報問題時，請 [143] ____ 房間號碼和簡短的問題說明。照片有幫助，但非必須提供。

標記「已收件」表示已排入處理清單，不代表一定已 [144] ____ 給維修人員。如果發現一扇原本只是有噪音的門現在無法上鎖，更新這項資訊比重複通報更重要。[145] ____

若遇到立即性的安全危害，請打電話給服務台，不要等回覆。我們的電話號碼就在電梯旁的布告欄 [146] ____。
groups.reviewPassage:
To: Office occupants
Subject: An update on facilities requests

When reporting a problem, please include the room number and a short description. A photo is useful but not required.

A request marked “received” is in our queue. It is not necessarily assigned to a technician yet. If you find out that a door which was merely noisy now fails to lock, the new information matters more than a second report. Add the changed symptoms to the original request so staff can see how the problem developed.

For an immediate safety hazard, call the desk rather than waiting for a reply. Our phone number is on the noticeboard by the lift.
groups.reviewPassageZh:
收件者：辦公室使用人員
主旨：設施維修通報的後續處理

通報問題時，請附上房間號碼和簡短的問題說明。照片有幫助，但非必須提供。

標記「已收件」表示已排入處理清單，不代表一定已分派給維修人員。如果發現一扇原本只是有噪音的門現在無法上鎖，更新這項資訊比重複通報更重要。在原通報加上變化後的情況，讓工作人員看得出問題如何演變。

若遇到立即性的安全危害，請打電話給服務台，不要等回覆。我們的電話號碼就在電梯旁的布告欄上。

groups.title: Alteration claim ticket
groups.passage:
Mallow Street Alterations | Claim ticket 314
Customer: Iris Wen
Coat hem: shorten by three centimetres. Work complete. Paid in full.
Coat cuffs: no work authorized. The fabric selected at the first visit is no longer in stock. We have clipped two substitute swatches to the ticket copy at the counter. You can take the coat home now without deciding about the cuffs.
If you want the cuffs altered, choose a swatch and sign a separate work order by Friday. We can order material on Monday. The cuff work can begin as soon as the fabric arrives and takes four business days.
We close at six on weekdays. The side door stays open until seven on Thursday, but late pickup is only for work already paid for. Use the front counter to approve any new work.
groups.passageZh:
Mallow 街衣物修改店｜領件單 314
顧客：Iris Wen
大衣下襬：改短三公分。施工完畢，已付清。
大衣袖口：尚未授權施工。首次到店選定的布料已缺貨。櫃檯的領件單存根上有兩塊替代布樣。你可以先把大衣帶回家，不必現在決定是否修改袖口。
若要改袖口，請最遲在星期五挑選布樣並簽署另一份工單。我們可於星期一訂購布料。布料一到貨即可開始修改袖口，施工需四個工作天。
平日六點打烊。星期四側門開放到七點，但延後領件只適用於已付清的項目。核准任何新工作請到前方櫃檯。

groups.title: Caption desk incident log
groups.passage:
Caption desk incident 26 | 14:20 closeout
09:05 — Hosts reported that audience captions lagged in the main room. The recording copy still had captions in sync. There was no complaint from either side room.
09:15 — Support found that the audience screen was using the rehearsal feed. We selected the event feed and asked a host in the main room to confirm the timing before changing anything else.
09:22 — The host confirmed that the captions now matched the speaker. We did not touch the recording system.
12:10 — An organizer asked us to add two new names to the caption glossary. Please file that separately as a content request; it is not a recurrence of the timing incident.
14:20 — Mark the timing incident resolved. If lag returns on the event feed, note the room and time before switching feeds. Record the details even if an immediate change restores the captions.
groups.passageZh:
字幕值班事件 26｜14:20 結案紀錄
09:05｜主持人回報主會場的觀眾字幕延遲。錄影副本的字幕仍與發言同步。兩個分會場都沒有投訴。
09:15｜支援人員發現觀眾螢幕使用的是彩排訊號。我們改選正式活動訊號，並請主會場的主持人確認字幕時間，再決定是否另做調整。
09:22｜主持人確認字幕已和講者同步。我們沒有改動錄影系統。
12:10｜一位主辦人請我們在字幕詞庫加入兩個新姓名。請另外登記為內容需求，不是字幕延遲事件復發。
14:20｜將延遲事件標為已解決。若正式活動訊號再出現延遲，在切換訊號前記下會場與時間。即使立即處理後恢復，也要記下這些細節。

groups.title: The quiet side of a busy street
groups.passage:
Mill Bend Monthly | The quiet side of a busy street
At the old shoe shop, a locked door once stopped visitors from seeing the repair bench. Now it is the first stop in our neighborhood sound project. On a small speaker, you can hear a half-minute clip of the shopkeeper tapping shoe soles into place. She recorded it herself before the shop moved.
The project invites local residents to record everyday sounds. Please hand in the unedited file; the editors may shorten it, but they will not add sound effects. If a voice can be understood in the recording, get that speaker's permission before submitting it. A shop owner can approve recording inside a shop, but cannot give permission on someone else's behalf.
The trail leaflet shows two entrances to the covered market and six stops along the route. Start at the north entrance for the complete route. The south entrance gives access to the last three stops only.
groups.passageZh:
《Mill Bend 月刊》｜繁忙街道的安靜一面
那間老鞋店原本鎖著門，訪客看不到修鞋工作檯。現在，它成了我們社區聲音計畫的第一站。小喇叭會播放半分鐘的錄音，可聽見店主把鞋底敲打就位。她在店面搬遷前自己錄下這段聲音。
計畫邀請在地居民錄下日常聲音。請交未剪輯的檔案；編輯可能剪短，但不會加音效。如果錄音中的人聲聽得出內容，繳交前請先取得說話者允許。店主可以准許在店內錄音，卻不能代替他人同意。
路線摺頁標出室內市場的兩個入口及沿途六站。若想走完整路線，從北入口開始；南入口只能走到最後三站。

groups.title: Glaze trial disposition sheet
groups.passage:
Linden Ceramics | Glaze trial disposition sheet
Purpose: Select pieces for the customer’s colour viewing, not for a strength test.
Tray J: Even colour across the glazed face. There is a narrow unglazed band on the underside, where the test holder covered it. These pieces may be shown for colour. Put them on the viewing shelf.
Tray K: The finish is smooth, but one end is visibly darker than the other. Do not show these pieces as colour examples. Keep one on the comparison shelf to demonstrate the variation to the next shift.
Tray L: Tiny bubbles appeared after firing. Place these pieces in the reject bin after taking one close-up of the surface. Do not grind the bubbles away for viewing.
A piece stored on either shelf must keep its tray tag. Put the photo, not a reject piece, in the handover folder.
groups.passageZh:
Linden 陶瓷｜釉色試作處置單
用途：挑選供客戶看色的樣品，不是做強度試驗。
J 盤：上釉面顏色均勻。底面有一條未上釉的窄帶，是試驗固定座遮住的位置。這些樣品可以供客戶看色，請放到看色層架。
K 盤：表面平滑，但一端明顯比另一端深。不要把這些樣品當作顏色範例給客戶看；在比對層架留一件，向下一班呈現色差。
L 盤：燒製後出現小氣泡。先拍一張表面特寫，再把樣品放進不良品箱。不要把氣泡磨掉後拿去看色。
放在任一層架的樣品都要保留原盤標籤。交接資料夾放照片，不放不良品實物。

groups.title: Saturday compost drop-off notice
groups.passage:
Brook Hollow Community Garden | Saturday drop-off
Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable.
If the shed is closed because of heavy rain, check the chalkboard by the gate. When it reads “Indoor drop-off”, bring your scraps to the market hall during the same hours. When it reads “Cancelled”, take everything home. Neither sign changes what the volunteers accept.
Finished compost becomes available on the first Saturday of each month. Bring a separate bucket to collect it. In the market hall, volunteers can take incoming scraps but cannot give out finished compost. If scrap drop-off moves indoors on a compost collection day, the finished-compost collection is postponed; collect your share at the shed the following Saturday.
groups.passageZh:
溪谷社區菜園｜星期六回收
上午九點至十一點，可將家中的蔬果廚餘拿到菜園小屋。請將廚餘倒入有標示的桶中，再把自己的容器帶回家。志工不收肉、魚或包裝，包括標榜可堆肥的袋子。
如果大雨導致小屋關閉，請查看大門旁的黑板。寫著「改到室內回收」時，請在同一時段將廚餘送到市場大廳。若寫著「取消」，就把所有東西帶回家。兩種公告都不會改變志工接受哪些物品。
每月第一個星期六可以領取成品堆肥，請另帶一個桶子。市場大廳的志工可收進站的廚餘，但不能發放成品堆肥。若領取堆肥當天的廚餘回收改到室內，成品堆肥就延後發放；請在下一個星期六到菜園小屋領取自己那一份。

groups.title: Training credit for cover shifts
groups.titleZh: 支援輪班的訓練時數認列
groups.passage:
Harbor House | Training credit notice
The new one-hour safety briefing can be attended live or watched as a replay. If you attend live, the trainer enters your name. If you use the replay, submit the quiz from your training account; opening the replay alone does not count.
A cover shift is a shift you work for another team. Training done during a cover shift belongs on your usual team’s record, not the host team’s record. Check your record the next morning. If an entry is missing, send the completion date and briefing title to the training desk. Do not ask both supervisors to enter it.
For staff due to cover the loading counter, there is a separate access rule. Anyone without recorded training may cover the customer desk but not the loading counter. If your credit is missing, the host supervisor can change your assignment for that shift; the supervisor cannot approve training credit. The training desk will still need the information above.
groups.passageZh:
港灣館｜訓練時數認列
新的一小時安全說明可參加現場場次，也可觀看錄影。參加現場時，由講師登記姓名；看錄影則須用自己的訓練帳號交測驗。光打開錄影不算完成。
支援輪班是指代其他團隊值班。支援期間完成的訓練，應記在原所屬團隊的紀錄，不是受支援團隊。請在隔天早上檢查紀錄。若少了某筆，請把完成日期與說明會名稱寄給訓練服務台。不要請兩位主管各登記一次。
即將支援裝貨服務台者另有一條工作限制。未登記訓練者可支援顧客服務台，但不能支援裝貨服務台。若缺漏訓練時數，受支援團隊主管可調整你那一班的工作，但不能批准認列訓練時數。訓練服務台仍然需要前段所列資訊。

groups.title: Cold tasting panel: sample handling
groups.titleZh: 試飲小組：冷飲樣品操作
groups.passage:
Rill Foods | Cold drink tasting panel
The tasting team compares three drinks without seeing the brand names. Use only the two-letter codes printed on the cup stickers when recording scores. The product names remain in a sealed envelope until every panel member has finished scoring.
If a sticker comes off, do not try to identify the drink by colour or smell. Give the cup to the preparation desk and ask for a fresh sample. The desk uses the tray map to prepare a new coded cup. Keep your score sheet at your seat while waiting.
An orange dot on a sticker means the drink contains soy. Panel members avoiding soy should skip that sample but can score the others. Mark “not tasted” for any skipped cup; do not enter a numeric score.
groups.passageZh:
溪谷食品｜冷飲試飲小組
試飲小組在看不到品牌名稱的情況下比較三款飲料。記錄分數時，只用杯子貼紙上的兩個英文字母代碼。所有成員都完成評分前，品名表留在封好的信封裡。
如果杯子貼紙脫落，請勿靠顏色或氣味辨認飲料。把杯子交回備料台，要求換一杯。工作人員會依托盤配置圖準備一杯有新代碼貼紙的樣品。等候期間請把評分表留在自己的座位。
貼紙上的橘色圓點表示飲料含大豆。需要避免大豆的成員應跳過該樣品，但可照常評其他飲料。跳過的杯子請標示「未試飲」，不要填數字分數。

groups.title: Pool access during a lift test
groups.titleZh: 泳池升降椅測試期間的入場安排
groups.passage:
Cypress Pool | Wednesday access note
The main pool opens at 7 a.m. on Wednesday. The warm pool opens at 9 a.m. Both use the usual entrance and changing rooms.
Staff will test the main-pool lift at 8:30. Before they confirm the test is complete, swimmers who need help entering the water should ask reception to reserve a place in the warm pool. Its ramp is independent of the lift test. Do not enter the main pool by lift until a staff member confirms it is available.
A morning ticket normally covers only the pool named on the ticket. If a lift user changes pools on staff advice, reception can transfer the main-pool ticket to the warm pool at no charge. The transfer does not open the warm pool early, and it cannot be done at the poolside gate.
groups.passageZh:
柏樹泳池｜星期三入場通知
星期三主池上午七點開放，溫水池上午九點開放。兩池都沿用原本的入口和更衣室。
工作人員八點半會測試主池的升降椅。在工作人員確認測試完成前，需要協助下水的泳客應請櫃檯預留溫水池名額。溫水池的坡道不受升降椅測試影響。工作人員確認升降椅可用之前，請勿用它進入主池。
晨間票通常只能使用票上指定的泳池。使用升降椅的泳客若依工作人員建議換池，櫃檯可免費將主池票轉為溫水池票。轉票不會使溫水池提早開放，池畔入口也不能辦理轉票。

groups.title: An evening screening and a ticket voucher
groups.titleZh: 晚場放映與票券抵用券
groups.passage:
Document 1 · Cinema notice
Clover Cinema | Wednesday screenings
The 6:20 screening has open captions. The 8:10 screening does not. Doors open fifteen minutes before each screening.
A voucher covers one seat, not a companion’s seat. Redeem it online before noon on the day of the screening. You can also buy regular seats online before noon. Any seat still available after noon may be bought at the door at the regular price. Unused vouchers can be moved to a later date by emailing the office; the box office cannot do this.

Document 2 · Message from Sienna
To: Jules
I can get there at 6:10. Please choose the screening with captions. I received only one voucher, but we both need seats. The website showed four seats left at 10 this morning. Could you take care of the tickets before lunch? If you can only get one seat, don’t redeem the voucher yet. I’d rather move it to next Wednesday than go alone.
groups.passageZh:
文件一｜電影院公告
三葉草電影院｜星期三場次
六點二十分的場次有公開字幕，八點十分的場次沒有。每場開演前十五分鐘開放入場。
一張抵用券適用一個座位，不含同行者的座位。請在放映當天中午前上網兌換。中午前也可上網購買一般票。過了中午，剩餘的座位可在現場以原價購買。未使用的抵用券可寄電子郵件給辦公室改期；現場售票處不辦理改期。

文件二｜Sienna 的訊息
收件者：Jules
我六點十分可以到。請選有字幕的場次。我只收到一張抵用券，但我們兩人都需要座位。今天上午十點網站還顯示有四個座位。你能在午餐前處理票嗎？如果只能買到一席，先別兌換抵用券。我寧可改到下星期三，也不想自己進場。

groups.title: An approved print proof and a late address change
groups.titleZh: 印刷打樣核可與最後改送地址
groups.passage:
Document 1 · Print order confirmation
Northline Press | Order NP-604
Print run: 240 table cards. Paper: ivory.
Delivery: Front desk, 16 Perry Lane.
We will not start the run until you approve the proof. Proof approval confirms the content and layout only. To change the delivery address, email Dispatch with the order number before the run starts.
A collection request can be recorded later than an address change, provided the completed cartons have not left our premises.

Document 2 · Proof reply
Tuesday, 10:12
To: Proof desk
The card names and placement on the proof look right. Please approve that version for print. I mentioned the new function room to the designer yesterday, but the confirmation still lists Perry Lane. I have not emailed Dispatch.
Jo

Document 3 · Dispatch update
Tuesday, 13:25
NP-604 went into production at 11:40. We received no address-change request before that. The cartons are due to leave for Perry Lane at 16:00. We cannot change the delivery address once a run starts. If you prefer to collect this order, email us by 15:30 so we can keep the cartons at our collection counter.
Perry Lane staff have told us they cannot accept your order today. Please do not let the driver attempt delivery there if you can arrange collection.
groups.passageZh:
文件一｜印件訂單確認單
北線印刷｜訂單 NP-604
印量：240 張桌卡。紙張：象牙色。
送達處：Perry 巷 16 號接待櫃檯。
打樣未核可前不會開印。核可打樣只確認內容與版面。若要變更送達地址，請在開印前寄電子郵件給出貨組，附上訂單編號。
把配送改成自行取件可比更改地址晚辦理，前提是裝好的紙箱還沒有離開印刷廠。

文件二｜打樣回覆
星期二 10:12
收件者：打樣服務台
樣稿上的姓名與位置都正確，請用這一版印刷。我昨天有和設計人員提到新活動室，但確認單上仍是 Perry 巷。我還沒有寄信給出貨組。
Jo

文件三｜出貨更新
星期二 13:25
NP-604 已在 11:40 開始印刷。我們在開印前沒有收到更改地址的申請。紙箱原排定 16:00 出車，送往 Perry 巷。開印後不能改送達地址。如果想改成自行領取，請最遲於 15:30 寄信給我們，以便把紙箱留在取件櫃檯。
Perry 巷的工作人員告知我們，他們今天無法收件。如果你能安排自行領取，請不要讓司機白跑一趟。

groups.title: A borrowed costume for a family parade
groups.passage:
Document 1 · Costume booth rules
Willow Parade | Costume booth
A costume is free to borrow for the afternoon if you leave a refundable deposit. The deposit is returned when the costume comes back to the same booth by 5:15. The information tent does not take returns.
A loose fastening may be repaired by booth staff, but do not sew or tape the costume yourself. If you are leaving before the parade, you can still return the costume early.

Document 2 · Text messages
Chen: I picked up the green cape at the costume booth. The clasp keeps coming loose.
Yun: I’m at the information tent and I have tape if you need it. Are you watching the parade first?
Chen: I wanted to, but I have to catch the 4:50 bus. I’d like to get my deposit back before I go.
Yun: I can meet you by the steps at 4:20. The walk from the steps to the bus stop takes ten minutes.
groups.passageZh:
文件一｜服裝攤位借用辦法
柳樹遊行｜服裝攤位
繳交可退押金後，可免費借用服裝一個下午。最遲在 5:15 前把服裝帶回同一個攤位，即可退押金。服務帳篷不收歸還品。
鬆掉的扣件可由攤位工作人員修好，請勿自行縫補或貼膠帶。如果在遊行前就要離開，也可以提早歸還服裝。

文件二｜文字訊息
Chen：我在服裝攤位借了一件綠披風，扣件一直鬆掉。
Yun：我在服務帳篷，有需要的話我有膠帶。你要先看遊行嗎？
Chen：本來想看，但我得搭 4:50 的公車。走之前想先拿回押金。
Yun：我可以 4:20 在階梯旁和你碰面。從階梯走到公車站要十分鐘。

groups.title: Counting bird strikes at the east bridge
groups.titleZh: 東側人行橋的鳥撞統計
groups.passage:
Volunteer field card | Riverglass Bird Rescue
At the east pedestrian bridge, count a bird strike only if you see a bird touch the glass railing. A bird flying past the panel is not a strike. Enter groups of birds as separate sightings if you can tell them apart. Do not collect feathers or handle birds; call the rescue desk if a bird remains on the ground.

Email | Rowan to Saturday volunteers
Use the new wall-side entrance this week; work crews have closed the stairs near the river. Our 8:00–9:00 session stays the same. Have one person watch the glass while the other fills in the sheet. If a crew vehicle blocks your view, write down the start and end of the obstruction instead of guessing what happened.

Field log | Saturday | Ivy and Leon
8:13 Two swallows passed in front of panel 4; both continued across the river.
8:26 One sparrow touched panel 2 and flew away.
8:41–8:47 A maintenance van hid panels 1 and 2.
8:52 One pigeon touched panel 4 and stayed on the ground; Ivy phoned the rescue desk.
groups.passageZh:
志工觀察卡｜河玻璃野鳥救援站
在東側人行橋觀察時，只有親眼看見鳥碰到玻璃欄杆，才記為一次撞擊。飛過玻璃板不算撞擊。若能分辨同一群裡的個體，請分開記錄。請勿撿拾羽毛或接觸鳥；如果有鳥一直留在地上，請打電話給救援站。

電子郵件｜Rowan 寄給星期六的志工
本週請走靠牆的新入口，施工人員已封閉河邊的樓梯。觀察時段仍為上午八點到九點。請一人盯著玻璃，另一人填表。若工程車擋住視線，請記下遮擋的起訖時間，不要猜測當時發生了什麼。

觀察紀錄｜星期六｜Ivy 與 Leon
8:13 兩隻燕子飛過 4 號玻璃板前方，接著都飛到河對岸。
8:26 一隻麻雀碰到 2 號玻璃板後飛走。
8:41–8:47 一輛維修貨車遮住 1 號與 2 號玻璃板。
8:52 一隻鴿子碰到 4 號玻璃板後留在地上；Ivy 打給救援站。

groups.title: Dispatching the tile library’s loans
groups.titleZh: 磁磚資料館的外借品運送
groups.passage:
Packing instruction | Moss Harbor Ceramic Tile Library
Each tile loan travels in a reusable tray. A tray marked D contains display tiles only, and a tray marked H contains handling samples that visitors may touch. Put loose labels in the envelope clipped inside the lid. Do not tape a label to a tile, even for a short trip.

Courier bulletin | Monday pickup
The morning driver can take either type of tray but does not obtain signatures at delivery. The afternoon driver picks up at 3:30 p.m. and can collect a signature from the receiving staff. Wet-weather covers are available at the loading desk; keep the tray flat even when a cover is fitted.

Message | Kei to packing desk
On Monday, please send the display tray from our packing desk to South Hall’s borrowing desk. That delivery needs a signed handoff record. Send the visitor handling samples to the other site; that delivery needs no signature and can leave before lunch. Rain is expected; please fit weather covers to both loads.
groups.passageZh:
裝箱說明｜苔港磁磚資料館
外借磁磚都用可重複使用的托盤運送。標有 D 的托盤只裝展示磁磚，標有 H 的托盤裝訪客可以觸摸的樣品。散放的標籤請裝入夾在盒蓋內側的信封。即使只運送一小段距離，也不要把標籤黏到磁磚上。

快遞公告｜星期一取件
上午司機可運送兩類托盤，但不辦理送達簽收。下午的司機於三點半取件，可向收件人員取得簽名。裝貨櫃檯提供防雨套；即使套上防雨套，也須讓托盤保持水平。

訊息｜Kei 給裝箱櫃檯
星期一請由我們的裝箱櫃檯把展示托盤送到南館借用櫃檯。這批須取得簽名交接紀錄。供訪客觸摸的樣品送往另一個場地，不必簽收，可以在中午前出貨。預計會下雨，兩批貨都請套上防雨套。
